themes.label: Payments held or reversed unexpectedly
themes.summary: Users report that payments made through the app are delayed, returned, or held for days, leaving funds inaccessible and sometimes triggering late fees, declined transactions, or credit score drops. Many say customer service gave inconsistent answers, and a few describe accounts being closed or frozen after payments cleared. Several mention the verification steps required before payments and charges go through as a source of friction.
themes.recommendation: Pull payment posting and hold logs for iOS app payments (v5.x through v6.5x) and compare pending, released, and returned statuses against bank settlement timing, then add in-app status messaging and proactive notifications when a payment is held, returned, or reversed.

themes.label: Repeated 2FA prompts and login failures
themes.summary: Users across Android and iOS report that the app asks for a one-time code, card tap, or secondary verification on every sign-in, even when biometrics are enabled, and codes are slow to arrive or rejected. Many also hit recurring 'Looks like we need to fix something' or unrecognized-password errors, and several say the website works fine while the app does not. The pattern spans app versions from 6.50 to 6.55, suggesting a recent authentication change rather than a single device issue.
themes.recommendation: Audit the recent authentication change (v6.50 to v6.55) to confirm when biometric sign-in started falling back to SMS or card-tap verification, and restore a trusted-device skip for biometric sessions on the same phone, while tracking OTP delivery latency and rejection rates by platform.

themes.label: Mobile check deposit failing
themes.summary: Users across iOS and Android report that the app's check deposit feature rejects or fails to read checks, sometimes after months of retries, with one Android user saying the image capture never succeeds on most checks. Several say other banks' apps accept the same checks on the first attempt, and some have already moved money elsewhere because of it.
themes.recommendation: Audit the mobile check capture pipeline (image quality checks, OCR/processing errors, and backend acceptance) using the failing check images from these reports, and compare failure rates by platform and app version (notably v6.54.3 and v6.55.5) to identify the regression.

themes.label: Balance and due amount visibility
themes.summary: Users repeatedly say the app hides key numbers: the statement balance, the amount due with the due date, and a running balance that shows how purchases and payments change the total. Several report that payments and purchases appear slowly or disappear from pending, so the balance they see is out of date or confusing. The complaints span both Android and iOS and recent versions (v6.4x to v6.5x) as well as older iOS releases, pointing to a long-standing gap rather than a single regression.
themes.recommendation: Audit the account overview and payments screens to add a visible statement balance, minimum due and amount due next to the due date, and a 'remaining balance after partial payment' message, then test with the Android and iOS builds against a sample of partial-payment scenarios.

themes.label: Discover migrants miss old app features
themes.summary: Former Discover cardholders forced onto the Capital One app say it hides key information that the Discover app showed up front, especially the running balance across transactions, pending charge totals, statement balance and due date, and CD details. Many describe the app as cluttered, requiring more taps, and filled with ads or shopping offers on the home screen. Feedback appears on both Android and iOS across recent versions, with users saying the forced transition has pushed some to consider leaving the card.
themes.recommendation: Run a usability study with recent Discover-migrated users on the transaction list and home screen, and create a parity checklist of Discover features (running balance, pending total, statement balance and due date, CD summary) to prioritize for the next release.

themes.label: Credit limit increases denied or ignored
themes.summary: Users across iOS and Android say Capital One keeps their credit limits low or refuses increases despite years of on-time payments and high incomes, and some report requests going unanswered. Many also feel that low limits make the card impractical for everyday spending, pay-bill-with-card use, or hold-heavy purchases like gas. Several reviewers compare unfavorably with Discover and other issuers that raise limits automatically.
themes.recommendation: Pull the last 12 months of credit line increase request logs and decline reasons, then audit whether the app's request flow and confirmation messaging are clearly setting expectations and closing the loop on each request.

themes.label: Praise: app ease and customer service
themes.summary: Users in this cluster are overwhelmingly praising Capital One for its easy-to-use app, responsive customer service, and fraud alerts that quickly catch unauthorized charges. Many long-tenured cardholders say the company helped them build credit and they recommend it to family and friends. The few complaints in the sample are scattered (a debit card not arriving, slow transfers, a card deactivated during disputes, and a Capital One Shopping feature that glitches on mobile), with no single recurring issue.
themes.recommendation: Protect the app's ease of use and real-time fraud alerts as core differentiators, and pull the mobile-specific complaints (Capital One Shopping rewards tracking, card deactivation during disputes, and address-change validation) into a backlog review to see whether any recur across the broader 143-review cluster.

themes.label: Praise: easy navigation and credit tools
themes.summary: Users across Android and iOS overwhelmingly praise the Capital One app as simple, clear, and easy to navigate for paying bills, checking transactions, locking cards, and viewing their FICO or CreditWise score. Several mention the app being better than other banking apps they have used, and a few point to rewards, savings accounts, and fraud alerts as reasons they stay. Minor requests recur within the praise, such as seeing available credit immediately after a payment, per-transaction remaining balance, and dispute options within the app.
themes.recommendation: Protect the core navigation and payment flows in release QA, and open a ticket to investigate why available credit no longer updates immediately after a payment posts in the app (v6.50.x and later reports), since that is the one concrete regression users cite.

reviews.x: PLEASE READ ALL! I’ve noticed that I have been charged with several interest charges on my account . Therefore I chatted in the capital one app for help. I have consistently made payments before my due date, and I have frequently paid more than the minimum amount due. I was not aware that I could still be accruing interest if I was paying more than the minimum. I’ve been a responsible customer for the past two years. I’ve made my payments before the due date because I genuinely believed that paying on time was important for maintaining a good credit score. I’ve also paid more than the minimum amount due because I wanted to keep my account in good standing. Honestly, I’m very disappointed with the service I’ve received today. I did not expect this kind of response from Capital One, especially after being a responsible customer who has consistently made payments on time. Simply being told that nothing can be done or that the charges cannot be reviewed further feels very unhelpful. I understand that there are policies and limitations, but I expected someone to at least make an effort to review my situation and find a reasonable solution. I’m not asking to avoid paying what I owe. I’m asking for help with interest charges that have been accumulating for a long period of time despite my consistent, on-time payments. I would appreciate a more thorough review of my account and a solution that reflects my history as a customer.

reviews.x: I have been a long time Customer Capital One customer for probably close to 30 years. Recently, I got a text for a suspected online fraud purchase. Even though Capital One could not tell me the reason why they flagged the online charge as fraudulent, they forced a card change. Normally, I would accept this as a good business practice, had it not been for this. Three years ago, Capital One did the exact same thing to me almost to the exact date. In both cases, I was out of town traveling thus it was terribly inconvenient for me. Capital One promised a next day FedEx delivery would bring a new card by 10am which failed and then showed up three days later to a location I was no longer at. The card was left on a porch with no person present even though a “signature was required”. Worse yet I had to notify Capital One of their broken promise and failure to deliver on my return home. To which Capital One promised yet another new card (the2nd) to be delivered to my home address by 10 AM the next day. The second promise also failed & the card came three days later. After 30+ years it’s time to change financial institutions as the evidence shows they can no longer perform as they claim-TWICE! It’s just impossible to have faith in a financial company that performs this way!

reviews.t: Discover to Capital One transition horrible
reviews.x: I’ve been a Discover card account holder since 2002. I used to love the app. It was very transparent. Each transaction was totaled up so you could see what was due and when it was due. Now that Capital One took over, they took away those benefits and now they are NOT TRANSPARENT! Why would they take this feature away?? Are they trying to cheat us? It makes me not trust Capital One AT ALL! Now I have to guess what the total is on each transaction if it’s gone through or if it hasn’t gone through. When is my bill ending period?? It used to be easy to understand because it was the same day every single month now the date is later and it’s NOT apparent on the app when it’s actually tabulated for the next bill. WHY WOULD YOU CHANGE THESE FEATURES?? WHAT ARE YOU TRYING TO HIDE?? I’m seriously thinking about using a different card for my purchases for these reasons and Discover has been my primary card. Very unhappy customer!

reviews.t: Excellent but not for small businesses
reviews.x: I have been a Capital One member for over 20 years. Although my accounts offer decent interest rates, 2-day advanced direct deposits, and no fees and have allowed Capital One to use tens of thousands of my dollars over the years, Cap One would not allow me to open up a business checking account ONLY until they saw that I put a certain amount of money in another bank’s business checking account I opened several years later. For the first time in years, Capital One offered me an opportunity to open one! I also attempted to get a small business loan but they only consider you a small business if you are making $250,000k or $50k in gross receipts. I am a disabled, black & woman owned business and I am simply trying to make a living. Do they know that black women-owned sole proprietorships & self-employed with no employees only average $24k annually in revenue? In 2024 the black women-owned businesses only averaged between $47-$58k annually in revenue. Do they understand some businesses aren’t even achieving 50k in revenue aside from 50k in gross receipts? My last question is do they care or only interested in serving and assisting richer clients? I truly believe they are missing out on a market segment that is eager to receive access to funding and as a result, the bank will be rewarded with higher payoff percentages & lower deficit portfolios for those same customers. ~MJ Haskins, Owner, Covenant Financial LLC, Middletown, DE.

Capital One has developed a troubling reputation among many customers, with widespread complaints about account suspensions, poor communication, and questionable handling of funds. Numerous users report having their accounts suddenly restricted or closed without clear explanations, leaving them locked out of their own money for extended periods. When they contact customer service, the experience often becomes even more frustrating, as representatives often provide vague or inconsistent answers and fail to give a clear timeline for follow ups or resolutions, with some customers saying they were promised callbacks that never came. Across review platforms, the company receives very low ratings, with recurring complaints about delayed payments, unresolved fraud disputes, and unhelpful or rude support staff. Some customers also claim their funds were held or access was delayed without proper explanation, leading to concerns that the company may withhold access to money during account reviews or technical issues. Across online discussions, users echo similar experiences, describing locked accounts, denied disputes, and customer service agents who seemed unable to resolve issues or provide reliable updates. Altogether, these patterns create the impression of a credit card company that lacks transparency, consistency, and dependable customer support, making it a frustrating option for many users.

reviews.t: Bait and Switch on welcome bonus. Beware
reviews.x: I was deciding between a Capital One card and a Wells Fargo card. Both offered unlimited 2% cash back. The Wells Fargo card included an 18-month 0% APR period and a $500 bonus for spending $10,000 in the first 3 months. Capital One advertised a much stronger incentive: $1,000 bonus after $10,000 spend in 3 months, and $2,000 after $30,000 spend in the first 3 months (with an annual fee starting after the first year). This higher bonus is exactly why I chose Capital One. After hitting the $10,000 spending requirement, I contacted customer service to redeem the bonus. I was told the $10,000 tier only qualifies for $750 - not the $1,000 that was advertised. This was never mentioned during application or in the offer details I reviewed. This feels like a classic bait-and-switch. I made my decision based on the higher advertised bonus, and Capital One failed to deliver what they promised. While they will still get the spending and fees from me during this introductory period, they have permanently lost my future business. I would strongly advise others to get written confirmation of all bonus terms before choosing Capital One over competitors with clearer, more reliable offers.

reviews.x: I love the simple app, easy to navigate. Not sure why some people don’t like capital one in the reviews. They’ve been good to me even when I was at my worst times financially. I actually had my first credit card with capital one, but through tough job issues got into some minor debt. Granted I did owe the bank around 300$ or so. I paid it off after a few months or a year I can’t remember, and waited like 1-3 years thinking they wouldn’t accept me again, but I did have a stable job at this point in my life and they accepted me again. My time frames aren’t exact but essentially they stuck with me at my worst and now at my best. I did an auto refinance and was able to save some money monthly for barely much more than I owed my original loan. I have 3 credit cards with C1 and basically try to earn points now so I can travel for low and see my family. I used some points for a joint trip with my partner to go to a wedding. I think it’s a good bank for the normal person who needs a break and is responsible and accountable. I definitely won’t be leaving or cancelling. My credit is finally in the 700 range and I have money saved in the bank!! Savings account was good, ultimately saved somewhere else for better interest rate but only because I’m greedy lol. I had the savings with capital one for like a year or so, was good as well! I have a credit limit of 5000 on my venture one and I pretty much just use it for groceries. If I get to like $1000-$2000 owed I’ll pay half or 1/3 and keep going this way. Right now I have it at $200 and I’m cruising.

Users can no longer cancel auto pay for a single month when paying off their balance. The app now requires either a cancellation for the entire auto pay series or Capital One will deduct an additional amount of whatever the auto pay is set up for in addition to the balance users are paying. This is really unnecessary and inconvenient. Cancelling auto pay and forgetting to set it up again means a payment can easily be missed. Was this the intention of Capital One in removing that option?

The app is easy to use, but it has too many other credit offers and pop-ups for other services. Just let me use the app to manage my credit card. All of the other marketing pop-ups and messages are very annoying and make the app feel like a free game off of Google Play that you delete after playing for a few hours.

Having trouble depositing monthly checks if they are the same dollar amount, even if the different check number is clearly displayed. I spoke to customer service and they said I'm SOL and need to deposit them at an actual branch. That is extremely inconvenient and defeats the purpose of mobile banking. I'm considering finding a new bank already.

I’ve had this card for several years, and I can confidently say the customer experience is unmatched. As someone who travels frequently with my daughter, who is a collegiate athlete, we often find ourselves in unfamiliar - and sometimes less comfortable - places. Having a credit card company I can truly rely on brings a level of peace of mind that’s hard to put into words. Every time I’ve interacted with customer service, I’ve felt genuinely valued. No matter who I speak with, they treat my financial situation with the same level of importance and care that I do. That consistency speaks volumes. What truly sets them apart is how seamless and dependable everything is while traveling. I never have to worry about my card being declined unexpectedly or dealing with delayed fraud alerts that leave me scrambling at checkout. Instead, I feel like I have a “financial guard” with me at all times - protecting my money while still allowing me to use it freely and confidently. In situations where other companies create stress or inconvenience, this team delivers reliability, security, and trust. My finances and investments feel safe, and that’s something you simply can’t put a price on. I’m incredibly grateful to be a customer and would highly recommend them to anyone who values exceptional service, especially those who travel often.

I've been with this credit card company for three years and two months. never missed a payment. Continously pay off my cards, all while maxing out the balance countless times. Make over 100k a year, and NEVER get approved for a a limit increase. Capital one recently said, "you had a recent returned payment." Yeah, I didn't want the product purchased, as it didn't match the description. That constitutes a disapproval? Plenty of other cards out there with better interest rates and rewards. #BYE

You can not order things with this card even with this app. Your order will be denied even if you have 700 dollars credit left on the card for a 200 dollar purchase and I autopay. You have to go through a 10 day verification period over and over again. Terrible business that make you the customer look indigent when you are actually not.

The App is very easy to navigate even if your new to online credit banking. You can even have multiple accounts (cards) at one time within the App and it's still visually pleasing and well organized! I also enjoy having access to Creditwise and getting updates on my credit score, even if it's just a close estimate. However, I'm SERIOUSLY upset now that I can no longer use it on my Note 9!! 🤨😑. At the end of the day, it's a Great App overall!

reviews.t: Works fine, but I have a YUGE gripe
reviews.x: The app has all the usual features you’ll find in any credit card iOS app, but the MAIN one I actually often use is the ability to lock the card when it’s not in use (I leave it locked just in case I lose my wallet, am pick-pocketed, etc). The problem is when you’re on the Home page of the app, users must scroll past tons of rarely-used features they don’t need to see (eg scheduled payments, expected transactions, recents transactions, special offers, etc: I’m not going to be referring friends). Upshot is, users are forced to scroll past all of that stuff just to get down to the LOCK card box. Devs, don’t make users work that hard to find a function that should be easier to find (it should be near the top of the page), as locking a card is a powerful anti-fraud feature that should be used by customers to help protect Capital One’s bottom line (users are on the hook unless they report suspicious card activity within a short period of time, but if they report it promptly, Capital One covers unauthorized transactions). Devs, help users protect your client from unauthorized use (when I first used my card, I was standing at the checkout line of a cashier, and had to spend a minute trying to find it).

make transactions organized by date they were made (pending and approved transactions) instead of date the transaction was approved! it is very difficult to track transactions when trying to remember when you purchased something vs the date on the app which lists it under the approved date. also add time stamp to all transactions in the app not just date - I will make this rating back to a 5 once this is fixed, it is a huge nuisance and makes tracking transactions very confusing! please fix!

First of all, Capital One charges you as much interest as your minimum payment so never ever pay the minimum because it's impossible to pay your card off. You select an account to pay from then it comes out and sometimes they randomly put it back in your account and try to charge you late fees for not paying. But the app lets me pay my bill I guess.

Capital One issued a Discover It card to me. I used it in several places. Most of the payments were refused, denied, returned. This directly affects my credit rating, costs me late fees, and has messed up my finances to a distressing degree. I do not recommend it. Be aware that a Discover card is not the same as Discover It.

The app itself is very easy to use in general. the UI is very well laid out. only a couple small issues relating to how to hide or roll up old accounts or accounts that you're not using on the main landing page. And in my opinion, we should be able to completely turn off overdraft protection on a debit account. or at the very least turn off for everything but actual emergencies. The add cash in store feature is the killer feature for me.

Really Great app. Simple to manage and keep track of all my accounts perks and benefits. Did notice a slight glitch in the last version where for the 1st time ever a purchase didn't prompt an immediate (push, text or email) notification of a purchase. Hopefully that was just a one-time glitch &or addressed in this version.

reviews.t: Card is great but App and live support not so much
reviews.x: Today is at least the fourth/fifth time I’ve encountered “Couldn’t Match Number” message from the Capital One Mobile app and/or the desktop capital one website. This in the first two weeks of having the card. It was particularly maddening today because I was trying to check out online using my Capital One card and the store’s app was telling me I had their last two of an item; I wanted three. For all I know, They may have sold out by the time I was able to use a competitor’s card. Each time this has happened, I’ve contacted the support telephone number and explained in detail the message that I was receiving from the Capital One app or their desktop. This “Couldn’t Match Number” message goes into detail about what some of the causes may be but the people that take the telephone calls and the tech-support people they eventually transfer me to have not been able to solve it. This message has a “try another way” button on it, and when you click on that, it asks you to validate your ID by taking a selfie and photographing the front and back of your ID. That’s not terribly convenient when you’re trying to check out with a couple items in your cart that may be gone in the next minute or two. I’ve gone through that exercise at least twice and it’s an only a temporary fix. In this day and age, if that’s your second verification method, you need to fix your system. There’s no way in the app or desktop to establish a two step verification I’ve been told by their tech support. It’s a shame Capital One doesn’t have better support behind a goood Card!

reviews.t: Capital One is an amazing bank
reviews.x: I love capital Bank. It keeps my money secure. I love that I can have access to my account through the app and it’s very easy to use and very helpful when I have any questions about any transaction or any problems and the customer service is phenomenal. I wouldn’t use another Bank than Capital One. Thank you, Capital One for always securing my my money, my finances and I love the real time notice if anything or security is going on they immediately call me and let me know and they won’t let any fraudulent actions happen and give me the security that I know that I don’t have to worry it’s been a very pleasure having you as my Bank and I will help to continue doing it forever Capital One one of the best bank ever

When you sign up they change their terms after so what they tell you to your face is completely different. They have no compassion for their user base when it comes to issues that effect your direct deposit or even welcome bonus. You are out of luck. Now another issue is security, even on my trusted device and giving credential info, you will constantly have to go back and forth verifying yourself. My husband is in Europe, and he has been using the credit card.I received a notification that fraud was expected, and that the account had been closed or locked. When I called on Sunday, a gentleman help me and we got the card unlocked and all was fine. I had to furnish my drivers license and a selfie. My husband tried to use the card again and again received a notification of fraud. Now I am having the most difficult time getting my card unlocked. Every time I speak to someone I get a different answer and different request or documents. I have several payments that go through my capital one card that are becoming due very shortly. I have had no luck, and all I get is request for more documentation and told that it will take 1 to 10 days to review and unlock my card. I have never had this kind of difficulty with this company in all that time. I appreciate you looking at my transactions for fraudulent charges, but I am not happy with the way I’m having to get this card unlocked.

I’ve banked with capital one since my divorce 5 years ago and I love them. From getting my first card, to buying a home and car this card has been easy and efficient! The customer service is always amazing and helpful and when someone tries to take a card out in my name capital one time immediately contacted me and let me know and walked me through getting a new card and everything! The app is amazing too, I love seeing my credit score and I also put got my son a card to build his credit and again the experience is amazing and I always recommend them. My father who has never owned a card reached out to me two days ago because now at the age of 60 he wants one!

reviews.t: Capital One - Best Credit Financial Institution and Mobile App
reviews.x: I have been a Capital One customer for years. I believe they are the number one credit card institution that anyone could have or need. I have had no issues with their website, application, billing, or customer service. Thank you Capital One for giving me a chance to improve my credit years ago and still be the best credit card with low interest and a better understanding to customer needs. I have a few credit cards but nothing compares to the Capital One service in whole that I receive. Thank you for your help Capital One and for all that you have done for me and continue to do. I recommend Capital One to everyone that I speak with regarding their finances, loans, and all other credit card services. My end goal is to combine the very few credit cards that I have into only Capital One accounts. I would like to add that Capital One has the best financing program if you need a car loan. In the four years that I used Capital One for my car loan, there was not one single issue. So keep in mind if anyone needs a car loan, take my advice, Capital One should be your number one pick for your loan. Capital One…. You are amazing and thank you!!

I had been a many year Capital One user, however my latest interactions have convinced me this is a one sided relationship. As long as I didn’t have a problem, C1 was fine. I have waited weeks for any follow up on my many calls. I have spoken at length to several “supervisors” to no avail. I accept, Capital One isn’t interested in customer relations and it’s time for me to leave. Of course, my family and friend will leave with me. Not a single return call or email from any of my inquiries, though each “supervisor” confirmed they were “escalating” my case. “It may take as much as 10 days” Several noted the validity of the issue, though they lacked any ability to intervene. I have waited weeks. I accept there will be no follow through. There are so many options for good online banking, and after all of these years I have learned Capital One is not a viable choice. They simply don’t care when an issue arises. I probably should have accepted this many years ago when another issue arose. There were no return calls, no correspondence and no follow up. I excused it as a singular anomaly. Sadly, I have learned it is simply business as usual for Capital One.

reviews.t: The worst handling of multiple cards I’ve seen
reviews.x: This company is ridiculous. It’s 2026. People are unable to barely afford living day to day with how expensive it is. And this company expects you to have a $80 phone plan just to be able to use 2FA. For context, I tried to open a new credit card cause you know… I need it. They sent me the card but first of all it made me open a BRAND NEW account to be able to use it. I have an account. Why should I have to have even MORE potential breaches of security? Second of all, I can’t even GET into that account because as soon as it set it up, it immediately locked me out and demanded to get 2FA and it won’t accept my mobile number. It’s 2026, like MOST people under 60 I have a prepaid service to get unlimited for $25. I’m not going to pay MORE for LESS from a ‘traditional’ phone. But yet this company expects it. It won’t authenticate my account. Won’t let me get into my account. I haven’t been able to even activate the card because I’m not about to have a card I can’t use. No I do not want to have to call them for this. They need to get it together. Each new credit card shouldn’t need a different account and they should accept what makes up a majority of Americans phones. (Though I understand this is likely just a shady tactic to discriminate against people )

Account details no longer opening so I can no longer see interest rate, etc for accounts which is frustrating. PLEASE FIX THIS! I rarely use bill pay after it was "updated" but I have moved on to other ways to pay so I can live with that. I do like how easy it is to open and close accounts and see them all in one place and the ease of accessing the app. Editing rating because the issue with the account details button was fixed. Thank you!

After COVID, my finances took a hit. My credit took a hit. And rebuilding felt overwhelming and honestly discouraging. Capital One was the institution that gave me a second chance. They weren’t just “a credit card company” to me they were the first yes when I needed one. That initial approval became the foundation for rebuilding my credit responsibly. Over time, I didn’t just regain stability I regained confidence. Today, I have both my credit card and my banking accounts with Capital One, and I’ve chosen to keep everything in one place because the experience has been consistently reliable, transparent, and straightforward. What stands out most to me is not flashy perks it’s trust. Clear communication. Easy-to-use tools. No surprises. In a time when I needed structure and accountability, Capital One provided that. Everyone’s financial journey is different. This was mine. And for me, Capital One wasn’t just part of the rebuild it made the rebuild possible. Grateful 🙏🏽 And before anyone come up to me saying this is AI generated. I’m saying yes it is GPT help me write this message because my first language is not English. And I wanna make sure that I wrote how I feel thank you.

reviews.t: Worst Start To A Banking Relationship I’ve Ever Had
reviews.x: The first two checks I deposited have had 7+ day holds on them. If you can’t cash a check because they do not have a live teller in the whole Northwest, and you submit it through their ATM and they put restrictions on accessing funds because of potential “fraud”…. Then what’s the point of having a relationship with a bank. Isn’t that the point of all the verification that happens up front? Why do I feel discriminated against, I’m already being questioned and I’m the customer? They offered zero support in helping me in a time where funds were needed at the most critical time. My deposits are scrutinized, questioned, and with held for countless days while my funds are in their hands gaining interest. My money that could be gaining interest somewhere else. I’m not a suspect, I’m the CUSTOMER, I have a name, a family, with real life golden retriever… I’m not a number, I’m a person that could have been a tremendous ambassador for Capital One… I don’t think they understand real life, real people, people that have real families to support and take care of…. Some people don’t get holidays off, and if you are going to have customer support available on a holiday, give them authority to support customers. You are a bank that moves money, if customer support can’t do that, then save your money and give them the day otherwise what’s the point….

I have the receipt with description and pictures of what I received and the package and shipping label ! I sent them to both the vendor and capital one. They determined it’s my problem. No explanation! I guess I’ll be moving on soon. You find the real company when there’s a problem I guess. Been a customer 40 years. Never had a problem until now. 40 years never had a complaint againt anybody. I felt protected when I made a purchase but it was just fluff.

I am extremely disappointed with my experience with Capital One after being a loyal customer for over a decade. Throughout the years, I maintained my account responsibly and worked hard to protect my credit. Unfortunately, after a single late payment due to a family emergency, Capital One reported it to all major credit bureaus without any consideration of my long-standing history or loyalty. There was no willingness to review the circumstances, no meaningful customer care, and no effort to preserve a decade of positive credit behavior. What made the situation worse was the customer service experience. The representative was unhelpful, and the supervisor I spoke with was dismissive, unprofessional, and ultimately hung up on me during the conversation. That level of conduct is unacceptable from a financial institution of this size. Additionally, I have experienced aggressive marketing practices, including being mailed new credit cards and encouraged to activate them without clearly disclosing the long-term impact. Once activated, customers may face high interest rates and fees that are not transparently communicated upfront. If you make even a minor mistake, they do not hesitate to damage your credit record - unlike other credit card companies that demonstrate flexibility and reasonable customer accommodation. I am sharing my decade-long experience to caution others. Loyalty and a strong payment history did not matter in my case. I would strongly advise consumers to carefully review all terms and consider whether this is the type of company they want managing their credit.

reviews.t: Just can’t ever get it right
reviews.x: I want to like it, I really do, but the short time I have banked with Capital One, I have not been able to get a debit card to work, still have not received my credit card , because the app wouldn’t recognize my mailing address’s second line at the time I changed it, and it takes longer to transfer money from a Capital One account to another bank than it does to transfer money from competitors banks to local banks I can access cash from their local atms. They are very friendly and helpful when I call, so that’s nice these days when a lot of customer service people aren’t always as helpful. Still, I think Capital One has a lot of issues that other banks just don’t seem to have. I’ll keep the account open to pay off the old credit card and the new one, if I ever get it, but I’ll have to give this bank a hard pass until things improve.

I’ve been a Capital One customer for over a decade & recently I found out how much that matters. It doesn’t matter one iota!! Out of the blue I get an email telling me that I’ve lost overdraft for 60 days, because I didn’t put $250 in, in the past 30 days. Well I knew that was a lie because my paycheck was direct deposited there. I relied on that overdraft, & losing it was extremely hard! After my 60 day starvation period, they turn it back on, for $20, which is just a fraction of what it was. After a week of trying to get in touch with a human, someone finally called me back. After I sat through their diatribe of spamming their terms & conditions, they came to the conclusion that maybe one day I could get the overdraft I once had! I proclaimed that any employee who was doing their job who had critical thinking skills could’ve taken a look at my past & credit report & known that Capital One was the ONLY institution I was faithful to! But the lack of humanity & reliance on robots overlooked that. I finished the conversation saying Capitalism One will rue the day that ever turn my overdraft back up, because it would be maxed out & ghosted! And they could write every nasty remark they can dream of on my credit report in capital cursive letters if they want!! Capitalism One can hold their breath and wait for their money!!

It was a quick and easily application. I was approved even though I have less than great credit. I had a previous account with them several years back and I got ill and was unable to work and pay my bill. They were really kind and understanding and never pressured me for a payment. They always wished me well and a quick recovery. Unfortunately I was never able to keep up with payments and it went into collections. I apologize and they were still understanding. Even with that I was still approved and given another chance. On positive note after 3 years in collections I was able to make a deal and settle my account. Made me feel Right by myself. 😉😋

reviews.t: Things move at a snails pace
reviews.x: I opened up a joint acct for my husband and I about 2 weeks ago. My direct deposit went in a few days after I filled out my info. That was the only thing that happened quickly with this bank. I had no access to my money and it was a week and a half before Christmas. I wasn’t “eligible “for a virtual card. I initiated a payment to my credit card, a transfer to Venmo and a transfer to Venmo but everything took a few days . I finally received my debit card in the mail in Christmas Eve and I filled my cart with everything I needed for Christmas as I hadn’t been able to have access to my money and my transaction wouldn’t go through and customer service was not available as it was Christmas Eve. reviews.a: What is wrong with this bank?

reviews.x: I have a completely legitimate check, all numbers are visible and whatnot, tried multiple times and every time it says hey retake the photo but make sure the numbers are legible. So I try again, yup numbers are legible. The image is clear. I’m in a well-lit area. The check is on a dark background. Every single instruction has been followed yet you still tell me you can’t read the numbers on the bottom. Ok so I go get the check re-issued. Same problem. Different check, so how could it be the same problem? I’ll tell you how. It’s the app that’s the problem, not my checks. Money ain’t something to mess around with. If you have zero physical locations where we can deposit a check then it’s your responsibility to make sure your app actually works. Please fix it so I can pay my mortgage. Would have done 1 star but the rest of the app works fine.

reviews.t: Cancel my Business credit card and personal credit card
reviews.x: I was trying to buy something with my business credit card, and Capital One blocked the card. The next day, I went to the same place to try to complete the transaction and used my personal credit card for a smaller amount, and they blocked that one too. When I called Capital One, they told me it was due to fraudulent transactions, and I explained that it wasn't fraud, that I was the one trying to make the purchase, and that I needed them to unblock the cards so I could finish the transaction. They told me they couldn't do anything and that I would receive a letter in 7 to 10 days with the final results of the investigation. The next afternoon, I received two letters, one regarding the business account and the other regarding the personal account, but both said the same thing. They had closed both accounts due to unusual activity by a Capital One customer, leaving me without any credit cards to continue operating my business. I find this unbelievable. Bank of America, if it detects something unusual, sends a text message to verify if you are the one making the transaction, and then everything is resolved. Capital One has good benefits, but zero empathy for its customers.

I haven’t had any problems with the app. It works fine. My concern and issue is I have an older phone and I’m not going to buy a new phone. I don’t like that I have to update the iOS in order to use the updated app. My phone can only update so many times. My phone works fine for what I need it for and updating the iOS is not an option. My point is this: you should leave the older version for older phones that cannot update. It’s not fair that I have to go into an actual branch in order to do my banking, which defeats the purpose of the app. I’m lucky that I live in a major metropolitan area that has a café and if I actually happen to be in the area, then it’s OK, but a lot of other people don’t. You guys really need to consider these things when you do the updates and so forth. The whole idea behind an online bank is for the convenience and having to go into the café is not convenient. And, it’s not even a branch it’s just a café with ATMs and some associates to tell you about products, but can’t give you any banking advice.

I had three CapitalOne (CO) credit cards issued by various stores. I decided to keep just one to make it easier to keep track of CapitalOne charges. I had some rewards accumulated on the two cards I was going to close so I contacted CO customer service in April to obtain the rewards and discuss closing the accounts. CO/CS suggested keeping one of the accounts open until the last statement came through because the statement would be coming soon. I did and in May I made sure the balance due was paid and then closed the account. I checked the coded accounts again later and no activity showed so I deleted the account from my CO app. I noticed a hit on my credit report due to unpaid balance on my closed account and called CO/CS again. After a lengthy discussion where I was not given any useable info and a promise to look into it. I asked them to correct my credit report until resolved. Today I got another collection call for the same problem. In the middle of the call the phone went blank after the CS rep said he needed to speak to someone. He did disclose that the overdue charge didn’t show up until 2 months after the account was closed. The charge was called “Transaction Revealed-balance adjustment” but the rep didn’t know what that meant. I think I am still in limbo I’m afraid. I now have late fees on a charge I know nothing about and only found out about the charges when I checked my credit report. Not cool CapitalOne.

reviews.t: Review Capital One Mobile App Service Response From An Actual Person
reviews.x: I’m very satisfied with the overall performance of Capital One mobile banking platform. The mobile and web applications are exceptionally, intuitive, secure, and efficient, making every transaction and account management remarkably efficient. However the only drawback I have encountered is not being able to reach a live representative when more complex or personalized assistance is needed. While automated systems handle basic inquiries well, the process of connecting with an actual associate can be time consuming and frustrating and constant disconnections have happened. Improved accessibility to human support would be an added convenience to an already successful banking system. Thank you.

I recently was traveling out of town, using my so-called premium Venture card out of town and made a $300 purchase as a local Target store. My card was decline for “fraud”. I was told to provide my license, & personal information to prove my identity. After getting off the line and doing all that , the card was yet again declined with more than enough funds on the card . I was then told that they needed to further validate my identity by me providing a utility bill and passport. I’m an out of town and can’t provide that documentation. This was so frustrating and embarrassing having to deal with this in the store. After managing to get that information, they told me it would take 10 business days to validate my account. This is the worst experience I have ever had with a premium product in addition to very bad customer service. NOT PREMIUM AT ALL. This experience ruined my trip for a minor 300$ purchase so called “TRAVEL” card. Worst experience ever.

Dear Capital One Customer Service, I am writing to address a critical and urgent issue regarding my two restricted credit card accounts ending in 8755 and 5848. Over a week ago, I initiated a wire transfer from my Bank of America account to fully pay off and close both of these credit cards. I have confirmation from Bank of America that the funds were successfully sent and delivered to Capital One's account. Despite this, I have been informed that the payments have not been posted to my accounts. As a direct result of this failure to post the payments, both of my accounts are now showing as "currently restricted" (as seen in the attached screenshot), and most alarmingly, this situation has negatively impacted my credit history (my FICO Score has dropped to 514, as also seen in the screenshot).

To be honest, I’m very irritated with Capital One. The last six months it has been nearly impossible to access my funds. I have called in multiple times to figure out why I can never access my funds, why months after I updated my address and requested a new debit card. I have received nothing in the mail. I’ve tried to go in person to withdraw money and denied because of not having a physical identity on me. Even though I had a hard copy of Social Security and birth certificate, as well as photocopies of passport, license and much more on my phone. The best three or four months I’ve truly considered closing out with capital one. Which is unfortunate because when I started banking with them, everything was much more user-friendly and felt much more personable. Now everything is automated. With more automation comes more confusion. As well as longer wait times to Handle issues. I hope that Capital One takes these reviews seriously. Then proceeds to make changes that are more customer friendly.

Three separate occasions I’ve tried depositing three separate checks through the mobile app and it’s given me a hard time, stating it was “having trouble reading the numbers on the front of the check.” It’s always taken a few tries, and sometimes trying on a different day, for the deposit to go through. This time I’ve tried ten times, with different dark backgrounds, the best light I can get, trying auto capture (which didn’t work at all and kept having an error), taking close up, further back, being super careful to have every part of the check be in focus, but the app is still “having trouble reading the numbers on the front of the check”. In the past i thought maybe it was the handwriting. This check is bank-generated and printed in extremely readable numbers from a bank printer. So the problem isn’t with my check, it’s with the app. I also tried getting help with “Eno”, the chatbot. That was a total waste of time. The only thing it seems capable of doing is providing information that is otherwise available on the app, like balances and transaction information. I still don’t have my check deposited nearly a whole day later, so I am seriously considering opening a bank account with a different bank because my only other option is to drive more than an hour to their nearest café. Although, I guess if you aren’t actually planning to try and deposit checks through the mobile app, it’s a perfectly adequate banking app.

reviews.t: App is so slow and gives so many errors for Tavel
reviews.x: This app is terrible I can’t believe I’m paying a $95 dollar fee for this. I regret getting this credit card so much!!! I wasted 50 mins on customer support only to be told there is nothing they can do to fix their own website/system. When searching for flights you have to wait so long for the page to load. If you’re comparing prices be ready to get a pen and paper to write it down because it takes so long it’s unrealistic to just compare prices on the app itself. Also when you go to purchase the flight it gives you an error message and will not let you complete the transaction. I tried reselecting it 6 times for purchase and did the entire process from start to finish several times. I then call the help line for assistance in getting it booked through the phone or have the app fixed - they said if I book it through them over the phone it would be an extra 20% fee. The representative tried to purchase and book it on my behalf she got a similar error on her end. The representative then proceeded to give me recommendations that I should clear my cookies or try back in an hour at this point I was already on the phone for 25 minutes they then transferred me to a manager. I gave the manager the full run down and then she transferred me to technical support. At this point I’ve been on the phone for 35 mins and had to reexplain my issue to each person that I got phone transferred to. The technical support then told me I can use my virtual card to buy things online but I can’t used my virtual card to buy the flight within their website I would need to use the physical card….. here is the crazy part: I can go directly to the airline and book the flight using my virtual card. However, if I purchase it directly through the airline site I won’t get the 5X points per dollar I spend. They transferred me to another representative explained my situation again and they told me there was no override or anything they could do for me due to security reasons at this point I was on the call for 55 mins. I will update this comment if anything changes.

Good service, loved having an account with capital one up until getting red flagged for staying up with my account and keeping it paid up/off. Customer service is 100% foreign based, they required for proof, my statements records, picture of my physical driver license, picture of my physical social security number, my primary bank account routing number, my primary bank account number, my primary bank accounts debit card card number, a literal screenshot of my primary bank accounts routing & account numbers from specifically my personal phone, screenshot of my most recent bank transactions, and a picture of my most recent capital one monthly statements from the mail. Ironically a starting to all be a red flag in itself. WARNING VERY PHISY with the way they operate. And it was their legit contact number I was speaking through. Seemed like they’d been compromised and the phone redirected or something.

Easy to Navigate, When I need to check balance the menus populate quick and smooth. If I do need assistance with anything call them up and they are there pretty much 24/7. Such a dedicated team of service personnel. I wish I can change my ID with my password lol. Great bank 100% online easier to keep movie in there. Lol it is so nice to do business with a Company that does not forget what it is like being human. We fall in to rough times and I appreciate the extra efforts to assist me in saving even a small amount of money by them dropping some fees. Lol it is a comfort knowing that I am not alone in my struggles sometimes, that they understand. A+++++ Service. Lately it has been getting on my nerves because of having to double authenticate myself even on my own device that I always use. Pita.

reviews.t: Capital one app error and customer service terrible
reviews.x: I have been using capital one for 4 years. I tried to make a payment with the same account I always have and the payment was returned. I didn’t understand why so I tried again and it returned the payment again. I then called customer service (awful experience every time) and they said to contact my bank. My bank then said capital one’s system wasn’t pulling from it as normal so I got a different direct account to add to it and the payment went through. I then removed the old account from capital one and add the new one that was successful. I tried to pay my bill the next month and without me noticing the app removed the new account added the old one back and then payment was returned again. I reached out to capital one again and they explain that I tried paying with the same one that was bad last time. I didn’t understand how that happened when I had removed that account and put the new one on but I added the new one back and paid it went through successfully and then I go to check my app next day and it says my account was closed. I called customer service because I was confused was one the phone with them for 50 minutes and transferred to the ‘highest’ they could do I only was transferred once. I was then told it was closed due to fraud because of returned payments. I went through what all I had gone through these last two times and that it’s not my fault their system was pulling incorrect from the account I had used for years. She then said it wasn’t capital one’s fault and that the returned payments were fraud. After back and forth and her explaining the same stuff and I was trying to get transferred to the fraud department that investigated it she told me there was no way they can transfer me because they would have to end the call. This is the worst place that I have ever had to deal with and there system error was then blamed on the customer highly do not recommend banking with capital one.

I was a loyal customer, made all my payments on time, and yet capital one had been by far the worst experience I could ever have. Despite me making my payments on time they charged me a 60$ late fee. One of the many problematic issues this company has. They shut down my account claiming they needed my Tax Id number, a copy of my social security number via Fax mail and etc. after MONTHS of going back and forth back and forth with customer service they claimed they were missing one of the five personal information items they needed they did not receive. Despite me showing proof it was sent I have been still waiting countless and my account is shut off. The rudest customer service you will ever experience out of anybody and after all the stress in switching immediately. I was informed they are currently dealing with financial problems and I hope it causes them to go bankrupt.

They will not protect your checking account from fraudulent purchases and will make you pay them! They do not actually investigate the charges and if you request information on how they came to their decision they will send a four word response that makes no sense and explains nothing and a print out of transactions you can already see on your end which has nothing to do with anything. They might put the money back in your account for a week but then they will deny you and take the money right back. An investigation is supposed to take 3 months, they pretended to do it in 3 days! Then they will tell you to do THEIR JOB and speak to the merchant where the fraudulent purchases were made, completely unlawful. I really liked Capital one at first but this is unbelievably unacceptable and criminal. I don’t usually write reviews unless they are good but this had to be done for the sake of all consumers, please know your rights because capital one is OUT OF CONTROL and if someone else makes charges on YOUR ACCOUNT they will not protect you, they will only pretend to investigate, they will give you no real explanation, and they will make you pay for it no matter what the amount is.

I just wanna say I’m absolutely thankful and grateful that I have my Capital One credit card, this is allowed me with the purchasing power to be more proactive in my life to handle my business and have the overall peace of mind and security that I know that I use my Capital One credit card card for my everyday purchases and I know I’m heavily protected by this group, and like I said, it gives me the purchasing power to move through and get things that I would like to have for myself, and it has created so much opportunity for my business to grow and into work and to expand all from just having the purchasing power of my Capital One credit card I just want to say I’m very thankful. I’m very grateful and thank you for protecting me.

I've banked with Capital One for many years and have always been very happy with them and the app....until recently. I do not understand the logic of making me have to receive a code for two part authentication when I'm signing in with biometrics. It's a little frustrating and makes it take longer to do what used to be super quick. Everything else is still great.

I have been with Capital One mobile banking app and a credit card for quite some time. I went ahead and switched my direct deposit over to them a little over a month ago. The whole reason for wanting to use Capital One was hopefully to build credit and hopefully get my finances going in the right direction. I’m actually planning on switching back to my old bank for direct deposit and look within that bank for credit building tools after going to Capital One and looking at credit cards and it plainly stated that it would not affect my credit score if I was to accept the offer. Lo and behold as soon as I accepted I got a ton of emails stating that my credit score had a hard inquiry. When your bank can’t be trusted who can? I mean everybody else is already lying to you.

I am very happy doing business with Capital One Bank. Unlike other banks I’ve used in the past, Capital One does not charge an overdraft fee if you accidentally go over. It even lets you get gas in an emergency when you are broke. As long as you have at least a dollar in your checking you can fill up by selecting credit at the pump. I always get them the money back asap. I was disappointed when so many Capital One Banks closed on Long Island but being able to use the ATM for free at CVS is a huge plus, even though I prefer to do transactions in-person. I enjoy using the App to transfer money to and from Savings & Checking. It is nice that Savings gives you interest (although an extremely small percentage). The main and really only issue I have with the Bank is that now if you dispute a transaction they automatically deactivate your card and have to wait for a new one. You can’t even go to a Branch to request a temp card. So you are without a card for a little while. Other than that I am very happy with Capital One.

I’ve been using this app since I got my car in 2021. I also have 2 credit cards with them so I check the app regularly. I check it obsessively actually. Whenever I would go into the app, or see the widget, it would show my principal balance at the top in large font, and under the balance it would show the payoff balance in small font. Now it only shows the payoff balance. In order to check my principal balance, I have to scroll down to “Account Details” and scroll all the way to the bottom to see it. I don’t like it. To some it might not be a big deal, but I don’t like change and I find it annoying especially since the payoff balance suddenly doesn’t reflect the balance that’s on my monthly statement. I have been obsessively checking my balance ever since March 2024 when I decided to make additional payments to my principal balance to pay off my auto loan early. I have a note in my notes app that I use to track my balance so I’m not having to go back and forth to the Capital One app and my notes app.

Following my divorce, I set a goal to build my credit back following the damage caused by my former spouses late payments on our shared assets. Capital One Quicksilver gave me a credit limit of $500 and the opportunity to prove I was more than my credit report showed. Within months of making on time payments, Capital One extended my credit limit and has continued to be a partner helping me re-establish myself. The app is very easy to use for account review, scheduling payments, and checking my credit score improvements. I feel the app is secure so my information will always be protected. Thank you to Capital One for providing a great app platform and the opportunity to be a customer.

This app completely blows. The login page is not recognized by my very common password manager. I tried to log in twice, and it threatened to lock me out. indicating I still had a few tries. The one-time password (OTP) sent to my phone was not recognized by my phone as an OTP, so I had to go look at it to fetch it. Now, the app has locked me out. I'm extremely annoyed.

I really want to love Capital One, and there are good things about it, such as higher interest earnings on accounts and ease of transacting and compatibility with other financial institutions. But today is the third time within a few months that my direct deposits are not showing up. They are coming from different sources, so the issue is not with them. I tried to call Capital One, and they have a high call volume, which is not surprising considering I am probably one of many missing my deposits. It is the Monday after July 4th was on a Friday, so there should not be an issue today. I just signed back in one more time before I post this. My money is not there, so I cannot pay my bills. This is my only issue with Capital One, but it is a big issue that has happened multiple times. It is worth noting that my former local credit union never had this issue in my almost 20 years with them.

I’m a person who spends almost 4k monthly on my capital one card, payments on time and I love the card. One day someone was using my card and called customer service and they send me the same card number and after finishing my call with the customer service my war was being use for making purchases again online. In my second call to capital one a representative from India awarded my call and I’m this time I’m so happy with this person because she was able to send me a new card with different numbers, and how I know this? Well I have both card here with me. Sadly I’m planning to not use the card anymore and just leave the account closed on their own to not be affected on my credit. I hope a real member of capital one can see this so they can teach representative to do the right thing at once. My card ends on 5328 same number mailed 2 time. You can’t have a piece of mind like that

This card is great because there are no foreign transaction fees. Customer service is not so great. When overseas, we were depending on this card to pay for our hotels, dining, travel, and other expenses. When I called beforehand to place a foreign travel alert customer service told me it was not necessary. However when we used this card to pay for the hotel, it was denied even with thousands of dollars of available credit and a credit score north of 800. When we called (international call) customer service was of no help and we couldn’t use our Capital One card anywhere on the trip since the company had locked it out. Thats why I give 3 stars.

reviews.t: No more complimentary lounge access and no statement closing date provided in app
reviews.x: Capital One pulled the rug from underneath Venture X cardholders with recent changes to lounge access. I understand taking away complimentary guest access for authorized users, but you went too far when you removed it for the primary cardholder. You have severally devalued your card. Complimentary lounge access for my family was the main reason I even decided to get this card. Now I am considering cancelling it and will definitely not be recommending this card to family or friends. It is very frustrating that Capital One refuses to post your next statement closing date in the app (or website) for credit cards like other banking apps like Citi and Chase do. Especially since the closing date is not the same date every month. For people who closely manage their credit score this incredibly value information and Capital One will not provide. Quite disappointing to say the least.

reviews.t: Ridiculous practices, poor customer service, more.
reviews.x: I changed my billing address while on the phone with a customer service representative who walked me through the process. Within two weeks, my account is restricted because the address change was suspicious; I moved a few miles away. To unrestrict my account, I have to provide a PHOTOCOPY of my license, my social security card, and one other document I couldn’t understand because of the representative’s thick accent. I asked if there were any alternatives and no, there aren’t. I even offered to go to a physical location and be personally identified with my id, nope. Absurd! I refuse to provide sufficient information to entirely steal my identity to a company who has had security breaches in the past. My ID is understandable, but a COPY of my social security card, never. I am irate. I have half a mind to let them close the account due to inactivity. Zero alternatives for a customer that has never been late to pay?!? What can I expect from white collar loan sharks? FYI, they’ve already lost over 100 MILLION Americans personal info in the past.

I used to have an account with Citibank, but I always encountered issues with their service. I switched to Capital One because I had a good experience with their savings account, and I'm really glad I made that choice. With Capital One, I receive notifications for every purchase I make, including those made with my credit card. Even when I buy something online from a place I've never shopped at before, I get a text notification asking me to verify if I made the purchase, which I really appreciate. It gives me a sense of security knowing my account is well-protected. I've shared my positive experience with my wife and friends, and they also love Capital One. Thank you, Capital One, for providing an amazing app experience and excellent services! 👍

reviews.t: Extremely Disappointed - Account Restricted Despite Paid-off Balance
reviews.x: I’m incredibly disappointed with Capital One. Despite having fully paid off my balance, my account was suddenly restricted without proper explanation or warning. I’ve always made an effort to be a responsible customer, and to be treated this way is frustrating and frankly unacceptable. What’s even more upsetting is the lack of transparency and poor communication. I was given no clear reason for the restriction, and each time I try to get answers, I’m met with vague responses and long hold times. It feels like Capital One doesn’t value loyal customers or their financial responsibility. Restricting an account that has been paid in full sends the wrong message and undermines trust. I expected better from a major financial institution. Sadly, I will be reconsidering any future business with Capital One, and I cannot recommend them to anyone looking for reliable or respectful service.

They keep your balance sitting on credit bureaus instead of it continually showing you pay your credit card on time. And they don’t give you more advances. And I still have old card paid off still lingering on credit report so looks like I’m owing them for an old credit card. And if don’t want to put credit up why not another card. I will keep capital one it’s a card that if not using they don’t kill you in crazy fees. But will find a card I can build my credit with since I’m working on buying a home. Need positive credit history. And when I call I get someone from South America who doesn’t understand and unsure how to help. And they can’t connect me with someone that can. Tried supervisor but they couldn’t help as well. I see I still have an issue with a payment I called because never received merchandise and still sitting on my account and never heard anything about it. But he turned my card off and I see my virtual card isn’t on my app so couldn’t order doggie pads from Walmart and that makes life hard because I’m waiting on 2 total knee replacement surgeries and can’t walk well enough to go on my own. Thanks for your time with my venting. God Bless

reviews.t: Great app but widget no longer works properly
reviews.x: The app has been solid for several years but with the most recent update the real-time widget no longer updates dynamically. It correctly shows my balance at some time in the past day or two (with the correct timestamp) and allows me to quickly launch the app by clicking on the widget but the balance doesn't update reliably. It doesn't help me to know what my balance was yesterday if something has changed today, and my main use case for the widget is to track any unexpected changes. It worked fine until the most recent update. I have tried rebooting my iPad and even uninstalling and re-installing the app but the problem persists. My other widgets work fine so it isn't an iPad issue.

Growing up in the culture I grew up in, that being African-American there’s a lot of things that was not privy to us. Financial literacy being one, is something that I am unfortunately still trying to learn at a later stage (age) in my life. capital one is one the leading credit card creditors, and lender because of the trust and willingness to risk working with Impoverished areas and/or people. I wish you had a more of a humane personal communication with the customer service to keep them up-to-date and engaged with my personal credit even if it’s through AI. When you canceled my line of credit for all my cards for reasons I couldn’t understand causing a major setback in my life after losing over 70 points because of that one single action but if I had received a text message a phone call or notification when I open the app it would’ve been easily preventable. I felt like the Capital One failed me and helped continue setting me up for the systematic failure. Im am glad I been given many offers to join once again but really wish when I had called to try to reinstate myself and correct insufficient amounts payment amounts I was making you had done so then.

I opened a Capitol One account originally to get a secured credit card to start rebuilding my credit, and it has not transitioned into one of my primary banking apps. The savings account interest is fantastic! You get free money letting your money sit in a savings account, that is pretty awesome to me. I also get cash back using my quicksilver secured credit card which is a major bonus. The app is very easy to use, it runs smooth, and feels professional. Overall, I really do enjoy banking with Capitol One and I'm extremely grateful that they gave me an opportunity to get a secured credit card with them. I give my experience with Capitol One a 10/10. Thank you Capitol One 🙏🏼

I have applied a new card for the registration I got the otp once, then when I try to active my virtual card I am not getting otp it says my number is invalid or not an US number. I tried with husband number, again an error pops up. I tried to call customer service they didn’t do anything. I thought let me try after getting the physical card, I got my card I opened the app to activate. It said my account is restricted, it tried after 2days it is still the same. I called the customer support and after an hr or so they told me that I will get an email with the link to upload my documents, I told them okay even though I already uploaded my drivers license in the app earlier. I was waiting for days I haven’t received any email. I called the customer support again this time a very nice lady said the same thing I need to upload the documents and sent me the email with link to upload as I am still in call as I requested. Then after uploading the documents she said they still need more time to verify the details. It’s more than 1 week I still haven’t received any update from them. It still shows my account is restricted. Changed my whole opinion of banking experience how I wish I hadn’t applied for this card. This is the worst banking experience I ever had with any of the banks. How I wish I could praise other banks for their user friendly services and not giving us a rise in blood pressure thinking about their services. And lastly I would advise you to do your verification before issuing a card rather than issuing it and giving us an bad impression on the banking system

reviews.t: Fraud department had never heard of th dark web. Found out thru their app that my ss was compromised
reviews.x: So with that said, I’ve been victim of identity theft so many times I can’t count them all and as soon as the problem seems to be resolved, they allow the exact same fraudulent companies to charge my new card. Would think in this day and age they would know how to block companies I’ve already said had no authority to charge my account. But the whole - “not knowing the dark web existed” as I’m asking advice from someone in the fraud department??? Scary …. told me a lot. That’s insane in my opinion. Some more training needs to happen esp being that it was yals website that alerted me to the fact that my social was being compromised. Just bizarre.

reviews.t: Gave me a chance when nobody else would
reviews.x: Thank you capital one for being the only credit card company to give me a chance when everybody else denied me. I now have a personal and a business credit card and my credit score is much higher, and I’ve been able to get credit cards with other companies since Capital One allowed me the opportunity to build credit. Of all my cards, these cards update the available credit the fastest, which is super helpful. They also don’t charge refyurned payment fees, which has been a lifesaver as well (mistakes happen.) if there was a local branch near me, I’d definitley choose them for checking and savings accounts too! Thank you

I've been a dedicated Capital One customer for many years and can say with all confidence it is the best, most transparent and compassionate credit card and banking company there is. Over many years I have dealt with all of the big ones and some of the small, such as my credit union, and none of them can compare to the level of customer service, interest rates both paid and earned, as well as the willingness to work with you when life hits hard. By the Grace of God I have been able to pare down my credit accounts, and am getting ready to do it again. Capital One has been, and hopefully will be, the only one that I want to always continue doing business with.

i got divorced and couldn’t afford to pay the bills. it’s finally been 7 years and went to capital one went to secured card.. for $200 they only required $49. But it can be anywhere from $49-$200 deposit i guess it depends on credit. And once payments are made on time that money you deposited eventually gets credited. Just go do secured card first! then just give it a few moments and the store cards like Like kohl’s, victoria secret or bath n body work will approve you.. then you may want to check out getting a secured loan, because different types of credit helps raise credit score, so you need more than just credit cards no matter how high the limits are.

I have two credit cards and a bank account/savings accounts account through them. I’ve never had any issues. There was an issue with their 3rd party direct deposit issuer and they not only paid any late fees you accumulated with said issue (outside banks you work with) but they also waved any fees you’d have with them if you were unable to make a payment due to the system issue. They are very vigilant in regards to fraud so if you are going to make a big purchase out of state I’d inform them. Customer service is great also, I haven’t had an encounter with a rep that was rude or unable to help yet. So they are very quick to resolve issues/concerns you may have.

My wife and I have co-managed our finances for 15 years, but just recently Capital One blocked our accounts and told us we were “mismanaging” our accounts by sharing our logins, which we only did because Capital One did not permit us to add our accounts to each other‘s profiles (we had previously called several times, trying to remedy this issue, with no success). In addition, we have had our capital one travel credit card spontaneously blocked while overseas, which meant we could not check into a hotel late night for example, and verification required a text message to a US phone, which we did not have access to because we were traveling. We were also told that if we share logins or log in from too many devices, our accounts will be closed, and that they are monitoring us, big brother-style. Ridiculous, stupid, counterproductive security protocols that just make life difficult without adding any security at all.

It’s very discouraging to see that for as long as this firm has been around they still practice a 1990’s form of banking when payments are made to settle some or all credit limits. Especially when the payment is deducted from one’s own bank account almost instantly from the banks side and Capital One has the date scheduled for that day.. and yet it’s not processed into one’s own account under the guise of them stating it’s your own banks doing; knowing very well it’s not. In fact it’s Capital One’s own doing and they likely are doing so to gain more of an APR interest and not allowing their clients to cash in on it with their credit scores. Waiting 3 days is of the old; majority of all banks use electronic banking systems which allows funds to be transferred for payment or reimbursement instantly or with no longer than a 12hr waiting period to see it posted provided the time of day it goes through.
