I made a payment at 10am and that’s well before the end of day cut off for such a minimal waiting period to observe any transaction and here it is my bank approved it instantly and yet you all are not and it’s been 2 days. You all need to quit laundering money to stay afloat or using the drag time to gain an interest. Because peoples credit scores are subjected to that and reflects a negative record.

I’ve used Capital one for years and I can’t even put into words how much they keep ripping out my bank account balance just on these interest fees… I see them take money for interest fees on both my savings and checking account… and they do it so often that I constantly see my balance decreasing… this is starting to not make me want to even keep my money with this bank because I AM not even SPENDING anything, my money is for example just sitting on my balance and they charge interest fees, I didn’t sign up to keep my money in a bank just for half my money to go towards interest fees?! Then when it comes to filing any dispute with this bank, it’s another issue because customer service is so slow and they don’t help properly, it takes me several agents and so much of wait time on the call, transferring me to so many different departments just for the issue to not get solved, and they say they can’t possible do much. Several times I encountered issues with this bank having glitches and errors where the app didn’t even load some features same with the website but anyways the agents I spoke to about this weren’t even able to solve their own problems!! They said “there’s nothing we can do about this” is it my fault that the app and website has so many glitches and errors?! NOW let’s continue the dispute part because I’ve had to file several disputes with this bank and one of them the agent said it could take up to 1 month to hear back from the dispute, 1 month is a ridiculous amount of time. I was given no other choice or help so I waited one month and I received NO UPDATE!! So I called them again and they said up to 3 months for this dispute to resolve. And it took 3 months of waiting just for them to say “we weren’t able to resolve the dispute as we can’t processed further and there’s nothing else we can do about it” and same issue with my other dispute, waiting 1 month and they told me they weren’t able to resolve and continue further. These cases are serious and they weren’t even able to help. It’s a bank I’m dealing with, so I expect more trust and better support, but this bank doesn’t seem to be giving that.

The app/website is trash, DO NOT get this card even though it seems smart and has lots of advantages. The thing with me is that I have been trying for more than 3 weeks now to buy flight tickets and everytime I reach the final buying part, it displays an error message “Uh oh, sorry. Something went wrong”. During this period of time the card acceps the payment and then it reverses it into your account cancelling that purchase. It has been so frustrating because now flights are more expensive than 3 WEEKS AGO! I keep calling the support number and they are completely useless and they just want to transfer you to every department they can think of to get rid of you. After being teansferred to a new department they also want to transfer you back because they do not know how to handle this situation. They even told me that they have no report of this issue but if you google this you find tons of articles and people complaining about this issue which if I would have read them I would NOT have bought this card. This is a 0 star review and I do not know how this app has tons of good reviews with this type of issues.

reviews.t: Limit is not based on credit score or usage
reviews.x: I have had Capital one for over 18 years. Obviously my credit score, understanding of credit and usage has changed over the years, capital one has not. I utilize my credit in a responsible manner, maintain an account balance, while utilizing the recommended less than 30 percent, but that isn’t always a good thing for creditors. They will not give you an increase in your credit limit, even if you maintain a reasonable balance (under 30% of your limit) or pay it off completely every month, even while making 25 times what the allotted maximum credit limit is with a less than 8 percent yearly income payment to a mortgage. They will refer you to the “letter sent”, “underutilization” of credit extended, while utilizing a healthy use of the credit extended to you. However, they will tell you if you utilize 90%, you are eligible for an increase. This is the only credit card company/ bank that has ever declined an increase. Every other credit or banking institution has extended credit to me with my exceptional credit score, without inquiry. It’s no wonder I won’t “utilize” them as i do any other financial institution. They deserve to go bankrupt, worst credit company I’ve ever seen. Capitol one prays on those that don’t have any bit or credit worthiness and will extend it to them to control you or make you bankrupt. But if you’re smart, they will decline and sent you to collections with the quickness. F capital one and the world bankers.

reviews.t: Scam with the Earn $45 Downloading Capital One Shopping App
reviews.x: Scam. You basically have to give up all of your privacy. And after an hour worth of clicking, you still don’t have your $45 and you’ve authorized Safari to do a bunch of stuff that they shouldn’t and you’ve downloaded apps an authorized and accepted things that you shouldn’t. It keeps on telling you that you have one more thing to do before you get your $45. You do it all and you still don’t get it. One final thing that makes you turn on all notifications and then go onto Safari and put that capital one has access to everything. Then the one final thing that you got to do in order to get just $25 if you have to download the app to your personal computer at home. Whatever happened to the $45 now at the end of this whole thing you’re telling me $25. This is a scam. I downloaded the app and went through all this for a scam. Capital one was good now they’re really shady

I was very excited to a Capital One Venture card. Unfortunately, I made the mistake of linking their “creditwise” product, which promptly pulled INCORRECT information from my credit report (wrong name, wrong address) and applied it to my credit card account. I have no idea why or how this happened, and while I know this ultimately is an error with a credit agency, after calling capital one customer service, I could not change the information back and had to just close the account. So my beef is with creditwise, but the capital one app is CRAMMED with spam for this product, amongst other things they will try to upsell. I also got a lot of errors in the app (probably because they messed up my account info) and couldn’t do basic things like access my account number or virtual card, even after multiple calls to customer service. Super disappointing.

I discovered my account had been breached through plaid and someone was able to take $100 on three different occasions for my savings regular strategically once a month on my third pay cycle as I get paid weekly and when I would transfer the largest amount into my savings so I wouldn’t notice because I use two other banks but capital one has always been my main one. I never really pay attention too much into my savings transactions. Just my checking. I discovered this at 4:55 PM called was on the phone with an agent by 4:57 PM. She was very kind and professional and honest she told me that she couldn’t promise that. It would be handled right away. They had to conduct investigation and average wait time for disputes 4-6 business days. Being that it’s Friday the end of the month I was a little bummed out. As a 30 year old male with a mortgage 2 car payments and 2 kids $500 is $500. I was bracing myself to get home and let my wife know that we don’t share finances be the more irresponsible one even though I earned a little bit more check my emails the light right before my cul-de-sac and I have one from Capital One tell me my dispute were settled and the full amount plus another hundred I didn’t know I had missing. I have never before seen a bank me with the speed on a Friday afternoon. Let me know they truly value my business. I will be closing my other two accounts and sticking to capital one from here they more than earned my business. Thank you.

Capital one does not care about the little guy… living pay check to paycheck and having access to to your own money means nothing to them… I deposited my payroll check into my savings account by accident on the app and they refused to transfer it to my checking account or release the funds so that I had access to to the funds, they refused to cancel the check and return it so I may deposit it at another bank . Instead they placed a 5 day hold on my funds and they did not care how long I banked with them payed my bills or didn’t have any check issues… as well as two previous times before that they placed a fraud hold on my payroll check for no reason and had me embarrass myself blaming my job and their bank when capital one was the issue and there was no reason for it… when they release my funds I will be banking elsewhere as they don’t deserve my business. since I don’t hold millions of dollars at their bank I’m just another cog in the wheel… if you want your money a week after you deposit or unreasonable holds placed on your money please bank here…

For at least a few months now, something changed in the way the app has handled notifications, and not for the better. Two main issues I have: 1) Purchase notifications used to remain (if not manually dismissed) on the lock screen for 7 days before going away. Now, on average, they only stick around for 3-4 days max before disappearing. I used these notifications for budgeting purposes and having them for a full week was extremely helpful as I update my budget weekly. Now I have to rely on text notifications instead. 2) Gas purchases in particular never show up anymore in either the lock screen notifications or the text notifications. They used to show up on both, but now the only place you can find gas purchases is by looking at your actual transaction history. This often throws me off when updating my budget because I’ll forget about recent gas purchases and won’t notice until my budget is off. Then I gotta go hunt for the purchase in my transaction history. This isn’t limited to one specific gas station brand; it happens no matter where I buy gas. What happened? There never used to be a problem with this before. The app itself is fine and useful for the other things one would need it for, but Capital One’s notification game is severely lacking as of late.

reviews.t: Still no notifications for debit transactions
reviews.x: update more years later. total disaster. half a gig for what should be a 70MB app. obvious Southwest Asia coding ------- update even many more years later. more pig app than ever. About every other time I want to use this, have to update again, HUGE PITA. Who got the huge bonuses for the brilliant idea of outsourcing the programmers and firing the competent people? --------- Update, years later: this app is becoming a bloated pig. 230MB really? Constantly needs updating for no new functionality, etc. ------- original review below ------- Sad that the old Wallet functionality, that pushed debit transactions immediately to my phone, still hasn't been rolled into this app, nearly a year after Wallet was discontinued. Now I have to check constantly to make sure my debit card hasn't been skimmed. Credit card transactions are pushed. Why can't debit card transactions be sent to notifications too?

I’ve had Capital One for several years now and I’ve never had any issues with the app until this last month. When they started having issues with an outside source and not getting bills paid or direct deposits taken care of. It seems like ever since then the app has had issues. Now my biggest problem is not being able to use the mobile deposit. Every time it “auto captures” the check it gives me an error message that it’s having issues reading the numbers on the front of the check. Or it tells me that what I’m trying to take a picture of is not a check but will still auto capture the pic. I have called and talked to customer service and they even suggested that I do the manual capture instead of the auto capture. Other than that, they can’t help me with the app because they have no access to it. I’ve tried manual capture and that doesn’t change the error message. There are no branches or ATMs that I can deposit this amount of money into my account. I can only deposit $999 a day with a maximum of $5000 a month at Walgreens. I have an uncommon amount for us and now I’m looking at having to open another checking account with a local branch just to cash my checks and pay my bills.

My first app review - and not sure what could be better or easier than this app. The fact that I can make a payment and the credit is available immediately is sooo helpful. Only one thing I ask - I appreciate regular updates especially for security purposes - but if there’s a way the developers could do what other apps do when there is a new update and allow you to skip it with a “Not Now” because I’ve been in many situations where I need to use the app right away while running around and can’t get an update. It would be helpful to be able to wait to updated when back on WiFi but still be able to use the app.

Do not expect any intelligent or helpful customer support from Capital One if you ever have a problem with your account. I bought a watch from Citizen through the Capital One app which promised a rebate from Capital One. The rebate never showed up in the account. I have spent hours over multiple calls with multiple customer service agents and escalation from one department to another getting absolutely nowhere. Nonsensical responses to simple questions, refusal to provide any email address or postal address to write to to explain the complaint and seek resolution. Their only channel for customer support is telephone and their call centers are staffed with people who know nothing and cannot solve problems. This is the second time I’ve gone down a rabbit hole with Capital One only to find that they have zero integrity and no interest in dealing honestly with their cardholders. I will no longer be using this card. They have lost a loyal customer.

Earlier this week, a Capital One representative told me that my bank account could be used if I applied funds to it, even though it hasn’t been used in a while. Once I add funds the account would become current. I took their advice and had my direct deposit sent to that account. However, after the deposit, I found out that the account was permanently unusable. This misleading information caused a lot of inconvenience, as I had to open a new account. ANOTHER representative made it seem like everything was fine and dandy and that they could transfer the funds as well as the previous debit card . A LIE! Calling Sure thing! On Wednesday morning, a Capital One representative told me that my charged-off bank account could be used if I applied funds to it. I took their advice and had my direct deposit sent to that account. However, after the deposit, I found out that the account was permanently unusable. This misleading information caused a lot of inconvenience, as I had to open a new account and now have to wait three days for the transfer to happen. It’s really frustrating to be misled like this, especially when it involves my finances.

reviews.t: Glitch in the app affecting unlocking my card
reviews.x: I’ve genuinely enjoyed banking through Capital One and haven’t had issues until recently. I prefer to keep my debit card locked when not in use to avoid charges I’m not prepared for. This morning I opened the app to unlock my card and discovered that a new card was issued since mine is expiring next month. Then I discovered that the app no longer recognizes that my current card is active and won’t allow me to unlock/lock it. The customer service was unusually rude acting like this was my fault for having the card locked and told me there is nothing I can do until the card comes. I want the app developers to be aware of this issue, since I know simply notating it on the customer service level won’t report the issue. This happened on my payday just a few weeks after having my check delayed due to the capital system failure. These issues are making me second guess using Capital One as my main bank. With the card locked the only way I can access my money is through ACH transfers since I’m not near a branch.

I’ve got a checking acct. and a savings acct. with Capital One. I’ve paid off a $16,000 auto loan completely and have paid off about half of a $35,000 car loan. I have two credit cards with Capital One. It’s safe to say, I use Capital One for a lot. I recently needed two cashiers checks because I was moving out of state and in to an apartment. The first check came on time, which was the next day. The second check was supposed to be overnighted as well and arrive on a Tuesday. I had to move out that Saturday so I thought I had plenty of time, because I paid for it to be overnighted. The check did not arrive before I moved out. It showed up after 7 days. When I called Capital One to ask them to void the check and return my money because the check was now useless as I was now one state away and needed to get yet another cashiers check, they told me they couldn’t do that. They said that I had to mail the original check back and then I would receive my funds once Capital One received the returned yet but that I had to pay out of my own pocket to mail the check back. My mom was able to track down the check and mail it back for me. It cost $40. Now I am out $40 to mail a check back that was one week late due to no fault of my own when I paid for and was promised that it would be overnighted. I was about to get out a third car loan but now I’m rethinking about going with a different loaner. Do better, Capital One.

Capital One advertises the no credit limit and it’s a farce and is no good for business use. Starting off I charge the card for large amounts that I pay off every month. The card is supposed to learn my spending habits yet it shuts my card down at random times without and heads up. I would rather have just a hard limit so I know how much room I have to charge versus being surprised. Customer Service explained that if I needed to charge something big I could run a pre-approval. What a joke. I don’t have time for that. I’m not very happy with this card at all and will likely switch. Just give me a credit limit that I can monitor myself!

I have been a Capital One client for just over four years. I always wondered why my daughter put even her groceries on her credit card, and then she explained that she actually earned cash back for doing so. Now I charge just about everything I purpose and then pay off my bill at the end of the month so I never pay interest. I am eating about a thousand dollars a year! This year I used my rewards to help with Christmas. Some years I use it for travel. Another great thing about Capital One is the discounts you can get at hundreds of stores. The exact percentages vary from place to place. I have recommended Capital one to several of my friends and acquaintances.

Ive never really had an issue with the mobile app, this is more of an issue with the capital one product itself. I use credit wise from time to time because some of the features are free such as viewing credit score and credit simulation. Each day, the credit wise section in the app shows a warning saying it hasn’t been updated since the previous day if you haven’t looked at it for more than a day. It says “see your new score” implying there has been an actual update even if there hasn’t. I feel they’re just trying to get as much data from your report as possible. I can also see that each time I update credit wise, there is a soft inquiry on my credit report. I just wish companies wouldn’t engage in deceptive practices like this, but I guess their bottom line is more important than building trust with customers.

I have accounts at BoA and Chase, both personal and business and Capital One’s app and website capabilities are way below standard comparatively. There is no Zelle feature for small business accounts. The help chat does not work, even when you select from their menu of prompts it doesn’t work. In the app you can’t pay a bill, so it takes you to the website via safari, and then I get an error message and need to try again. And the setup was painful, I added to users to the account and they were taken to an account that wasn’t ours! Only resolved after calling them multiple times. Then tried to add the debit card to my Apple Pay…surprise surprise it didn’t work! Then because one of my main vendors don’t use Mastercard I have to pay from a different account altogether. This is the most frustrating service by far. I haven’t ever written an app review, but they earned this and need to act like they care about their service! Hope their CTO reads this!

CapitalOne has made no effort to rectify this issue not processing payments, myself included. The hardship is now going to cost me so much more than the late fees for bounced bills. Without gas to get to work it will effectively force me to be fired from 2 careers, with a value of benefits and retirements from 2 different places. That is over a million in losses. I am a single parent missing my daughters birthday, which is what absolutely is the worst part of this, which i cant put a price on. Its Ruining my relationship with my kids. The outrageous hold times and 3rd party excuses with these people being given scripts are doing nothing to resolve this massive issue (and i dont blame them.) and I hate to complain because I know i am not alone. CapitalOne: what are you going to do to fix this? To cover me for the hardships you are causing me? To cover me for the massive financial loss this is causing me? And to pay the people that need the money they work so hard to earn? I am seeking further assistance from several additional resources. I suggest everyone else do the same.

Move your money if and when you can! Didn’t get my direct deposit on Thursday. Had to go to “X” to find out that Capital One had an outage. “Technical issues with their third party services.” Was given the ring around for hours. Then when given an ETA of “throughout the day and tomorrow morning (Friday) majority of the issues would be resolved.” It’s now Friday, January 17th at 1:50PM(CST) and my husband and I STILL haven’t received our direct deposit paychecks. We can’t use our debit cards, cant move money to a different bank, can’t receive money either. Our livelihood is at a complete standstill and late fees are now piling up due to their inconvenience. No emails have been sent out to update us on what’s going on. Only way I know is by going on “X” and checking news articles through Google. This is absolutely unacceptable and we will be using a different bank. I filed a complaint with the FDIC last night. It’s a holiday weekend so if the issue isn’t resolved today then we all face the consequences of waiting till Tuesday when “business hours” resume. They claim they’re working “round the clock” but nothing has changed and everyone is getting zero help from calling this company for answers.

They don’t offer fraud protection I had a debit and credit card with them. Had fraud on each account for a total of 200 dollars. They offer you a credit then take it away in a few weeks. They ask for ridiculous amounts of proof you didn’t buy something and make you upload it through their “secure” link but it never works. I called several times to explain their doc upload tool is not working (tried multiple ways and types of documents pdf jpeg etc) and they did not help at all. Crazy part is I actually got the merchant to refund me for a car rental they didn’t have ready when I showed up to pick it up but since I booked through Expedia the refund went to them and they Expedia refused to give it to me. Simple case of a charge back I didn’t rent the car they make it so difficult. If you ever carry a balance calculate the interest yourself it’s amazing how they always find a way to have you at the highest interest rate possible I had a few thousand in debt paid over 2,000 my monthly interest fee went from $150 down to $141. How can I pay off majority of my balance and my interest rate goes down 9 dollars? Ask capital one even though my credit it 700 I’m now at the highest interest rate possible try to negotiate they give you the run around reps are rude. I can’t believe how bad they are had to waste my time writing this review

App is broken. Can't report fraud, can't get a replacement card, just an error message and a phone number. They want you want to spend hours on hold trying to fix an issue that should take 30 seconds in the app. It's inexcusable to have such an important security feature be unavailable for months! I've locked my capital one account and will no longer be using this bank. Every other bank can resolve these issues instantly through an app or website, forcing customers to sit on hold is unacceptable

reviews.t: My Card Travel Card of Choice
reviews.x: I have had Capital One for more than a decade and it continues to be my primary card. I originally got the card for traveling abroad as they offered $0 fees for foreign currency exchanges while other cars gouged their customers. After that I just kept using it. I have had my credit card info stolen and had fraudulent charges abound but they always helped me through it. The app itself has been easy to use and kept up with the times. I don’t use them for banking but to compare the two, it seems the app is well ahead of the competition. The app works for almost every thing you need and rarely do you need to redirect to their website or 800# to get further assistance.

reviews.t: Early warning third party screening for this huge bank??
reviews.x: I recently was screened by Capital One to apply for a checking account, been a customer for a credit card for 12 years and a money market for 5 years. I applied and I was rejected so I was like, excuse me, so I called and I was told my information didn’t match (despite my 12 year relationship with them already and having a money market with them for 5 years). I was just told sorry we can’t help you your information doesn’t match what we have in our records. No explanation at all. I filed a BBB complaint for an explanation and I received a letter, not a call stating that Capital One uses early warning third party screening and that I needed to clear it out with them and that it takes a while to get things resolved but I was welcome to reapply once I fix my issues with them. A big bank such as Capital One using a company I’ve never heard from and I have to share all my personal information with them so I can get my record straightened because they might’ve made a mistake? This sounds like a third party collecting information to sell to someone else later, it’s ridiculous that this bank thinks so little of customers that they don’t have their own department to screen their own customers, not potential customers, actual customers. So disappointed and won’t do business with them again. Only reason I’m leaving my credit card open is because you’re not supposed to close your oldest credit card.

Recently i was scammed out of $5000 of merchandise I purchased for someone I had met online and thought we had a great relationship going. She had her accountant give me her bank info to pay me back the $5K. I did so and made the payment but it was rejected (naturally). My account was then restricted since she would not talk to customer service. I tried explaining everything and paid the card off with my own money but they were not budging, they needed to talk to her. She wouldn't comply. I was sent a letter saying if I didn't respond within 30 days the account would be closed. I made copies of text messages and wrote a lengthy letter explaining it all. They closed my account and when I called they said they never got any reply. Big business strikes again. I've used this account for years and was my go to card for all purchases and it was paid off every month. This is the thanks I get for being a good customer and getting scammed! Thanks for nothing Capital One!

My special needs daughter received a settlement check from a car accident after almost 2 years. I opened a joint account and took her to the branch on Friday to deposit the check. The receipt indicated she would receive part of the money the next business day which was Monday. On Monday, the app indicated the partial deposit was available but the money was not available in the account so I called customer service. The rep didn’t want to tell me why the deposit wasn’t available and insisted I have my daughter call. I had my daughter call on 3 way during my lunch break and the next rep was even more unreasonable. He told my daughter in an unkind tone, “You’re 19 and an adult, if you don’t hang up on your mother, I will end this call!” My daughter was so upset she hung up on me and the rep after we waited for 10 minutes to speak to someone. After work we went to the branch and waited again because it was packed. The rep put us on the phone again after putting some notes in the system. The rep on the phone asked my daughter if it was ok to speak to me and se said yes. He transferred me to yet another rep and after asking some security questions informed us that all the funds were now on hold for an even longer time than before. She apologized for everything but said there’s nothing she could. My daughter is so upset she can’t purchase the tablet she wanted before going back to school. Not good customer service at all!

reviews.t: Not backing me on a credit card purchase
reviews.x: I would really love this card. I’m still gonna give it a five however, I was in Europe. I was scanned by a bus company. They could have converted my ticket for the new ride time. They said they couldn’t do it because the Internet was not working. I paid them cash to get on the bus. They told me I could get my refund later when the Internet was working. I could not check anything because my Internet was not working. I’ve called Capital One multiple times to help me. They refused to give me my money back other than that this would be an awesome card. I can’t understand why a $92 fee for the money I put through on this card & they won’t honor it and refund my money. If they had done that and wrote a letter, then the bus company would talk to their employees about taking cash from customers lying, saying we could get our money back on the purchase tickets through the Internet. If they will not back me in Europe I don’t think I can take the card with me over there again. Because there’s always an issue when you’re traveling overseas people try to scam you. It sure would be nice if Capital one would help issues like this it would make awareness instead of the sweeping it under the table.

When I was first getting started in life I had a wife an a stepson had my own place paying for it with my own money. Well I didn’t have any credit established and was needing to work on it. I had something in mind I was wanting to buy so I call my step dad up and ask hey would you care to cosign for me a loan so I can start building credit? The man’s answer was you don’t need that. Just honesty acted like I would not pay it basically didn’t want to give me a chance. So I was bummed out about it got on the internet and found capital one credit. I believe at first it was like I paid them $100 and I borrowed from that 100 to build trust then it went to $300 credit and so on an on if it weren’t for capital one giving me the opportunity to help establish some credit I’d still not have any at all Although as long as iv been with you guys you could drop my rate down just a jag ☺️

Advice & Help for beginners who never learned how to handle your credit responsibility: A) 1st charge you make, Pay off in full before due date. B) 2nd charge allow interest to accumulate over 3 month payoff. C) 3rd charge pay off in full. D) 4th charge pay off over 3 months so interest can accumulate again. E) Credit scores will go up because you showed you are responsible in such a short time but could handle the interest that accumulated too. Usage theory; 1) Prove you are responsible. 2) Never use more than 15% of your total limit available. Never! Credit cards are not for high usage unless it’s for a business. Keeping in mind the limit to ratio usage. 3) Show you have self discipline & control even if you needed more, you didn’t use it. 4) Credit scores will continue to rise. 5) Keep in mind, I used to have $35K in personal credit before exuberant health charges placed me in bad debt. Once I paid my debt off, I rebuilt my credit at the same time. 6) I never defaulted on my debts, I never ignored my debts, I never went bankrupt, (because it’s wrong period!) 7) Communicate to your creditor, they work w/you. 8) Creditor’s will always see your background of amount of credit, write off’s or bankruptcies, even after 30 years. That will hurt your scores forever. 9) Don’t blow off debts. Pay in smaller amounts if needed. 10) Creditors can do wonders for you if you are not more than 6 months behind and honest. 11) I rate the APR on the SILVER PLATINUM card horrible but the improvement on my credit score is excellent. 12) Be RESPONSIBLE and the creditor WILL BE VERY GOOD TO YOU in return. Good fortune to all snd I hope this will help those who need it.

I paid my balance off, the funds went out of my account to cover and I got a message that the payment was declined. I made another payment, so it wouldn’t be late, and again, it took the funds out of my account. However, capital one put the funds on hold and wouldn’t release them for a week and a half and after several Calls and misinformation I was told you had to send me a paper check for what over paid and it would take 10 days. So, already I have waited a week and a half, I haven’t had an available credit and now I have to wait 10 days to get back the money you owe me. I need that money, I feel like I have been robbed and it’s the holidays and it totally messed up being able to do the holidays for my family. Holding someone’s funds, especially after confirming with the bank they were covered, is unethical and bad practice. I am very very dissatisfied with capital one.

If we’re being honest, dealing with credit card, companies is more often than not an unpleasant experience but I can say without any question that my experience with having 3 different Capital One cards and the company as a whole over the past 10 years has been a pleasant one and problem free. They have always treated me well, been fair, respected me as a customer more than any card I’ve ever owned. They have not unfairly judged my credit worthiness (as all other companies do) based on any other factor other than my history and record with them. If I had to get rid of every credit card, but one, I would 100% keep my capital one card!

Such a hard time I have been having. Come to find out they did get my checks for separate cards. One is paid and the other one, after multiple calls, HOURS on the phone with them and the certified mail I paid extra for, they cashed the checks and I’m still trying to find out why one is not posted to my account. So frustrating. I’m not rich, it is necessary for a home refinance, and it’s been weeks and I’m still not sorted out. I have gone out of my way and contacted all parties, I have told u who signed for both packages, who I found from 2 sources of delivery, and it comes down to u all. So terrible I have been doing all this run around and like I said 3 weeks ago, it is on your side yet I am required to contact multiple groups while u do not accept any responsibility. I have the work id numbers, the other parties contacts that I have talked to, pictures of checks, receipts from mailing, everything. What else can I do?

I’ve had my card for 10 years. I had a balance close to 5or6 thousand never late once. I paid off balance 0 on November 28 . Which is my due date. And it showed a balance 0. I looked two days later and it showed 95 dollars owed so I called to try to have this removed and after speaking to 3 managers I kept getting treated like they could care less about helping me and said no they could not remove this 95 dollars it was not possible. After I just paid off thousands of dollars and have been a customer for many years! And not to mention on many months of paying my due payment on the due date 28th I’ve noticed that after being paid on my he 28 due date the next day on many bills there is a late charge. Now get this shot I paid on the due date always and on many months on my he 29 you charge me a late fee and she said because it as fate a certain time! Lolol now think about this. If there is a time it should be midnight not 5 in the afternoon and second if I have a due date and I make my payment on that day on my app on my phone you should not be scamming me for a late fee. And I mean for years . Go look how many times. Thousands of dollars to my bill! I should take you to court! Now back n the 95 dollar interest after. Paid off my balance. Discover and visa both took off their interest on my account yet capital one says no!

My family has only used Capital One Credit Cards and as a college student, they were my first choice, and I opened a credit card with no credit score. Capital one helped me build my credit and has helped me open a business credit card at in less than a year after not having no credit score at all. When I accidentally paid off my personal balance with my business bank account, I called Capital One and my bank and both helped me quickly reverse my mistake with no issues. I love the app, it’s simple, reliable, friendly, and hassle-free. I even got upgraded to a normal credit card status from my student credit card in less than 7 months! My spending limit increased! Thanks for all that you do Capital One, and please keep up the good work!

First of all I want to say that capital one was my first and is my only credit card , unfortunately I haven’t been doing so well financially and I’m even embarrassed to call but regardless of my financial hardship capital one has always had solutions they never make me feel bad for not making a payment and sometimes even waived my late fee. I used to think credit card companies were bad when trying to collect payments but capital one has been so helpful to me since day 1 , I recommend everyone, I can’t think of one time ever regretting this credit card company, the customer service people have delays been friendly to me , never rude always transfer me to the correct people and like I said if there’s a problem they have many solutions and they walk me thru and even though my account is not at its best and I’m having trouble making payments that’s not thier fault and I am trying to get everything on track. I do wish I could pay off both my accounts but they don’t accept another credit card for pay off and it’s my mom’s only way of helping me out and that would really be a burden off my back but that’s the only thing I wish could change. Thank you capital one for being understanding and helping me through the hard times I promise I’m doing my best to keep my credit cards in track but things aren’t going well I appreciate the solutions and awesome customer service.

This app is great in so many ways, except that there’s no in-app spend analyzer like most other major credit card providers have. This actually discourages me from using my Quicksilver card for some purchases because I’m on a really tight budget and want to keep track of how much of my income that I’m spending on groceries vs. gas vs. insurance vs. entertainment and everything else! Discover makes it so easy with pre calculated categories and spending percentage overviews that really help me track where my money is going. If Capital One did this it would be a game changer for me and other people who don’t want to have to manually go through every purchase and categorize and calculate themselves, especially when I WANT to use my card for more things to get the rewards and cash back! Otherwise, the app is great, no bugs, easy to use.

reviews.t: This is a great banking app
reviews.x: This Capital One app is one of the few decent, mature, easily accessible banking apps. (Too many others try to mimic video games and graphics) I am always able to see ALL my transactions from a year or more, with no hassle. Bravo to their SANE designers! This is one of the nest banking apps, but it will cost me near $1,000, to use it. It forces you to update to the newest iOS, which means having to buy a whole new phone, if Apple decides to discontinue your hardware. I have iPhone 8. I love it - it’s size - it’s system, but unless I allow Apple to ruin my experience with the “newest” iOS, CapitalOne no longer allows me to open it. I guess that’s life, eh? CapitalOne now WORKS FOR APPLE. I’m back to banking through Safari…………. (Maybe it’s just the techies that design and service the CapitalOne app who are getting paid under the table by APPLE. I only just thought of that - pity.

I pay off my statement balance each month to avoid paying interest. I also have a recurring payment set up for a fixed amount, to ensure I never accidentally miss a payment and protect my credit score. When paying the card via the app, I am given an option to “pay remaining statement balance”. Unbeknownst to me, this amount subtracts pending payments. Then, I’m given the option to cancel the pending recurring payment - which I do because I believe I’m paying off the balance of the statement. As a result, I end up short and get charged interest for the month. To make it worse, even if you pay it off, Capital One automatically charges interest for the subsequent month. I was irritated the first time, but now can’t help but feel this is intentional. Obviously if I’d paid closer attention to the amount I would see the issue, but if I’m selecting “statement balance” that’s what I want to pay!! It’s a bad UX that benefits Capital One in the short term, but has lost my business. Between this predatory practice and the incredibly annoying popups to advertise referral bonuses or their shopping plugin data collector, I am done with this app. Cannot recommend.

Other than me not receiving my replacement card (getting got lost in the mail, family member throwing it away thinking it’s a credit card offer instead, etc.) everything has been good. I had an unauthorized charge and that caused me to need the replacement card, but I haven’t received it. Customer service has been great and I love the discount offers that pop up on the websites when I’m trying to purchase things versus having to look up and see if the card gives me a discount or not. So I think that’s pretty cool. And whoever reads this review if you could send me an email, text or call so that we can find a better way than sending me the card directly to my mailbox would be awesome. Because I don’t pick up the mail and my stuff doesn’t always get to me. Maybe a home delivery where the mailman makes me sign for it at the door or something, or in a more official looking envelope that won’t get mistaken for a credit card offer. But if not, I’ll still be on the lookout for the card. I have recommended the company (investing) and the credit card to members of my family and friends and I think at least one has gotten a capital one card because of it. I give you guys an A+ on everything and the only problem I have is not getting the replacement card, but that’s not your fault. And if you guys wanna raise my credit limit a few thousand I’d be cool with that too. Joking.

Would like to like this app, but it has three annoying problems. The first is that managing eno virtual numbers is just not possible. The second is organization - finding what I want isn't easy... in part because eno is a dumb bot, as well as a virtual card manager. You end up wasting time trying to get the right text only to land on an unexpected web page. If you try to use the web, it cycles back through the app. 2fa is a hassle. I really don't want to have to have my phone to bank online.

reviews.t: Disappointed with limits on mobile deposits
reviews.x: I’ve been a longtime Capital One Small Business customer and only recently found out the hard way about a $25K limit on mobile deposits on a rolling 30 day basis. This is one of the most unrealistic restrictions I think I’ve ever heard of for a business checking account. The alternatives for making deposits is to go to a branch or ATM that can accept deposits, or mail in the deposit. Unfortunately where I live and conduct business there are No branches or ATMs that accept deposits. This has put a huge restriction on my business operations right now due to not being able to make the deposits necessary to make online invoice payments in a timely manner. Thanks CapOne!! I will be looking for another bank to move my business to.

reviews.t: Unhappy customer from a 7 year auto loan
reviews.x: Took and made my loan a 7 year loan. I paid for the car in interest alone. 100% interest paid on the car. And after the term of the loan. The principle still had 6 thousand dollars at the end. They essentially took 3 thousand off and I was forced to pay 3000 or it would have turned into a 8 1/2 year auto loan. Never in my life. They really got over on me during COVID. You no what you did capital one. I was threatened a lot with my auto loan. Repo repo repo. Yes I was behind, but COVID hit and so was the entire U.S. but capital one didn’t care business as usual. I payed my car off and I will never ever go through capital one ever again. They were a thorn in my side for 7 years strait. They say at the end of each conversation. Thank you for being the best part of capital one. What a lie. I was a rolling account number that accrued interest monthly-weekly-daily. Be aware and think before you take a loan out with this company. Satin the only thing that wasn’t asked was to sign in blood. What a joke. And the joke was on me. 100% total loan paid in interest. Greedy greedy company. They preyed on me, capital one. If this gets to one person and makes them rethink their auto lender. And the change it due to this review. Then I got my point across. Capital one you should be ashamed of yourself. Michael Sutherland

reviews.t: Some things work, Shop deals is a bait and switch!
reviews.x: There have been a few times already where I use the app shopping deals with my Capital One credit card for a %of money back. Several times I buy things and look at the shopping trips beta and sometimes it shows pending and later disappears or it just says activated then goes inactive. Stores like JBL and several times for GNC. Don’t waste your time on the shopping unless it is really worth it and screen record you buying it. That’s how I got back money before because I have the truth behind me but I shouldn’t have to do this every time. I feel that capital one are wanting people to use the cards for shopping rewards/% back and make if disappear hoping that you won’t notice. Been happening for over a year now so they can’t say this is a one time glitch or just happened recently be that is a total like. I been debating contacting FTC and BBB because this seems like borderline possible fraud by this company!

reviews.t: Beware this app is not secure
reviews.x: Recently after longtime use of this app, the app suddenly listed my account mysteriously as restricted. Upon contacting Capital One through the app using the number that is listed in the app that you press for one touch connect to Capital One. Someone other than Capital One was called and they attempted to convince me that they were contacting my bank to confirm that I owned the account that I make my payments from. The pretend bank employee from my supposed bank New, which bank I paid from identified himself as an employee, then proceeded to ask for my debit card number and pin but I refused. I hung up. I contacted capital one through the number on the back of my credit card and reported this incident. They ignored my report, so I hung up and called them back and reported it again. By the third time that I called and reported it, I realized they either knew what was happening or simply did not care. They also attempted to request my full Social Security number among other personal identifying information. Do not trust this app and do not ever allow them to pretend to call your bank for you. Capital one after talking to three representatives and a supervisor still cannot explain to me why my account became restricted to begin with.

reviews.t: Make sure ask questions over and over
reviews.x: They closed my two credit cards because i didn’t ask the right questions. I usually pay my card around the 26th every month and sometimes I can’t till like the 2nd because the way i get paid. SO SOMETIMES I call them and they set up a payment schedule for the 2nd . Keep in mind I have a capital one checking account as well so when they set up my schedule payment they asume I’m using that account and I do sometimes but I’ve asked them if i could just pay on my app and they always say yes well what i didn’t know is they would set of payment then on the 2nd i would pay on my app with my other card so I don’t have to go add money to my capital one account it’s just easier. Well I guess they payments they set up would get returned and my would clear which is clearly stated on my app you see a return from them and payment from me same day . Well they closed. Both my accounts because of the returns . I’ve told them they never said that i couldn’t do that as long as they were getting paid SMH so ask questions and ask again so nothing like this happens to anyone else

I just want to thank u for all that u do my first card was a secured card and a few weeks ago I applied for the Quicksilver card unsecured and was so so happy I was approve just got my card in the mail and I’m enjoying every bit of it so thank u so much for approving me on this card it really motivates me to make sure my payments are always on time thank u so much for giving me this great opportunity, I love capital one everyone I speak to on the phone about my 2 cards there so nice and helpful mayb after six months I will have made sure payments are always made on time and I will b hoping I can receive a higher limit that would b so great. Thank u again and Alooooooooha Che’ri Kaina 🌺🌈🏝️🌺🌈🩷

I had to have a new card issues due to a fraud situation. The customer rep said he would get a new one set up and get it in the mail..5-7 business days. I asked if I could use my Virtual Card in the meantime. He said I can’t get a VC until I have the new card? I told him I already had a virtual card, but he dropped it and I assumed I couldn’t use it. It didn’t make sense to me. A week went by and no card. I called and talked to another rep who was on top of her game. She said the request was not completed so no card was issued! Seriously! She got the card in the mail immediately with expedited delivery and no charge for the extra fee. Received it today. The first rep would have 1 star, unless it was his first day on the job, the 2nd one 10 stars!!

New feedback: The Capital One app needs dark mode. Using the app at night, or in a space with minimal lighting is blinding to the eyes. There is too much stark white color in the app. Please consider giving customers the option to personalize the app’s display settings by adding dark mode customization. -  -  -  -  -  - ORIGINAL REVIEW: Card Lock/Unlock Should ALWAYS be Accessible Whoever designed this does not care about security, or they don’t actually use the app itself. Simply put: I NEED THE ABILITY TO LOCK AND UNLOCK MY DEBIT CARD ALWAYS! Stop hiding the lock and unlock feature further into settings. In all the time I’ve owned my Capital One account, I have NEVER transferred money, I have never sent money with Zelle, I have never paid my bills through this app, nor do I need to view my statements every day!!! Yet I have likely locked and unlocked my debit card about 500 times. Locking and unlocking my debit card is the account feature I use the most. The features that I don’t use are the ones you push in my face, and the feature I do use often, you make me go through hoops to access it. I should NOT have to click more times than necessary to access this feature. My debit card remains locked 99% of the time, the remaining 1% of the time is when I unlock it about twenty seconds before I proceed with a transaction, then I lock it again immediately after I complete my transaction. Rather than ALWAYS leaving this feature accessible under the “I want to” tab, I have to click through settings to find it. This is annoying and inconvenient! PERMANENTLY LEAVE THE LOCK AND UNLOCK DEBIT CARD FEATURE UNDER “I want to” tab. Or make the account holder choose which setting they want quick access to.

reviews.t: Extremely easy and convenient way of banking
reviews.x: So unfortunately Capital One doesn’t have a branch within 20-25 miles from me. But the ability to add cash to your account using CVS or Walgreens by using a barcode makes it easier for me to deposit cash. And the deposit check feature using the camera, makes it simple to deposit a check as needed. Customer support is friendly and supportive with every issue I had with my account. Which has only amounted to two at the moment. I also have credit cards with Capital One and love that I can see all of my accounts including the credit cards on one dashboard via the app. Helps keep you in tune with your credit score with a monitoring feature that shows your score and probably does other features that I’m not aware of. So far I very satisfied with Capital One and have been for the last two years that I’ve been with them. I highly recommend utilizing them for your banking and credit needs.

I use Capital 1 for an auto loan and when I traded my car in and a dealership, I never expected to get a late fee from Capital 1. That’s where I was wrong even though I traded my car in before my payment was due and notify Capital 1 by telephone, I traded my car in to pay off from the dealership still added a late charge and put that on my credit causing my credit to drop over 50 points. As a person trading in a car, no one would think they have any worries as long as the dealers are paid, Capital 1 was paid within 20 days which is within the law and still applied a late fee and would not remove it after I had it investigated. I would never use them for an auto loan again.

Find another company to get your credit card through. They tell you one thing then when it doesn’t happen they find a reason on why it didn’t work. I was told if I made a payment using my debit card that my availabile balance would reflect right away. Well I go to make my first payment to pay off my balance thinking it would reflect right away since I have to drive out of state for a business trip only for it to not recognize my payment and shows that it’s still due. I called customer service and was advised that I now have to wait until midnight for my payment to post and an additional 2 business days for my available balance to reflect leaving me without an option to travel. I’ll never trust capital one EVER again! If I could give them zero stars I would.

reviews.t: What was once a good place to bank
reviews.x: Capital One has now become another shady bank that changes products(your saving account and credit card terms) without any notification. They will change the interest you were earning in your account and then play stupid when you call them out, the agent will say “I’m sorry but my system won’t let me adjust or fix the issue” they will say this statement over and over again to the point of frustration. Good luck trying to find a brick and mortar to do some real banking or to talk to someone to help, what a joke. Had to withdraw a large sum of money and the only place I could do this was over an hour away, get to the place and it’s a “Open to the public” Cafe, think of a Starbucks where people are trying to bank. The employees looked like the random people off the street, they were not knowledgeable on any of the banks products, could help with my issues and didn’t have a private place to take out large sums of money. Now they are charging me a membership fee for a card that they promote everyday to the public of having no membership fee, not to mention I don’t benefit at all from any of the “benefits” of this card. Agent told me the industry low 1.5% cash back is somehow a benefit and how I should use my rewards to pay the membership fee. Now they are saying they have been charging me this for 3 years and won’t reverse or take off the annual fee that’s not even supposed to be there. Now I know that’s a lie cause that was one of the reasons I even got the Quicksilver card was due to no annual fees for the life of the card. This is the straw that now have me looking for other banks to park my money. Just with these examples I advise you to go elsewhere. I have other examples that would make this a novel, I hope my bad luck is a deciding factor for others to go elsewhere.

There was an unauthorized purchase using my card so I called Capital One. I ended up for over an hour on the phone with five different people some of whom were totally disinterested in the problem and were not willing to help me make sure I got a replacement card overnighted. The initial customer service representatives told me they do not overnight cards which I know is not true because this has happened to me before with Capital One. When I got a supervisor on the phone, they told me they did overnight it and they would overnight it. however, they told me you have to call before 12:30 in the afternoon to have it overnighted. This is ridiculous because again that was a totally different requirement from the last time this happened to me. Also, the initial customer service representatives were very rude. I may or may not continue my relationship with Capital One.

reviews.t: Lack of ability to talk to a human
reviews.x: My credit card was locked due to a fraudulent charge by T-Mobile, I was able to talk to a person from the fraud department, I was told that my new credit card was on its way. I was going on a cruise and I was sure that my new card would be available before I left. The card didn’t arrive so the only way that I could get a new credit card was to tell Eno that my credit card had been stolen. I also told Eno that if I didn’t get my new card soon, I was going to close my Capitalone account and go to one of your competitors. If I could have talked to a person after contact with your fraud department, I would have had my replacement card in time for my cruise. That didn’t happen and I had to charge all my cruise expenses to my checking account debit card.

I’m actually very happy with capitol one credit card company because they are one of the only credit card companies that gives you a chance to grow and build your credit. As long as your card is on automatic payment, you will always pay your bill on time and at least a year down the road they will take a chance on you by giving you more credit. I really like capitol one! This is not only a great starter card but also a great building card overall….. the discounts you get for using the cards are great because you learn how to build and leverage there point system I would recommend this company to everyone!

I wish this app would work as expected, but it just doesn't. First, I have quite a few savings accounts that I set up beginning years ago with ING Direct, before Capital One bought them. I find it to be very convenient for setting money aside each month for large expenses such as property taxes, auto insurance, car payments, vacations, etc. With ING Direct, I could give each account a "nickname" such as "Car Insurance". I was able to change the name if necessary, if I paid off a car loan for example. But now if I change an account name, it still shows up with the old name. Why can't it just use the right name? Second, I can't pay my credit card bill through the app - I have to use a web browser. This is because you have to choose which account to pay the credit card from, and it lists all the savings accounts as well as my external bank account that I want to make the payment from, but it puts my external account at the bottom of the list and the program won't allow me to scroll down to the bottom of the list. If I scroll all the way to the bottom I can see the account I need, but as soon as I lift my finger it snaps back below the bottom of the box. I've tried to quickly let go, and then tap the account before it disappears, but it happens too quickly. Finally, I have searched several times and can find no way to inform Capital One of these issues. There's a useless AI help feature that just tells me it can't help regardless of what I ask, but no apparent way to contact the developers to explain the bugs in their system.

"I've been using my Capital One credit card for an incredible 10 years now, and I must say it's been a game-changer for my financial journey! As my first-ever credit card, Capital One took a chance on me when I was just starting to build my credit history. Over the years, their user-friendly interface, flexible payment options, and rewards program have helped me establish a strong credit foundation. I'm grateful for the credit limit increases and competitive interest rates that have allowed me to make the most of my card. The Capital One mobile app is also super convenient for tracking my spending and making payments on-the-go. Most importantly, Capital One's reporting to the credit bureaus has helped me improve my credit score significantly over the years. I've gone from a credit newbie to a responsible credit user, all thanks to their trust and support. If you're looking for a reliable and customer-centric credit card issuer, I highly recommend Capital One. They've been my partner in building a strong financial future, and I couldn't be more thankful!"

What a complete joke! If I could give them 0 stars I would’ve! My husband was in a work related accident and we placed many of our living expenses on credit cards to just get by. After he received a settlement, we paid off all our debts including my 4 capital one cards. They returned the first attempted payment because they thought it was fraudulent. Called customer service and they replaced the bank account back into the available accounts to make payments from and we retried the payments. Well guess what folks… THE PAYMENTS WENT THROUGH!!! The money was pulled from our account! The amount was over $10k and capital one received the money. Capital one even stated that the amount received was valid and was a good payment but then they turn around and closed all 4 accounts down. Their reason for closing all 4 accounts? Capital one said it’s because I breached contract. I never did such a thing! I made valid and non fraudulent payments to my accounts! It’s reported to my credit now and showing 4 closed cards. Please for the love of god, find another creditor that will appreciate your longevity and payments better than this disgusting company. I was never late on ANY payment and NEVER had the cards go into collections or anything negative happen and then capital one turns around and does this? All I can say is wow! Please if you value your credit and your payments then please find a different creditor because capital one is NOT IT!!!!

I recently bought a car and went through capital one. I have been trying to pay my bill for three days now. I have called and cat speak to anyone real. I have tried the app to try to pay that way and it says it has an error. I am still pretty young and have been working hard on credit. It has been impossible for me to pay and I’m irritated. Why is it so hard to pay a bill? Honestly wish I went somewhere else. App is no help, online is no help. It’s embarrassing. I feel sorry for who ever goes through capital one. All I want to do is just pay my bill. Need my car just like everyone else for work. I don’t care if they added 10$. Just let me pay a bill. I have looked all online and all the numbers I call all go back to same place. If someone could assist would be great. I can’t just walk to work either. It’s an hour and 15 min away. I’m screwed if things don’t get fixed. Again I just want to pay a bill.

On 7/2/24 I visited the branch at 4111 Gaston Ave. Dallas, Tx. I was there to make a withdrawal and while being waited on there was an elderly Black Man at the next window. I overheard him explain that he was robbed of his phone and wallet where all his credentials including his Capital One debit card. He was trying to prove his identity by showing his birth certificate and social security card. He was concerned about his money telling the cashier “they have my card and can drain my account. I just want you to lock my account until I can be issued another card and the teller wouldn’t help him saying, the 2 items he had was not proof it was him. And the bank policy would NOT let her accept them as government proof. SINCE WHEN!!! How much more proof can you have. She was a young Black Women treating this man with such callous and matter of factly. He then asked for a supervisor or branch manager and was told he was at another branch so I can’t help you. Other people in line including me was so appalled and upset they started talking and discussing “ what if that was us”. This is a VERY BAD POLICY on Capital One’s part. How could you treat your customers like that. We felt sooo sorry for this poor fellow. I never seen a teller at this branch treat someone like that with NO HEART. Up until then I thought Capital One was the best. It is where I have ALL my income entrusted to. I’m getting up in age now and can’t help but think, what if it were me. The poor old man was shaky and looked as though he was about to cry. Everybody that heard this was angry. Shame on Capital One. I’m considering using another bank now because I don’t know?

I’m 13 and everything is going so far so good. Even though you are not the parent, you're still in charge! You can put money in your savings and take out without permission. It might not sound very big but Capital One has 0.10% interest when you save in your set aside. That’s more that most banks provide (most banks: 0.01%interest). Tip: With a teen account comes a debit card, so if your having a hard time trying to find out if they are in the process of making your card, don’t worry! After a day or two of opening a teen account, they show you a card tracking. For now I haven’t gotten my card but it’s on the way! I’ll update!.

I logged into the app, looking for an upgrade to my platinum card. After clicking into the profile for the platinum card and searching upgrades for that card, I selected one which is the Quicksilver card. However, for some reason, the app upgraded the wrong card, or the apps algorithm is set up to inconvenience the customer I needed a card that would give me more points than the platinum card, but I also needed to keep my venture card. Customer service was most unhelpful, and told me nothing could be done even after calling seconds after noticing the error. The algorithm of this app obviously is meant to favor the bank and this situation so I cannot take advantage of the points I gathered on my venture card. Disgusted with my experience i will not be recommending any services through Capital One. This experience left me feeling robbed, and scammed out of the points that I worked hard to earn to be able to use for my wedding. If I could give this app zero stars I would.

So far I have been very impressed by the quality security that has been provided to help people keep their data safe from malware attacks in the past few months I have been notified by my card company that they were checking to make sure I had access my account and made changes to my password as I have been able to do because I am only human and forgot my password and had to reset it. So I thought that I was okay but it seems like I missed a letter and I had to reset my password again and thanks to fraud protection I was notified to contact the number so that they were able to check and confirm that it was me who made the change. Thank you for your help with keeping me informed of these things. Much appreciated

Capital One really needs to get their act together. They wasted my time making me verify myself in multiple ways. Trying to make a simple charge online, not even a high priced one, and they make me go through the hassle of verifying myself through text verification through my number linked to the account. Then, they send me an email that I need to verify. Then after that, they STILL don’t let the charge go through, even though it is from the email and the phone number they have on file with my account!!! Just a complete waste of my time The worst part is, they weren’t even notifying me that they were rejecting the charge! The card was just declining, but it was coming up as “insufficient funds“ on the vendors side. I had to call them to find out. They locked up my account until they verified my identity! No notification at all!!! so then, I had to waste about 10 minutes of my time on the phone, verifying my identity, when I was calling from the same freaking number that is attached to the account!!! All for a $90 charge!!!

reviews.t: Gives you a chance when credit unions don’t
reviews.x: I’ve had an auto loan and 2 credit cards with Capital One. In the 4 years of building credit with them, they have increase my credit line at least 4 times using soft inquiries and rewarding you on good old paying you credit card in full and on time. Just recently, a credit union asked me to apply for another credit card with them. It was a hard inquiry. They denied me. Within a week, Capital One offers another credit card with pre-approval, and actually approved me with a good amount of credit! Thank you Capital One for giving me a chance to prove myself! Now I have 3 credit cards with Capital One and a good amount of available credit!!

Best credit card company ever for help in preventing fraud, good benefits, and efficiency. Am a little displeased that it seems they’ve moved some of their Customer Service phone assistance to outside the United States! Its the only drawback that I can speak of. Still think they gave up an awesome marketing tool when the quit doing credit cards with photo uploaded! EVERYONE wanted to know how I got mine or how they could get that card. Instead of departing from the photo card entirely, why didnt they just allow choice, AT RENEWAL DATE, for cardholder to submit and upload a photo then??? Would bring in 100’s or 1000’s of new cardholders. (People like to see themselves or family on the card and be able to brag at checkout line!)

Everything is right at my fingertips i really enjoy being with Capital One. This may stem out to every credit card service but the only thing that would be more helpful is that if the help line also had an option to connect with a person and not just the automated computer. I needed help with something specific an the prompts I was being shown wasn’t compatible with my needs during that time. So I continued to search for a little bit trying to see if I could be connected to someone and I had no luck. I did finally get thru but I had to play around with my options and when anxiety it’s harder for me to formulate a solution (ex.) “wording what I needed help with using key words.” I give you guys a 👍 deff great service but I really do think there should be an exception to speak with a person for certain problems you come across. Especially if the problem your facing is more detailed and can’t be explained with only a few words. But once again other than that tiny adjustment I’m very satisfied with my choice in going with Capital One 👍⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

When I attempt to access the app it states, update required, the app you are using is no longer supported. So I press the update button. Which takes me back to the app. The app doesn’t indicate an update is required, it just reads open. I then attempt to open it which takes me back to the update required screen. This just keeps circling, very frustrating, would like to check my balance and see if my health insurance payment posted… Please advise …. Also I have attempted 20 names which it is asking me for to place with this post, and no matter what name I select, regardless of how absurd, it says name taken. Is this just a ploy to prevent bad reviews from posting?

reviews.t: Awful system when you dispute a charge.
reviews.x: I booked a trip with a budget travel site in January. When we received the itinerary they had switched two of the 3 hotels to lesser hotels. We disputed the charge for one day until they changed the hotels to the ones we agreed on. We cancelled the dispute the day after making it. The CO rep said it hadn’t gone through anyway. We paid on the airline site for carryon bags $200 and at a later date for seats $30 on the site. The day before our flight when we tried to get the boarding passes that we had to get them at the desk at the airport. When we arrived at the ticket counter and were informed that WE had cancelled the flight when we disputed it and it would cost over $1,400 to get new tickets. We had no choice but to pay. Of course we disputed the $1400 when we returned from vacation. Capital Ones dispute system couldn’t be worse! The ask for screen shots of pages you want to send them BUT DO NOT ACCEPT the format of Iphone screenshots!!! They accept JPG and PDF files. Apple screenshots are not either of those so you have to covert files to the form they accept. They send you messages through the CO app but DO NOT advise by email or text that they sent a message on the dispute. I was told they are working on the problem. The trip was early April and in the middle of May when, and only when I asked to speak to a manager, i was informed that according to TACA terms of service that the money is LOST if you dispute a charge for a flight!! WE NEVER received their term since we booked through a travel site and never hire a lawyer to read terms of payment. The cost of the flight through the travel site was less than $600 and now we have paid Twice for the flights, over $2,000 total. What is in your wallet???

Capital One has helped me rebuild my credit back to the way it use to be! Yes, I have other credit rebuilder cards. Bur,with Capital One you’re not only rebuilding your credit. I,get points for shopping at some of my favorite stores and eating at some of my favorite restaurants! With Capital One I’m in control of my spending. I pay the amount I want to have on my card. I’m in total control of my spending and it has a pie chart that shows me how much I spent in different areas. Capital One platinum is the card you need if you want to rebuild your credit and get rewarded each time you use your credit card! Thanks Capital One from a happy card holder, Stephen W, Wilmington-New Hanover County,NC!

I ordered the venture x because I thought it would be a card with good benefits. I knew before ordering that I would need to use their travel portal to get 5,10x miles when booking flights/hotels/etc. What I didn’t know was that the portal does NOT allow you to book flights! It’s designed to do so, but as of now, I’ve booked flights to Sweden and to Mexico and haven’t been able to use the travel portal. My flight to Sweden showed options that were considerably more expensive compared to google flights, my flight to Mexico I wasn’t able to book on the portal, called customer service (very profesional,) they offered to wave the $25 dollar fee they charge if you do it over the phone (due to the fact that I was having issues on the portal.) After short time, I was told the times I had chosen to fly were not available and I needed to choose different flights(price increase.) I ended up booking the flight directly through the airline with no issues. Long story short, if you are getting this card for the promised miles they offer when using the travel portal, don’t rely on being able to access all flights that you can buy directly from the airlines or expect to pay more when booking flights through the portal.

I filed a dispute regarding a double charge on my Capital One 360 debit card. Jan 10 I had funds in my acct $85 to pay the merchant, the merchant swiped my card and the merchant stated the charge was declined, they swiped the card again and stated it was declined again so I gave them a different card from another bank and the transaction went through just fine. Laster that evening I received a notification from Capital One 360 that the transaction went through to the merchant. The next morning Jan 11 at 9am I received a notification that the transaction went through again. I contacted the merchant and they told me to contact the bank. I did contact Capital One 360, so they gave me a provisional credit after 10 days of my complaint. April 11, 2024 Capital One 360 reversed the provisional credit sending my acct into the -$85. I have proof where I paid the merchant with another card when the merchant advised me that the card declined twice on Jan 10 and never even swiped the card on the April 11th because of the declination on Jan 10. I have proof of where I paid the merchant on April 11 with another card as well. I called Capital One 360 to have the reversal of the provisional credit removed, they placed me on hold came back to the line and stated nonsense, they do not know why the reversal of the provisional credit was done, and they need more time put me on hold again and eventually hung up. Reported to BBB Will allow the account to close.

reviews.t: Deposit not on time, locked me out of logging in
reviews.x: The early pay, two days early did not work for me. Can’t get a clear answer from any customer service rep. All five of them gave me different answers. The last person just told me to keep checking, it could arrive at any moment, and I checked too many times and it locked me out of my account and told me I attempted to authenticate the account too many times after sending me verification codes every single time I logged in. So there is a limit to how many times I can access my account. Now I have to call an 800 number just to check my balance for 24 hours. This is insane. I will be switching back to my other bank. This was the biggest mistake. I’m in my 40s and never in my life have I seen such a raggedy bank with an app with tons of issues. The customer service has no idea how to help. What a mistake. Sure let’s mishandle someone’s money and then lock me out of my account as I’m checking for my deposit that should have been there yesterday… As soon as I clear everything I’m closing this account.

Capital One is a sexist bank. Did you know that they approve men with a high credit line? I had 3 cards with them and they only gave me a $300 credit line for each card and never increased my credit lines. I have a male family member who had the same credit score as me and he got approved for an zqinitial line of credit of $3,500. Make that make sense.
