Capital One will also close your credit cards without notice and say that you account was considered “a risk” even when payment history is at 100% of payments made on time and cards were paid off. Don’t waist your time with them. It’s not worth risking your credit for a sexist bank!

They recently did a software update that effectively shutdown the Bill Pay feature. It was working up until a month ago and then I started to get a ‘under maintenance’ page which eventually changed to page that says that Bill Pay is no longer available on the mobile app. I called into customer service only got the standard response to reinstall the app. When that didn’t work, they wanted me to update my OS version on my phone. First of all, I had already done that the week before hoping that that would solve the problem. And secondly, a user shouldn’t have to jump through hoops like this to get the app to work. It seems that this latest software update from Capital One was not fully tested before release and they are now having their customers perform the testing for them. They customer rep refused to send me to their tech support. Just horrible. I’m going to ditch Capital One once and for all. This was the last straw. They’ve literally closed all physical branches in my city.

My wife and I have used our Capital One card for a long time. We use it for EVERYTHING, gas, groceries, purchases, for everything possible. The only thing that makes me mad is your credit reporting. I pay my card usually twice, sometimes more every week. It is the only debt we have ever. I had a balance of $1343 which I paid as soon as I could. But if I have an I increase in spending, such as the $1343, and it’s at a certain date, it shows as an increase in debt and as a result, the credit agencies lowered my score by one point. That doesn’t seem like a big deal but it is to me. That $1343 stays on my report for a month even though it was paid the first day possible. I take my credit score seriously. The bottom line is that your reporting is erroneous, false, and not current. Because I had a higher than average balance for a day or two, it sticks to me for a month. I talked to someone at Capital One and they said they would get back to me, but never did. If you are going to share my balance, please be timely. Every day if that’s what it takes for you to be honest and correct. That is your responsibility. You can tell that I am p****d! I have lots of cards and a credit line of half a million dollars. I choose to use Capital One because I like the features. It’s a good card, but not necessarily the best. I know you probably don’t like people like me because you don’t make any money off of me. But remember how the pyramid goes. If I say you are a good deal, no one tells anyone. If I talk negatively about something, they tell ten people who tell ten people and on it goes. I simply don’t want a single day balance to be reflective of the entire month. Thank you.

reviews.t: Can’t access and it’s destroying my credit!!!
reviews.x: Got a credit card with $300 limit, once I had about $100 on it I went to pay it off, noticed I couldn’t log into my app, Not a big deal. Waited and waited while using the card here and there for snacks at work while still not being able to login or make a payment or anything. All that showed up was, “we’re having a problem displaying your information right now” since I’ve had this credit card, and keep in mind I haven’t went over the limit, my credit score dropped almost 230 points. That’s right, two hundred and thirty points. Have tried multiple times to call the number and pay it off and it’s an automated messenger that just keeps looping in circles and I can’t make the payment. Can’t call to cancel it and I can’t call to make the payment while it’s absolutely trashing my credit score. I will be taking action and making sure something is done about this because it is absolutely ridiculous and unacceptable.

I have a business account with multiple separate cardholders. The mobile ap is disappointing, especially for handling business accounts. First, it does not allow me to modify spending limits for users. Second, the lock/unlock function was naively programmed. I unlocked a card and it was refused. Why? Because when I unlocked it, the phone did not record the unlock. It turns out that when I lock/unlock a card, a button appears at the end of the card list to accept and record the change. The button is not there until a change is made, and since it appears at the END of the card list, it is on a different screen than is visible to the user. So when I tapped the ONLY exit button on the screen to save the change, it discarded the change. This screen needs 2 basic fixes: the save button needs to appear on the page within view and state how many changes are being saved, and the exit button needs a popup when hit to warn if changes are being discarded. These are basic to making any user friendly ap.

reviews.t: This app has a accidental login problem
reviews.x: When Face ID is activated for this app, this app assumes that the user wants to login every time the app takes the screen which isn’t always the case. The Unna time I think, automatic login in to the app becomes necessary, is when the user login into the app, but then put the app in the background, and then recall the app back to the screen. Every other type of login should be prompted by the user have the user attention and input by software button, or a checkmark that enables the app to always automatically login using Face ID. such checkmark should be different and separate from the checkmark that is used when signing up for Face ID they should not be the same.

I’ve used this app for years now and have never had a problem. It covers all the basics of managing my card and then some. However…. I moved overseas and now I can’t even log in to the app because of the two-factor identification. The app only accepts U.S. phone numbers to text the confirmation to. The number of ex-pat and overseas military users is probably pretty low, making this a low priority from the app developers. But it seems like an easy fix. Just allow texts to foreign numbers or allow the two-factor identification via email. Again, the app is great. And customer service has been really friendly helping me out with this. And I can still log on via the website. The app just needs an extra little function.

reviews.t: Love the additional shopping rewards perks!
reviews.x: I have had my capitol one card for some time now. In the beginning the percentage on rewards was far more significant, which I miss. However, if you are smart on your preparation and search the app before making purchases, you will find that capitol gives quite a bit back in rewards if you shop by linking to your specific retailers through it. Example, you choose BJ’s because capitol one is giving extra back, click on that link and it will automatically direct you to your in phone app for said retailer. Purchase is made, and then the extra percentage displays in your reward benefits! Capitol one has the best rewards out of all of my current cards!

reviews.t: Great until you don’t have access to the info you signed up with!
reviews.x: Everything has been great with the app……until my phone was stolen and had to change the number so I lost access to my old phone number and I was locked out of old email accounts that are no longer active…..so when I try to login, the only other option besides sending a text or email to numbers and address I no longer have access to is to call the toll free number!! Which I have done several times which they send me a link to scan my drivers license, which I’ve done over and over for it to tell me it failed so they can’t help me!!! Even though I have all of my personal info, along with my account, routing and credit card numbers, they can’t help me!!!!! So basically told me there is nothing they can do. Maybe this will get them motivated to simply change my phone number and email address on my account so I can login!!!!!!

You restricted my account for paying my balance off, which I do every couple of months. It comes from the same bank account every time which should tell you. It’s my bank account because it has not changed for more than a year. You guys have decided you need proof it’s my bank account, and how much money is in my bank account which I refuse to divulge because it’s none of your business how much money I have in my bank account. It seems like you guys think you’re doing me some kind of favor, letting me borrow money at a 28% rate. I’m not sure if you guys are aware but that’s a terrible interest rate to borrow money at and I don’t need to borrow money at all let alone at 28% so basically you guys are losing a customer that pays you a ridiculous interest rate so I can basically get points. That can pay off the balance of this card maxed out at any point in time. Because you’re employees either can’t use logic or you’re not allowing them to be logical. either way you lost a customer I don’t deal with stupidity.

In my early 30s. Been working hard at rebuilding my credit since the impact employment changes & inflation has had on most of us since 2020. My savings and checking is also with capital one. I’ve always paid my credit cards on time whether it was more or the minimum. A few days ago, capital one lowered my credit limit drastically on a card i haven’t used in yrs .. the limit was helping my credit score, and also lowered it drastically on the only credit card I currently use. I was informed that it was lowered bc of a “return” of a payment that was actually scheduled on time on my end. & because I chose the “remind me later” option to update my current income and number .. all my hard work of rebuilding my credit score over the past 3 yrs will be reversed and I feel defeated. I will be removing all of my accounts with C1 because this was extremely unfair to do this especially right after the holidays coming into a new yr. Worried that i won’t be able to be approved for anything this yr bc of the drastic change this will have on my credit score. I’m infuriated and heartbroken

The mobile deposit system is absolutely a nightmare. I had a check deposit and I had to take photos of it and submit it four different times and even when it took it an hour later, I would get an email from Capital One saying they refused it because the payee name and pay your name and all this other cryptic stuff no clear explanation rejected it. I called online and talk to a customer service agent got hung up on automatically call back. Got a different one after sitting on hold off and on for 20 minutes. Gotta well you’re gonna have to go into a branch to do this. What’s the point of the mobile deposit system if you have to go to a branch oh and by the way, the nearest branch for me is 45 miles one-way time to find a different bank if they can’t get the system to work. Sure I’m sure it’s a fantastic system when it works but often doesn’t absolutely miserable.

I am a very satisfied customer with Capital One. Their on-line mobile banking system is very easy and convenient to use. I have no problem or issues or complaints using this system. I have lots of rewards usage with my credit cards. They are accepted everywhere by all businesses and restaurants and establishments. They also have an excellent theft prevention and protection system. I have had unauthorized charges at two different times on my credit cards and they caught it right away and cancelled the charges and issued me a new credit card. It is all part of and included in owning their credit cards. They always have my back and have protected my credit card accounts. I am a very happy and satisfied Capital One customer.

reviews.t: 2 stars because the app works great, but..
reviews.x: It seems to no longer support Apple Watch, and the release notes say the exact same thing for the last year, which I used the app on my watch in the last year. You would think this would be something to communicate to the users of this app.. but no. Want to provide feedback? You have to call them and push through the robot prompts to get to the feedback and complaint department, or be disconnected because it doesn’t understand you.. whichever. I’m more let down by the lack of communication than I am the fact that the support for Watch is gone. I don’t always carry my phone on me and rely on my watch to keep me up to date.

People be aware!!! Check your statements immediately!! They add charges close to the amount of your purchase so you don’t notice (with just cents of difference). I have changed my card and unauthorized charges still appear in my card. Sometimes they “automatically” return the amount charged to the account. After few days they erase those transaction from the app so you don’t notice. They also add unauthorized charges weeks and months after your statement cycle has been closed. I had charges added to my account as “purchase adjustment” to past months in the app transaction section. You don’t notice this charges unless you write down your current balance everyday. I am sick of my stomach to find out how much money they have been stealing from me all this years since I opened an account with capital one-Walmart.

I am a longtime customer (10years ) in fact . They have always been understanding and sympathetic to the everyday person such as myself. Whether I was calling to dispute a charge or needed a little more time to pay my bill . They never held it against me and have always updated me with my credit score free of charge . They have raised my limit without me having to ask . They send me offers all the time for other types of credit cards and insist I get one that matches my needs . For instance if I was a frequent flyer they would send me offers with great interest rates with twice the miles . They are the consumers choice because after all they put the consumer first . Always !! Thank you for all you do for me , my wife and our four children.

reviews.t: Bill Payment has a Serious Flaw
reviews.x: I have been a Capital One/ Chevy Chase Bank customer for 40 years but the latest update to bill payment together with the loss of Premier Banking account perk to reimburse ATM fees with new 365 checking account conversion have driven me to reconsider my banking choice. I can no longer update a single payment amount in a recurring payment series, nor can I delete it and add a one time payment in a different amount which was my mobile app work-around. Now if I try to edit a recurring payment my only option is to delete the series. This almost caused me to miss my monthly credit card payment since I accidentally clicked the red button where it used to be delete payment but instead it deleted my monthly average credit card payment I have set up. Losing the ATM fee reimbursement was also a loss of a perk but not nearly as damaging to your credit ranking as possibly missing payments you made every month on a reliable schedule. It also seems that with every new version of online banking you are warned to send your payments earlier because they are expected to take longer. Find a different software development team and fix the bill payment so you can actually edit the amount for a payment that is already scheduled whether it is a recurring or a one time payment.

I have a credit card and a savings account at Capital One. Very happy with the savings account and for the most part I’m happy with the capital one credit card. However, when I open the card I open the wrong one. I wanted the venture X and not the venture. The reason for my three star review is that when I call capital one to upgrade to the venture X card they tell me I can’t. If I want the venture X card I need to fill out a new application application. My credit rating is 825 and I have, the income to support the venture X card. but no matter who I speak to they tell me I have to wait to see if Capital one will allow me to upgrade at some point in the future. If I can upgrade in a month or two, I will go back to Chase where I had to chase sapphire Visa.

They believed in me with a secured card. I now have a Kohls, Walmart, Quicksilver, Plantinum and Venture card. I opened a checking account and now considering them as my primary bank. They have a multifaceted amount of products. When I had to rebuild my credit, they were there when my credit was improving they were there when my credit was excellent they were there along with my banking needs. Primarily, they have a great tool that got me here, which was credit wise. Regardless of where you’re at on the credit score scale, they can help with just about anything. I have been fortunate enough to deal with knowledgeable, supportive, and, helpful representatives on the phone. If you’re willing to be responsible and hold yourself accountable for charging 30% or less on your card and making timely payments I believe that Capital One is for you.

The Capital One app works extremely well on my iPhone and my Apple Watch Ultra 2. It’s very easy to see my current balance in my checking account or my savings account and it’s very easy to see how much I owe on my credit card, schedule payments for my credit card balance or pay bills/send money with Zelle. It’s also easy to spot check your credit by seeing your FICO score, and some of the aspects that generated it. I love the new Credit Wise. It seems more accurate than the previous system. My score is 25 points higher and came much closer to the reports I received direct from the bank. Bill Pay needs work. It's sloppy. There is no button for "pending bill transactions" or "recent bill transactions". Figuring out what has posted and what's pending can be confusing. Bill Pay needs to be its own tab. The only thing that makes sense at this point is combining "capital one wallet" with the "capital one mobile" app so that we only have one app. I see no reason for two apps. Capital One wants me to use their travel planner to redeem points, but I find it terrible. Expedia, Travelocity and numerous other apps are far easier to use. Capital One should partner with one of them. International flights and stays are extremely glitchy to search for. I prefer to buy my vacation and redeem the points against the statement balance.

Capital One isn’t perfect, but it seems clear they take system and app development seriously and have properly invested in this space. It is so easy to monitor and take actions on accounts, and even to establish a new account that seamlessly get affiliated with your identity and shows up in the app/site in moments. Transferring money is more or less instantaneous and scheduling transfers or payments in the app is a breeze. The seamless experience and convenience is what makes it hard for me to imagine opening the accounts I need elsewhere. I hope in turn therefore they take security just as seriously RE: ID theft and fraud, and I can’t speak to “exceptions to the norm” (how helpful they are when things go awry), which are the real test. But for day to day needs I’m very satisfied with the account management experience.

Show a payment due summary that is useful and actionable. 1. Statement Balance Remaining Amount. 2. Payment Due Date. 3. Minimum Payment Due Amount. 4. Interest Charges Amount. 5. Late or Other Fee Amount. If this information is visible quickly, one place on portal, the user can plan and act better, in timely manner. The information shown at present is not adequate nor useful. Showing only minimum balance due amount without the remaining amount due for the monthly statement any given month requires much extra work for user in rechecking, recalculating, especially if you make multiple small payments through statement cycle. See CITI card mobile app, for example that is 10x more useful and efficient to use practically. Every useful feature is ONE-CLICK away or visible UPFRONT!

There have been a few disappointments with this bank. First, I somehow went over my limit on my credit card and they immediately shut it down and reported to my credit, before I could even get a chance to make a payment, 3 weeks before a payment was even due. I made payments every week, let alone monthly, I thought that was going all right, until it wasn’t. So I’m still making payments, and it’s still restricted, and counting against my credit. Thanks. As far as the debit account, it’s a nightmare trying to keep up with the balance. There’s money missing all the time, then it pops up, I’ll have a balance of 2$ deposit 50$, go to McDonald’s spend 10$ then Walmart for a 15$ purchase and it tells me insufficient funds. And I look at my transactions and there’s no explanation as to where it went. Now I thought pending transactions were already taken from the account balance to make the available balance and if there are no other transactions, where is my money going? It may or may not all work out, but I’m seriously thinking of changing banks because it’s too stressful to put money in your account, go to make a purchase find your money gone, and your sitting there adding stuff up, trying to make sense of it and failing every time.

Sincerely Capital One has helped so much to build my credit, it’s over +730 and I am very happy with it, all my banking business are with them already. But unfortunately with Apple and Google Pay, it’s very useless. Mostly of time I am changing my phones and I need to re-add my cards, but when I am trying to “verify it” it never happens. Other banks with a call or a SMS it’s done, but Capital One wants to be “unique” and the only way to verify our cards in Wallets is into the App and it really useless, if you’re a person who loves Apple or Google Pay, think very much to having business with this bank, the rest of it it’s amazing.

I created a 360 savings account and 6 days later I am trying to transfer funds to the account by adding an external bank account through the app. First method I tried is the text message verification. It always comes back and says it can’t verify my phone number so I can’t use that method. Why not? It texts me just fine to do other things on the app but that same text verification number isn’t good enough to transfer money from an external account. I then try the other method which is to take a front and back pic of my license and that errors as well. I called customer no service and the guy says something about how it can take over a month for my text number to be officially verified in their system. What?? My text number is my US mobile phone number that I’ve had for 25 years. The guy then says the only way I can transfer money into the account is for him to do it over the phone since the app can’t do it with my account in some sort of limbo. NO WAY am I going to give him my bank information and transfer money if it can’t verify who I am!! If I tried to do anything with the deposited money it probably would say I’m sorry you can’t have your money since we can’t verify who you are. This is incredibly frustrating!!

reviews.t: Do not be fooled by the 4 star review
reviews.x: This company has the worst customer service you could ever imagine. I was making an online purchase with my capital one card and the website told me I would be charged a certain amount today however i was charged 12x that amount. I called customer service and provided clear evidence that I was overcharged (sent screenshot of what they claimed I should be charged vs what I was charged) and they ended up siding with the merchant on the amount charged and reversing my provisional credit after I was guaranteed it wouldn't be reversed by a capital one manager. When I called today after noticing my provisional credit was revered, they told me they would have to reopen the claim which would take an additional 55 business days look into, which is also holding up my money for an additional 55 business days. Keep in mind this was a no brainer investigation, the screenshot I provided clear evidence that a 3rd grader could investigate and conclude quicker than they can. They have proven themselves incompetent to me. The cards they provide don’t work for most merchants because its master card and customer service might as well be replaced with kindergarteners, wouldn’t recommend this bank to anyone. Use at your own risk and dont say you werent warned!

reviews.t: Pros do not out way the cons
reviews.x: You ask me to pick a payment date, but set my statement date for 5 days later. If I want to set up automatic payments the only option is to pay my last statement balance not the amount I actually owe. I pay 100% of my payment balance every month yet what gets reported to credit companies is what I owe 5 days later. I can’t use automatic payments because the statement balance usually exceeds what I owe by sometimes over 100 dollars. The fact it takes you 6 days to process a payment, yet purchases go through instantly is sleazy and unprofessional. You caused my credit score to drop 120 points because it took 2 weeks for my payment to process. I love the people that work in the cafe near me. But dealing with your phone support is causing me to end up with bleeding stomach ulcers from excessive stress, and being terminally ill gets exacerbated with stress

This has been a good card for me except they still haven’t raised my limit after several years of faithful payments and now I’ve found out I can’t pay my bill with debit cards anymore like I can with other credit cards I have….I don’t understand why a lot of cards do this. Don’t they understand that if you make it very quick and easy to pay and if payments posts quickly also, I would just use a couple of trustworthy cards and not have 4-5 tiny little cards that are annoying to keep up with on payments-it’s also a hassle when you travel out of town and use the gas pump and the hold amount exceeds the credit limit because you bought gas or food maybe 1 time.

reviews.t: Capital One lied and cheated me
reviews.x: I heard about a 90,000 bonus point offer for the Venture X and called to see if it was still available. The customer service representative on the phone told me no it wasn’t. I applied and got approved for the lowest offer ever on the card. Then two days later before I even put a single purchase on the card I find the 90,000 link. I call to see if they will honour the 90,000 offer for my account. They say they are unable to do that. They suggest I apply again for the same card I was approved for to get the 90,000. Immediately declined! There has been no change to my credit report except the first Capital One application since I first applied, so I think it’s impossible to have two Venture X cards at the same time, and all the people I talked to are just giving me their theories on how the Capital One system works. The reviews of how Capital One has changed and now has good customer service I don’t believe. Stay away from Capital One.

reviews.t: I Said No To Your Offers
reviews.x: As with another banking app I use, this app is great and works like a charm. I should, therefore, rate it 5 stars. I am not, though, because it shares another similarity with my other app. For the past months, I have had to repeatedly dismiss alerts asking me if I want card offers, money for downloading the shopping app, etc. Not only do they pop up when I access it initially. They will often display when I click on the account to view my information. To quote both my parents, I said no, and I meant no. What part of no don't you understand? Stop asking. Stop. No means no means no means no. The more you ask, the more I have to get through these alerts to do my banking, the more irritated I will grow. I do not have time for this. If I need to bank, I want to bank. I should not have to keep saying no. Three stars off for this. You should listen more attentively.

Opened an account here and deposited my wages compensation check from workers comp, i was injured at work and cant go back until im healed so my only income right now is these checks. They have had this check on hold for a week now because they are worried it’s fraud. Im out of reserve cash and have had to steal food the last 3 days because this bank has a hold on all of my money. If they struggle this bad verifying a check from a huge and reputable insurance company how bad are they going to struggle with literally any other type of transaction? All this happened maybe 10 minutes after opening the account too so that’s important to note. Dont waste your time with this awful excuse of a bank they will put unnecessary holds on your money and then get frustrated with you when it causes you a problem. Ended up in a whole argument with customer service because they were genuinely acting like children, got super frustrated with me for not being okay with what theyre doing and told me to go make some actual money if its that important (this is after ive told them i cant even use my left hand or wrist), just treated me like absolute garbage. By far the worst banking experience ive ever had. I havent even been able to use the account to see how i like it theyve had all of my money held up since i opened it. Honestly having all of your money in cash is a better option than banking here they will screw you over hard and tell you to accept it because its part of their procedure.

reviews.t: App will not verify debit card on Apple Wallet
reviews.x: I have spoken to customer service about this ongoing problem and even the automated phone system indicates that my phone number it’s valid and verified with the account., yet the app will not verify their debit card on the Apple wallet stating that My phone number cannot be verify. It’s seems that Capital One’s security team discriminate with account holders who are on Mint Mobile, Tracfone or any prepaid cellphone plan. Another issue that I’m encountered right now is the verification of an external bank account to transfer money to and from. I did the process step-by-step as instructed and I even was able to transfer a test amount from the external account to the Capital One 360 account and it’s not showing up. I closed the mobile app and open it again and now It keeps indicating that I need to verified the account by a certain date or they will close the account. Bringing these issues to customer service it’s futile as they have no answer or a solution to fix this.

reviews.t: Still unable to see funds in my account
reviews.x: My girlfriend and I opened a CD and savings account with capitol one on 9/25. Both accounts were setup as joint holders. After multiple attempts to setup the accounts (and several calls to authenticate myself, my login to access the accounts doesn’t work. I login and receive a message stating there is an issue with one of my accounts, contact customer service. I contact customer service and they authenticate me yet again and state everything is setup correctly with my account. If I click on any button or link in the site I receive a message “oops we’ve hit a snag”. This has been a poor experience. I am going to close my accounts with capitol one and go back to Wells Fargo

Hello I’ve been using this mobile app for a very long time and I have loved it up until this past week. Ever since the update has been made capital one has change the feature for me to be able to make a payment when I want to. I have called into capital one and voiced my concern, but I haven’t gotten anywhere. This matter has gone all the way up to tech-support escalations and unfortunately they stated that there’s nothing that can be done because if I want to make a payment prior to my statement being cut, I have to sign into the Web portal of capital one to do so. so please explain to me why I would have the mobile app if I still have to sign into the Web portal? Also, why are you restricting me from making payments when I want to make payments? I feel that’s very unethical. Customers should be able to make payments when they want to not when capital one wants them to.

The camera deposit feature is not working properly. I will first start by saying I have submitted a check using the picture feature before and it worked, but just recently the app keeps saying the photos are too blurry and not good enough. I have tried taking pictures with two different devices, an iPhone 12 and iPad mini newest model and still does not work. In addition, I tried with a black background in 3 different areas of light, in auto mode and manual mode at different lengths away from the check, cleaning the camera lens, and holding my breathe while taking it in case I was moving slightly. None of these worked and still said too blurry and not good enough. This is probably an issue from an update and hopefully will be fixed soon but for now it’s a major feature that doesn’t work.

I am enrolled in college. I received a refund check for the funds left over from my financial aid and student loans after my tuition was paid. I deposited the check using the mobile deposit feature within the app. The check cleared immediately, the same day, but I received an email from Capital One saying that they are delaying the availability of the funds. According to them, they have confidential information that indicates that the check might be returned unpaid. There is absolutely no way the check will be returned, it already cleared, and it is from a reputable source; the payment processor for my college. I never had this problem with the previous bank that I was using. I switched to this bank because it has a good reputation but I am regretting the decision. I probably should have cashed the check at a check cashing place for $5 and then just made a deposit. I am extremely dissatisfied with this bank and I might switch to another over this. Beware of this bank’s policy on checks deposited via mobile deposit. There is no confidential information indicating that this check might be returned, this bank is just outright lying.

3 times in four months my card has been compromised with a false charges. In each event, the card was deactivated and the assurance of a new card being re-issued was given me. However in this last security breach no card was issued. upon checking I was told it hadn’t been re-issued because they needed my approval.. which is absurd since that was part and parcel of deactivating the compromised card. Since each fraud event had reoccurred so quickly after each re-issuance, I was assured that the case would receive a thorough investigation and the results sent to me. That never happened nor did the fraud department in any of these security breaches informed me that my new card number would have been available to me immediately simply by accessing my account on capital one’s app or website. Since these simple solution based protocols were never afforded me I have spent four months needlessly contacting vendors, or being contacted by them with concerns over the card deactivations. Regardless of other enticements, I can’t trust their capacity to keep fully informed as is essential in these matters.

reviews.t: The card of many chances and the app that gets things done
reviews.x: I am now embarking on a journey of keeping my credit profile clean by staying on top of my finances. After a significant life event, the capital one team have been forgiving and modern. The app design is accessible, easy to navigate and offer many ways to link with other payment vendors. This is helpful for days I don’t want to deal with carrying extra baggage. However, the verification process is daunting and when I had a emergency and needed cash fast, I was left without access to my balance due to slow verification processes. I would like to see how the theft and loss of a mobile device can be made quicker with this product in relation to customer verification processes. As someone who is differently abled, this will show tolerance and inclusion. Thanks #sandracoinent as seen on LinkedIn

I have been using this mobile app for several years with only a few technical hiccups every now and then. But the latest update is *terrible*. When you make a mobile deposit with the current version, it won’t let you view the check images to be sure they are clear and acceptable. The auto capture has never worked right, so you need to take it manually. Not a big deal, but being able to view the check image was a very helpful feature. Please add it back! Also, Capital One requires quite a few updates that don’t seem to be about security. Every time you turn around, it forces you to do an update, many of which seem unnecessary. It would be nice if they could stick to security only updates and leave everything else that works well alone.

Infuriating that the check deposit doesn’t work.. happens every time I get a paycheck. I’ve taken dozens of pictures with different lighting and backgrounds and it just states that it’s too blurry.. I can read the numbers in the 1 cm long picture, it’s not blurry. Eventually itll take after sometimes up to 100 tries (literally) but next paycheck, I have to deal with this again. App is otherwise well designed but this is a huge inconvenience. Customer support is useless and just tells me to drive to a bank or atm (both 2+ hours away) just to deposit a check. I wish they’d at least have the option to put in numbers or have a human confirm that the numbers are readable/manually input the check values. Otherwise, I have incredibly limited options for depositing my paychecks. If this isn’t fixed in the near future, I’m gonna be opening an account somewhere else.

So this was my first credit card and I’ve really loved the cash back and rewards they offer with various brands and stores. But what amazed me to the point I stopped using another bank was interest in both checking and savings. It’s been a real lifesaver and good place to raise your savings amount especially, but the checking is fair. I really like the app, too. It’s easy to get around and into, and honestly I’ve only had one dispute in the 7 months I’ve been with C1. Sure they don’t have a physical branch in every location but a lot of ATMs work with them. So if anyone is looking to get a credit card to start off with credit or need a good bank account that is secure and offers rewards, I think this is it. Btw this is not a promotion, it’s my personal experience with them :)

Thank you for giving me a chance whenever we first started and for you trusting in me I will never do you wrong cause you never 👎 dead me wrong and I’m a member for life and I’m happy I gain your trust and I got into credit cause I lien be the best in wateva I do lol just like everyone else but we helping each other and I’m going goign to continue to show you I will never do you wrong on god and I want the same type love amen or we come in middle Yu know how it go whoever reading this and thanks 🙏 and one to be one your best partner you work with and when I have 10 to 15 in this wan tto talk to boss long boss or ceo 👩‍💼 👨‍💼 that all I ask for this my document to show you .and I agree to my part already just waiting 10 or 15 and Ima see how loyal you is to me as I’m is you you thanks 🙏 Anthony they call me ron ron and I speak only for me and I’m a carrying person and I just wan to prove to you I will never do you wrong just work with me and we will never have a problem nice talking to you lol 💯🤝

I love Capital one, have been a loyal customer for ages, but in my last trip abroad they proved to be as incompetent as the worst I have ever seen. I left my credit card at home and called the number in the card. I was told that they would issue a new card and that would take 10 to 12 working days to issue and 15 working days to get it to the country I was. REALLY? I was lucky to be able to transfer some money into my brother’s bank account. But what If I was in a country with no one I know? Buy the time the card arrives I am already back in the USA! You guys could do a lot better. Expedite the card. Use FedEx and help your customer. It seems you have some crystal generation people, unable to come with practical solutions. It’s a shame. Other than that I love all your other services. So woman up and get capable people to serve your customers efficiently. The real time I needed your help, you failed miserably. Thanks

Here’s how: Similar to the Apple Card app features, discover can work on improving displaying the available credit line by updating immediately after a payment. What keeps me using my Apple Card so often and making it my main daily card is the appeal of knowing exactly and live payments. Even if I max out my card, I can immediately pay off a portion and use that portion immediately, unlike discover where I’m unsure of the amount that’s due or available even though I just paid off a chunk. Additionally, seeing how much I need to pay off for the month and discover calculating how much interest that would mean if I don’t pay a certain amount. This helps and encourages me to pay off as much as possible while best making decisions on budgeting or what to expect for my finances. For example, I have $50 on my card from last month, discover can show live a dial/scale visually that depending how much I want to contribute to paying this off this month, I’ll get $X amount of interest for the following month. TLDR: -Live and immediate credit line availability (to the minute) -visual amount of interest possible if not paid -how much interest you accumulated over months/past year shown in one space

I have had Capital One probably since 2006 . I have never received an automatic increase in a credit line or offered any O percentage rate for a year maybe 16 months even. Discover does it all the time and I have had them for a much shorter time than Capital One. I am selling my home right now and my last youngest child just got married so I have used the car quite a bit to ready my home for selling and would enjoy maybe a 5k increase on my credit limit. I only use you and discover even though I have a much larger credit limit with them. But you presently are at 8.6 percent and soon won’t be competitive any longer. I did make this complaint before and a young lady did contact me but it just came up a number and I can’t quite locate it. I have never just paid minimum or missed a payment once in all the years I have had your card. I am an excellent customer but you don’t reward that at all. Discover does!

reviews.t: No online support, app authentication is useless for purchases
reviews.x: For huge company, and a card that advertises good travel benefits, it is embarrassingly poorly designed. There is no way to contact support online or through email, only phone, which is annoying and expensive while traveling. When making purchases internationally, I downloaded the app explicitly to give approval to my purchases as I won’t have access to my US phone number. However, I never see this option at any point where it matters. Capital One seems to know when I’m traveling, because when I am, the only approval / authentication option I ever see is text. Not email, not using the app. Because of the lack of online support, I am forced to leave this review here as opposed to actually getting help. What is the point of these features, if I am unable to choose the authentication option I am actually able to use!?

reviews.t: Capital One finance charge and interest rate charges
reviews.x: Dear Capital One Recently I forgot and missed a payment. I corrected the error as soon as I was made aware of my mistake. I made the payment plus interest and the finance charge. Once the payment was posted I contacted your firm to see if I could get the charges reversed since this was a one off error. Your firm graciously reversed those charges. Now the interesting part and my issue. I discovered you continue to accrue interest charges even though the account was brought up to date. I find this practice very concerning and very much contrary to recent rulings against other financial institutions. I understand the fine print that I was told “ well you agreed to the terms”, however I would argue that some high power attorneys would love a crack at this practice. Just a thought..

reviews.t: Great services, great app, but needs major improvement
reviews.x: The services capital one have are amazing, high interest rates on savings account, decent credit cards with good rewards, all tied together in a visually appealing easy to manage app. My main issue with said app however is how many time it tries to sell you something. It seems everytime I open up the app, i get at least two pop ups asking if I want to try a service either sponsored or created by capital one, I tell them no, proceed to check my checking account balance, just for them to ask the exact same prompt again with no way for me to avoid it. Please fix this, everything else is great but I would like a banking experience that is just that, a banking experience. Not a way to get me to use other products I’m not interested in using and have made that clear in the app.

I have been a customer for many years and never had a problem. Then I was traveling and received a text that my payment was due. So realized I must have forgot to pay my bill and I went online and made the payment right away. Got my next bill and it said my payment was late and charged me interest ( which I never pay, because I pay in full) and a late fee. So I call customer service and was told ya you must have made it after 8pm. I am pretty sure that was not the case as I remember we were eating supper. I asked him to look and he said at midnight it rolls over to post the next day. So which is it 8 pm or midnight? Either way I know I made the payment on time and they wouldn’t do anything about it. Which is fine I have another credit card we use for our business we will start using. Very disappointed and wish I would have known there was an 8pm cut off.

reviews.t: Make sure if you lose a card to call them and not report it through the app
reviews.x: I have 3 credit cards plus a auto loan through capital one. I reported one of my card’s missing through the app and reported I did not have the card in my possession. I received the card yesterday. Since it’s a platinum card I don’t have interest. I used the card last night as I do every month to keep building credit. When I checked the app this morning I noticed that my purchases last night was on a different card that has interest. I called and after trying to explain to the woman they sent me the wrong card (who was trying to convince me they didn’t) finally she admitted that something went wrong in their system and they sent out the wrong card. I asked if she could put my purchase from last night on the card they were supposed to send and of course she couldn’t. I asked to speak to a manager who got on the phone and was horribly rude. Kept talking over me, wouldn’t listen to my concerns, wouldn’t take responsibility for the mistake that she ADMITTED they made. I asked why they would send me a card with the same numbers as the one I lost. At first she tried saying it was my fault because I didn’t report the card was missing. Then she blamed me and the app. Then told me I should NOT have reported it on the app and I should have called. When I asked why they had the option on the app she giggled and said most people calls in. Then why have the option on the app?? These people takes 0 responsibility for their actions! I cut all my cards up and I’m going today to get a auto loan through my bank. The incompetence along with blaming the customer is horrible customer service!

reviews.t: Bad customer service and credit increase
reviews.x: My wife credit score is 728 she applied for capital one credit card 3 years ago they approved her for credit of $300 , she have never missed a payment or paid minimum amount , in all her credit cards her credit history is clean , other credit card companies approved her for $15,000 of credit line while we trying once every week to get credit line increased with Capital1, but they always turned her down, We contacted the customer service 4 times , the representative we talk to she was rude and she wasn’t helpful at all , so we asked for a supervisor she told us she can’t guarantee the the waiting time , which, every time we ask for a supervisor we get the same answer. We cannot guarantee the wait time but this time we waited for 34 minutes and never talk to a supervisor it’s like automatic answer the representative give us. Every time I ask for a supervisor it seem like their supervisors told them this is the answer you get to the customers deal with customers I guess

It is highly aggravating to have to continually rephotograph a government issued check that you are trying to deposit because “we can’t read the amount” is the excuse given over and over. You need to fix this issue !! it shouldn’t take over 10 mins to deposit one check because your system is so finicky and just forget it if you have multiple checks to deposit! I have done everything on my part to ensure the photo is taken as requested and it doesn’t matter, it will still say “We CaN’t ReAd ThE aMoUnT”…. do better Capital one I know this isn’t the first review regarding this matter and it won’t be the last until you DO SOMETHING ABOUT IT!!

Capital One has an interesting intersection of all the things that I want from a bank. They offer a competitive savings rate, they offer both checking and savings account while some competitors only offer “money” accounts, the majority of business can be handled digitally but they have physical branches if needed, and finally they have very competitive reward credit card offers. The only thing holding Capital One back in my eyes is the app. The options across the bottom are extremely basic, with the digital assistant being something that should live within the settings/help menu, not warranting its own button across the bottom. I think other banks have optimized their navigation bar slightly better, with an option for credit cards, banking, loans, investing, and more. Ideally, a home button, a banking button, a credit/loans button, an investing button, and a settings button should be the five places to navigate to through the navigation bar. Additionally, adding a feature to have vaults where I can create sub-accounts within my savings account so that I can customize and control how I save for specific things would be an incredible addition.

I got the capital one silver card, because I needed a new line of credit (to maintain a good credit score). Once I received the card I found out about all these “perks”. The only good thing about this card is, 1.5% cash back on everything. Their “member exclusive” deals, are RIP OFFS (unless you don’t mind staying in decrepit roach-motels, & renting catfished junker-cars). DO NOT EVER USE CAPITAL ONE TRAVEL. The cash back is NOT worth it. They work with slum-lords, that don’t maintain the rentals (property/hotels & the vehicles, both). You’re placed in/with UNACCEPTABLY UNSANITARY rentals. Then you’re STUCK paying TOO MUCH for it - because it was “booked through a third party.” I’ve never used capital one travel to fly. But after the experience I’ve had with their other travel aspects - I have no interest in utilizing their flight. Not to mention, they charge more than Booking, Expedia & Travelocity.

I’ve been a Capital One customer for nearly 20 years was grandfathered in from ING direct to capital one. Our issues begin with a capital one 360 checking account. I like the free checking feature into debit cards with the last few years. Whenever we attempt to use the debit card purchases are declined and we can’t use the debit MasterCard as intended. Upon calling capital one customer service we were told “you don’t use your debit cards enough so we’ve declined these various attempts” for fraud suspicions .. using a debit card linked and unless you use your card more frequently… It might be best to look for another financial institution…to meet your needs.” Allow me to continue. For a few years I was pleased with the interest I was earning and the ease of access for savings however, within the last year two I noticed my savings interest rate was stuck at 0.30 and I heard other people mention the great rate that capital one was paying for their savings account 3 or 4%. Upon further investigation, I found out this rate was only offered to “new accounts in new customers. “yet a long time customer like myself did not get the increased rate because my account is in a “old “status. To say the least I’m very unimpressed that Cap One blocks purchases using the debit card we were given for these accounts. And that injury to insured with thousands of dollars in their savings account I’m not given the higher savings rate offered to new customers but yet disfavored as a long time loyal customer for nearly 2 decades with a substantially lower rate in savings. Hmmm..Makes sense right? Poor business tactics and customer experience . Going elsewhere

Opened new account. Too many hoops to jump through. First, they tell me it takes 5 days to access my account because it might be fraudulent. Secondly, they tell me my phone number isn’t registered in my name (which it is). Thirdly, they tell me in essence that my account won’t be opened to services other than deposits (how convenient) for 30 days. Take my money but I am not a real customer until after 30 days. Fourthly, I received two separate emails on the same day at the same exact time contradicting each other as to when my funds will be available. Their explanation was that the emails were sent from different departments. And finally, I have not received any paper info regarding my account other than a text to a number they said didn’t belong to me. If it doesn’t get better soon I am closing this account very soon. Didn’t experience this with Navy Federal or Truist. I wanted to take advantage of their returns on their 360 account; but now I feel it isn’t worth it.

Capital One is simply the very best. This is the credit card that everyone should possess. Their response time to what seemed out of the ordinary for them and myself is nothing short of with the quickness. I’m grateful to have the Capital One team behind me as I traverse thru life with this card. In this day and age of hackers, you simply must monitor your account on a daily basis, almost an hourly basis. Capital one notified me of a suspicious charge and within minutes of notification and my response, my card was cancelled ( Thank goodness), and a new card is being shipped out. Thanks! Capital One and your fraud team for staying on top of not just my activity, but thousands of people who have Capital One credit cards in their pockets. Again, Capital One is simply the very best.

Opened a new Capital One account to replace a credit union account and get decent interest again. Looking forward to being able to manage account online. After doing the whole set up thing, I find that I can’t use the app for anything besides looking at my account because they can’t verify my mobile phone on my 10+ year Verizon account. I got an error message with a slew of things that might be wrong. Fast forward past an hour of sleuthing and trying to get through to a person on their horrible phone bot, and they tell me that I won’t be able to use the app which doesn’t happen until sometime around a month, but no promises as to when. They promise this is their normal procedure! So, I have a bank account but no way to use it. Phone svc is a joke. The nearest physical location is not close AND has terrible reviews. Looking elsewhere. Save yourself a hassle and skip Capital One.

I just got off the phone with one of your customer service representatives. I had a problem and several questions I needed help with. She was able to solve my problem and answered all my questions in a very polite and professional manner. I failed to write down her name but she did an excellent job. I just wanted to take a moment to praise the service that we receive on our Capital One Venture Card. My wife and I we were just talking about how pleasant it is to call about a question or a problem, and the pleasant response we receive. They’ve always been able to help us with any problem or questions that we have. and it is a real pleasure to call and have someone who is pleasant and actually knows what or how to solve a problem or answer a question. Thank you. Jim H

reviews.t: The capital one 360 savings account is a NIGHTMARE!!!
reviews.x: I saw online that capital one had a high yield savings account so I thought I’d try it…I deposited 3500$ but nothing happened for days so I tried again this time 4500 nothing happened for days so I stupidly I tried again next thing I knew it said 12,000$ in my account 0 avail…and 3500 was taken out of my bank with 2 32$ fees all of which saying capital one credit card payment ..when I call I ask why it says credit card payment and no one can tell me why..also they took the 3500 over 5 days ago via bank transfer and it’s STILL not available I’ve called several times and no one can tell me anything also there saying that there’s no records of any fees ..we’ll my bank statement says it clear as day -32$ for capital one credit card payment and I don’t even have a credit card …no one can help me I spoke to a manager who was RUDE and told me she “expedited” my problem and someone would reach out to me in 60 days!!! WHAT??!!! Does anyone know of anything I can do? This whole process has been a nightmare

Just want to start by saying that we have had our account with Capital One for several years now and normally have had great service. However, today, my wife tried calling in regards to a check we deposited through the app yesterday. We got an email last night saying they were putting a hold on it for a week. Never before has this happened, so my wife called and was treated very rudely by a manager no less. We are going through a rough time at the moment and really need the money and they would not work with us in depositing the check for us. We really needed it this week for bills. If you are planning on depositing a check, I do not recommend using the app because according to the manager, this happens quite regularly to check for fraud. We have been members for several years and our check came from our church, which we have deposited before with no problem. It is very upsetting. If you need your money pretty quick, don’t take the chance of this app or bank helping you.

reviews.t: Capital One is still destroying ING
reviews.x: I’ve been a customer of ING/Capital One for over 20 years. I introduced countless people to the bank and the savings accounts with the fantastic rates. At some point, Capital One changed my interest rate from being the one they advertise on their website, to being 0.3%. I found out last night. I didn’t get an apology. I didn’t get a remedy. I got nothing. I was told my accounts were “old”. (Read, I am unworthy to them.) Even though my accounts had the savings rate offered by the bank for over two decades, now I was not eligible for that rate. Again, because I have been a loyal customer, trusting Capital One with my savings for longer than the customer service person that I spoke to has been alive. I have many. Many. Savings accounts with Capital One. If I want to get the rate situation that I have always had, I have to manually close all of these accounts and set up new ones. As well as their savings plans. When I asked if I would be notified if this change was made in the future, I was told that I can check the website each day for the rates. Which I did, for years. Because the rate on the website, was the rate on my accounts. Until, at some point, it wasn’t. I logged in expecting a year of interest at a refreshing 3%. A good bit of money. But, no. There were pennies of interest. Why can this behavior exist?

reviews.t: Great to start with, but no increases even with perfect payment history
reviews.x: I started to rebuild my credit with this card. They gave a $300 limit. Fine. I needed a start. Paid everything off, in full, always a week before the payment date. No credit increases in one year! So then, I requested an increase, and they only increased to $800. So it’s a great card to start to rebuild - but now I have cards with $6000 limits & cash back options- that I will use before this one. If they increased my limit to something other than a measly $800 I would use the card more frequently. After a solid 3 years of payment- never once late- and a ‘very good’ credit score now, I shouldn’t have to ask for an increase. It’s great to start, but $800 after 3 solid years is blah.

Their customer service is the best. They are very patient. I’ve been with them for many years . I recommend them to everyone. Yesterday when I called the customer service The person that helped me was named Vino. Vino was so good that when he got finished helping me I ask if I could please speak to his supervisor because he was so patient and knowledgeable and helpful and had the patience of Job. When I spoke to the supervisor I told her that we were on the phone for about 30 minutes with him helping me and because he was so patient and thorough that if they were looking for a great training audio for their new people to learn how to provide great customer service they should save that conversation as a training tool to develop more excellent customer service people like Vino thank you.

Why do I say that? Because every time I talk to one of their team, they are knowledgeable AND even more noticeable is they “listen to their customers”….. I am a normal person, 59 years old. I had a very successful career with 2 companies, that didn’t make me rich, no where near that, but I travel extensively for business, but Nation and Globally. Not luxurious travel by any means, but travel that brought several banks and credit cards in my name over the years. Capital One clearly stands above the rest. AMEX was my benchmark, but with Age comes Wisdom (they say..). With today’s technologies and scams, they are kind and understanding how easy it for me accidentally “click” and advertisement, authorize a $0.99 charge, only to find out a month or so later that I inadvertently received subsequent charges for +$100 and they kill it!

Great card to have in case of emergency, I’ve had my Platinum card since 2019 and with a great credit score they do not have a high limit for this card. I try to keep my spending below 10% so with a 600 credit limit that only leaves me a 60 dollar window. So I only use this card when I absolutely need to cause we all know the best way to get your credit score high is to spend below 10% and pay off your credit every month. They should reevaluate there limit terms because if the limit was higher I would definitely use it more often. Also, don’t like being ignored when ask for a credit increase. It will say request a increase and know within a few hours and twice I have asked for an increase and heard nothing back from them. This card is the only card that I have that has under 4,000 dollar limit.

I was so happy when I opened these accounts. I’ve been rebuilding my credit awhile when I got the Platinum card. Everything was great. Upgraded after receiving an offer for the Quicksilver. Loved it and the Cashback incentive at first. With tax time, came extra spending. I paid my plumber and maxed out my card which isn’t the norm for me. However, paying the entire balance off is. I paid it off a few days later and it got locked. I sat on the phone with them for a half hour to verify my info with I assume the fraud department. Transaction 2 to the same place, locked totally after I made the payment. This time, I had to call and verify with the credit card department. Then we had to call my bank I made the payment from to see if that was my account as well. Keeping in mind, they don’t deny the transaction, which would make more sense. They keep locking it after I make a payment. What good does that do?? Add this issue to my deposit issues. I have a paycheck every two weeks. Every single time I deposit it, it’s so called “risky.” The company banks with Bank of America. Definitely a big bank. My first deposit was held an entire week. They’re excuse is I hadn’t deposited one before. I guess them picking up a phone to verify funds doesn’t make sense. Now when I deposit it, they split my check and don’t give it all to me at once. I feel like they’re scamming interest on my funds. Why else would a bank today need to hold funds? This is the electronic age after all…Lastly, the customer service people sound so annoyed when I call in. How do they think I feel having to call in weekly to verify my name, address and social security number??

reviews.t: Tough times call for tough measures
reviews.x: I am so pleased to report that I had a sincere sympathetic representative name, Pedro, who listen to me for an hour he listen to me cry and weep on the phone about my financial burdens and about my personal life chaos, but even through all the darkness he was able to talk me through to reaching to the light and understanding that they were there to listen to me and all my concerns I’ve been a dedicated customer trying to pay my monthly payments for my vehicle and have yet to miss one payment and I’m hitting financial disability and employment loss that I just couldn’t breathe and was so worried that my car would be taken away from me next another failure in my life however Pedro talked me through everything and the exciting part was that we have discovered that I had a gap insurance coverage that I didn’t get to use and has not yet expired and I was drowning myself in another major car repairs as my vehicle has just recently broke down. Shout out to Mr. Pedro who took the time to listen to me!!

reviews.t: Bad app, bad customer service, bad card
reviews.x: This app is a perfect example of how unsophisticated most Americans are. We have been fed garbage for so long that we can’t identify it when it is right in front of our face. To start with, any utility app that interrupts a customer’s operation with pop-ups, ads, or requests to do some thing other than the user’s intended activity should automatically start at a 2-star rating. Capital One then sinks to a one-star rating because the help menu constantly crashes. And when it is working, it has the worst virtual assistant of any bank I have ever used. On top of all of that, the app is not sophisticated enough to give you accurate pay-off information. For instance, if I pay off my balance but then make one more purchase before the current billing cycle is over, their data base will tell me that this purchase’s due date is the current billing cycle, not the next. This is a common problem, and most customers never notice it. But Citi and USAA have figured it out, so there’s no excuse as to why banks the size of Capital One have not. I see the Capital One commercials all the time, figured that they must be a decent company, just because of their size. And then REI switched to this bank, and I just assumed that REI knows what they’re doing. But I can’t think of a single aspect of this transition that has gone smoothly. Maybe I’m just lucky to have started banking with USAA 50 years ago, so I’ve been sheltered from the cruft and friction that everyone else is accustomed to. It’s a bummer that I’m gonna lose out on part of my REI reward this year and going forward. But my time is worth way more than a 3-figure rebate at the end of the year. Additionally, I have filed a complaint REI, informing them that this unnecessary transition reflects poorly on their management’s decision making.

reviews.t: Horrible Customer Service & Charges Wrong Account
reviews.x: I’ve had the app since I got my account there & everything had been alright but this is now the second time they’ve charged the wrong account. They allow you to have multiple payment options & I have two bank accounts I use to pay. First time it happened was a small amount so I just let it go. I made my payment in the app & selected the account I wanted to charge & it charged the other account instead. The second time this happened is when I got upset. Because it was a large amount & so since it charged the wrong account with insufficient funds my bank charged me $35 for not having enough funds. I contacted my bank about it & they said I had to contact Capital One since it was their app being faulty. Their customer service is horrible. I’ve explained the situation multiple times & they aren’t even listening to what I’m explaining. They keep cutting me off when I’m explaining my issue saying that it’s not their fault. I told them this isn’t the first time this has happened & I keep getting cut off & put on hold. I’m a very patient person so I don’t mind taking time to figure it out but the lady helping me keeps trying to get me off the phone & not help. I asked to talk to someone who can help me better & she kept telling me no one can help better. I asked if I could be transferred to someone who deals with errors that happen in the app & she said she would but they wouldn’t be able to help. I’m really frustrated that their customer service is so difficult to deal with & that the app was being faulty. Capital One needs to do better.

reviews.t: Great card for learning and building credit
reviews.x: I love my capital one card, and all of its benefits. One downside is the capital one shopping, you have to have it on a desktop computer, it doesn’t work on your cell phone well. I shop at retailers listed in the rewards section often yet I do not get my rewards due to not going through the app even though I used my card to purchase in store. When I attempt to purchase items with Capital One shopping through the app by choosing the retailer are usually have issues and glitches, which makes the discount more difficult than it’s worth, it also will not allow you to go to the retailer through the Capital One app, and still use other reward sites such as the retailers rewards program or discount apps, such as retail me not. Overall, the card is great for someone looking to open the door to credit building and apply for their first credit line without a lot of hidden fees and sky high interest rates. I usually recommend this card to people who don’t know much about credit as capital one doesn’t have tons of crazy fees like most cards nor do they misrepresent any of the features. This card is a great start to learning how credit works as it offers valuable information and articles to read, as well as helps you build credit worthiness. Once you get a capital one card, all the credit card companies will be coming for you so don’t fall victim to a bad credit card, get a capital one instead! I wish the shopping feature worked in a different manner but I highly recommend this card to anyone looking to build creditworthiness, however, don’t expect a large credit limit, even if you make all of your payments on time. I’ve had an account with them for a few years now, and they will approve me for new Capital One cards. However, they won’t raise the limit on my current cards, which makes no sense to me, I guess that’s just how the credit game works!

This app truly has everything you could possibly need. I have another card app (my husband had it from before we married) and it annoys me at how far behind in the game they are when compared to Capital One. Everything is easy to find and just makes sense to have the feature where it’s at. I can easily find any scheduled payments I’ve made. It tells me if I’m about to make an additional payment from minimum set payment. Any notification I need, I have. And they send to my phone like they’re designed to. They have virtual card in case I’m in a situation where I don’t have or want my card on me (touristy situations or when I’m shopping in bed on Friday night instead of going out 😊). It’s just a really great app. I feel the same way about Capital One as a company too.

reviews.t: Decent app, some nice features, one major flaw
reviews.x: Basically what I say in the title of this review, it’s a decent app, it has some good features. I like the credit score option. HOWEVER, their add cash in store feature has never worked for me. I was so excited when I saw this feature, it’s one thing that’s a definite problem with a mostly online bank, not being able to deposit cash specially when they don’t have any branches or their “cafes” nearby. I’ve called about this twice now, the first person I spoke to from the bank in Dec. 22 seemed to think it was just an issue that only I was experiencing but that they’d pass on the concern to the tech department. The second person I spoke to in late Jan. When the problem still wasn’t fixed said it was an issue others were having and they were working on fixing it. Here we are over 2 months later and no progress thatvI know of… Capital One, please fix this.

I’ve been a loyal customer for over 20 years racked up big purchases to get points. I don’t know where they decided to freeze my account because of so much activity then they wanted me to send them over different items to verify. It was me my drivers license they wanted a copy of my Social Security card. I sent them a copy of the Social Security card in a text picture they wouldn’t except it. They wanted a picture of the original Social Security card. I could not find my original Social Security card. All I had was a picture from my income taxes I asked him that I would apply for a new Social Security card because of Covid and other unforeseen things, Social Security and take anywhere from 3 to 6 months to get a copy of my search In the meantime, they won’t cooperate with me. I have $650 more or less of rewards money and they won’t give it to me. They say I’m going to lose it. No matter who I talk to they say that’s their policy.

Capital one has been a very reputable and dedicated company each representative I’ve talked with is nice and knowledgeable. Especially nihja if u have the pleasure of working with her she took so much extra time to help me a young person new into credit. Serialist an amazing worker that cares about the client bravo. My only complaint is there elongated periods of waiting for system processing. My card was restricted for a non- breachable withdrawal. I’ve spoken to a assistant each day. I understand it takes time to process especially in the regards to their security. However I am in a financial emergency and the process has stayed the same. My only critique if u will (from a Harvard business student) is they need to have easier access to managers to sort out peoples financial emergencies and especially discrepancies with faster care. All things considered great company just need more personalized and capable workers to have access to.

reviews.t: Great, but stop taking away features
reviews.x: The Capital One app is great. I love being able to see my accounts and easily make payments or access digital cards for online shopping. However, there is one GLARING issue for me. They keep taking functionalities away. Such as being able to see your actual card number or being able to reorder the appearance of your accounts on the page. Why did you remove the ability to arrange the order of the accounts on the Capital One app? At first it was fine because my accounts were in the order I wanted until I added another savings account and couldn’t organize it properly. It was a great functionality; why take it away from users? Now you’ve also changed the order they appear in to credits cards first, then checking, then savings. Thats’s absurd and incredibly frustrating. I want to see my accounts in a specific order because it helps me budget. You organizing them for me is NOT helpful at all. You have a credit card I don’t even use as one of the first three listed and all my important accounts at the bottom. Give users the freedom they had before by allowing us to choose the order our accounts appear in.

reviews.t: I’m here to review the APP not the company
reviews.x: As an APP, it’s not bad. The only annoyance, right now, is that it keeps reordering my accounts. I like seeing my bank accounts up top, but it keeps moving my credit card accounts to the top. I go in to reorder them, then save, close out, come back in & it’s back to credit cards up top. Highly annoying. Otherwise, it is easy to deposit checks on this app, it is easy to transfer, easy to pay credit cards, easy to make payments, easy to update information - no complaints about this. Never crashes, Face ID always works, etc. On a side note, people shouldn’t be reviewing the company itself on this forum here. Go somewhere like Credit Karma or NerdWallet to do that. The Apple App Store is for APPS…

I’ve been a capital one credit card customer for a long time. I love this card because it has very good customer service, it’s easy to contact a human customer service representative. They’re always courteous and helpful. I feel that with capital one I’m well protected from fraud and scams. I switched my banking to capital one last year after banking with another bank for 15 years. I am very satisfied with capital one 360. Your money earns better interest compared to other banks. The only set back I can think of is their lack of a physical branches. However, it does not impact on their services because you can do things on line. They have convenient ATM affiliates that you can use without paying ATM fees.

This app is easy to use and incredibly useful. I set it to notify me if so much as a penny is charged to any of my cards, so it’s like an instant receipt. I feel so safe because if there is a fraudulent charge, I can immediately lock my cards thru the app (I can even report it lost or stolen too!). I use the app to check my credit score thru Credit Wise, to make payments, view my transactions, view my statements. It’s essentially all of the information I’d need from the desktop site but on my phone. The only time I use the desktop site is when I’m booking a flight with my miles. I highly recommend this app is you have a Capital One card.

I had a acc with you and we had some difficult last yr with payment method. My family wanted give me a gift to pay on the credit card I had with you. I understand that you need verification of acc from the ones who were going to make a payments for me for a Gift. I’m an honest person and I , myself, made the payments and paid it off. Then I got a notice that they needed to verify some more information on my acc to continue with the card. So i did and all the person at the time that I spoke to only needed to verify my bank. This was in a Saturday so I had to wait until it reopened. When I did call back on a week day they still wanted to verify the other two bank accounts which I went thru the same thing as I did after receiving the card. I’ve never missed a payment and I had paid more than the amount requested. I’ve shredded the card. I thank you for your time. Jenette Williams

This is my first (very first ) credit card I got them last year nov2022 and honestly I thought after I got sick and lost my job they was going to harass me (They did not) I told them what was going on and they let me get back on my feet kid you not I just paid my card off in full with no hard feelings from Capital!!!!!
