They suggested a low payment $67 bucks but at the time I couldn’t afford it I’m a single mother… so they offer lower but this time I had it to pay it off in full the customer service I want to point out was more concerned about my health (I love it) my agent didn’t start the conversation off with you owe this nor did she say “I’m sorry for or unfortunately… she was actually asking how I was and made small talk it made my day I read all these bad reviews it’s many ppl that need to stop BSing and pay they bill. But my experience after 2 months missed payments they still cared about me and waiting me to stay and catch up is why I payed full and I still get to have capital on my side Thx for reading YOU ROCK CAPITAL ONE WALMART REWARDS

I got my first capital one card about a year and a half ago and after applying several times was FINALLY accepted! Was sooo happy that I had a card with cash back ! At that time they gave me $300 limit within three months of having the card they gave me an $800 limit and a couple months ago raised it again to a $3300 limit!! I cannot tell you how much I love this card !!! I have saved so much money on the cash back rewards . So recently I applied for another capital one card that had a $200 cash back reward if you spent $500 in three months also a 15 month no apr time frame. I decided to get it because I needed dental work done that my insurance wouldn’t pay for so I got accepted with a $10,000 limit!!! I am beyond grateful for these cards as I have worked VERY hard on my credit in the last 3/4 years and it has definitely paid off!!!! Thank you capital one for all you do !!!

reviews.t: Don’t bother with Capital One apparently some pending transaction don’t show up on your account
reviews.x: What’s the point in having an app that is suppose to track your transactions so you keep track of how much you are spending if it doesn’t show all your transactions. Everytime before I use my card I check the app to see my available credit. I checked it last night used my card and woke up today and was told I was over my credit limit. I check my account there is only two pending transactions my balance on my account shows I have credit limit but when I call into Capital One I’m told there’s a pending transaction that only they can see. It’s not showing on my transaction list on the app but they can see it and it caused me to go over my credit limit. Any transaction is suppose to show on the app. I have two capital one cards and I’m about to cancel both of them. Never had a credit card or banking app pick and choose which transactions to show customers.

This review is for my experience with the Capital One App and the Capital One Money App. My Son (13) wanted a debit card with his name on it. I searched and reviewed every single one I could. I settled on the Capital One Money card because it's the ONLY card that puts a minors name on the actual card! THIS IS HUGE FOR A TEEN! And to be honest, this is the only reason I chose the Capital One Money card, but I swear I am not disappointed. I had a capital one 360 account before opening the Money card for my son so I was a bit more comfortable with keeping $ with them. Any who...There are WAY to many options to this card to mention in this review so I'll touch on the best reasons. First-my son has a debit/credit card with his name on it! Woooohoo! Second-I have full control of what goes in and what goes out! Oh and third-It offers Zelle transfer so his Grandparents and other friends/family can send him cash!!

I have my car loan with this company, due to the fact that in 2016 I lost my job and didn’t get a permanent position until 2018. This caused my credit rating to go down. I was grateful that in 2018 I was able to get my car thru this company even though it was at a high interest rate so it wasn’t like they were helping me out for nothing in return. I never was late or missed a payment in 3 yrs of having their car loan. However in November of 2021 I had emergency surgery and was out of work for 2 months with a serious health issue and I called them to see if they could defer my car payment for one month until I got all my bills situated. They told me that at the time, this was not an option. A year later, I end up in the hospital again for surgery (due to complications), again I call them to see if they can defer the payment and I was told no, this company does not offer deferments. I was so mad that I told them that after I pay this car off, I will never do business with them. I also have a small credit card with them that I intend to pay off because in this day and age of COVID and high inflation, I can’t fathom a company that is not willing to help out a customer. It isn’t like I was asking them to erase a car payment, I was just asking to defer it. I e had other car loans who have done it and they will defer it for at least 3 request. Yes, I paid it off too!!!!

Over a year ago, I switched all my banking accounts to Capital One for the sole reason that their technology is the best I had experienced and put my bank, at the time, to shame. The app works seamlessly with all of my various CapOne banking products and the experience is extremely intuitive. I was recently offered a card with a competitor and gave it a try earning the free points for travel, but immediately resumed using Capital One as the competitor’s technology was atrocious. And in fact, will not bother with such offers again as a cumbersome experience is not worth it, to me. On top of the great experience through the app and online, I get stellar service whenever I call in. Keep up the great job CapOne!

reviews.t: App has potential but doesn’t cut it
reviews.x: I’ve been banking with capital one since early 2020, back then all I had was a credit card and for that sole purpose the app was amazing, I had zero complaints with my capital one credit card. The issues began when I opened a debit card account with them, in the beginning everything sounded great, no maintenance fees, no minimum, no overdraft fees, get paid up to two days early I mean the card had the whole package whoever it’s short comings were quickly revealed through the way the mobile app processes transactions. I’m not sure if it’s the financial institutions fault or just the way the app runs but I feel like the way it processes transactions is completely misleading, for example when I use my funds they immediately are deducted from my available balance and goes into processing status, obviously since it’s already been deducted from my available balance I know that it’s money already spent and since it’s gone i obviously can’t use it or go over my available balance. A day or two passes by the transactions finally start chipping at my present balance as they normally should, I use my card sparingly so of course my available balance won’t see much change, but then out of no where usually at night time I’m trying to take a cab for example and it says card declined, impossible because I should have more then enough funds and I track my spending meticulously, I check the app and sure enough I’m like negative $85 with no valid reason. It’s extremely frustrating and customer service has no explanation except “the transactions are processing you’ll need to wait a few hours for everything to post”, and the funniest part is the next day I wake up my bank account is fully stocked with the money that went missing. I’m very sick of this app and my checking account, im going to be moving all my funds back to chase and closing my capital one accounts soon, you guys have failed me way too many times.

The app now requires a text or requires me to tap my card to verify it’s me each time I sign in using FaceID. While I’m all for stronger security, this process is silly to me because the texts go to my phone that I signed in with, so it slows the sign in process without adding any security. If it were going to another device, that’d be more secure, but all the text verification does is add taps and texts I need to do. Plus if I’m traveling abroad this process costs me money because texts abroad aren’t free. Give the option to opt out of two factor authorization if the app is on the phone that’s used for the authorization. Also, Cap One, you already have me as a customer, please stop trying to upsell me in the app, I just want to manage my credit card, not add a browser extension or buy event tickets, and it’s great that you enable me to open new accounts in the app but don’t keep begging me to. I don’t need a reminder of how to do it every two weeks, my answer hasn’t changed in that short time.

reviews.t: Capital One Scams on my Credit Card
reviews.x: I have over $4,000 dollars in scam monies that I have taken the money out of my bank accounts and paid off my credit cards every time I’m asked to pay it! My statements show where Capital One has gotten my money back from all of these scam companies and I have talked to probably every person in that department & I have received maybe $100 dollars of scam monies but in my case after spending a minimum of 2 hours on the phone with the ladies in that department and all of their apologies I have only received maybe $100 dollars! It shows that they received my money back from the scam companies but it doesn’t go back on my card & I have received what little money I have received after spending 2 hours on the phone with them & then it’s $2, $5.95, etc., mot to mention the monies I have received for sales from my company, the girls tried telling me that that was part of the reimbursement. It’s my money for items sold! This has gotten completely out of hand and these issues have to be addressed! Right now my Capital One card is being charged from a Walmart store somewhere in Arizona & there’s two sets of charges. I can’t keep chasing my money & I need it back in my bank account! I made that extremely clear to the last agent I discussed all of these issues with & told her not to put any money that she might manage to get back for me, to not put it in my credit card account & the very next morning there it was added to my credit card! I am extremely upset & I want my money that I pulled out of my bank accounts to cover all of these scams only to not be reimbursed and ignored at my requests! Please take care of this matter & have all monies owed me mailed to me in a check so I can get my business money back in the bank where it belongs! Thank you for your time and please know that time is of the essence in this matter!

I sent in a check to pay off my entire balance……. The check never posted, it started getting close to the due date, I called them . They said they never received the check, so on the due date ….I made the minimum payment. They charged me a late fee even though I paid on the due date . A couple days later Capital One sent me the original check back ( the one they said they never got) and said it was damaged and they couldn’t read it ….. this was a cashier check and it was fine , the bank that produced the check said there was no reason the check shouldn’t have been cashed. I called Capital One again and told another customer service agent my story , she offered me the $29 late fee back ……. I asked well what about the several hundred dollars I lost for two months additional interest….. she said the $29 late fee is the best she can do . Needless to say , I closed the account and will never use them again! I’m also moving my auto loan . Capital One is a scam!

Had to file bankruptcy shortly after Covid was in full swing a didn’t know what to. Being in food service our doors closed March 18, 2020. Not long after I hav no choice to find for bankruptcy. After 11 years of building up credit, opening revolving accounts and has every type of account with zero late payments and most balances paid in full every month. I had several cc’s all in perfect standing. Then I lost it all. But I had everything I needed and made it through the rough couple of years battling the pandemic and slowly built my credit back up applying for any card with no annual fee. Capital One sent me an application at one point and I was denied because I had been a card holder when I filed for bankruptcy so at that time they declined my application. However sometime later they sent me another Pre approved application they approved me. Obviously I was very happy for another opportunity and I love this card! Thank you capital one!

Years ago I hated Capital One. Now I love it. I am a pretty skeptical consumer but they have completely turned the business around, and turned it into one of the most consumer friendly banks I have seen. I love the fact that my payments are posted and my available credit updates instantly on Capital One, even from outside instructions. With my other banks, I have to wait 2 to 3 days for my payment to post in order for them to update my available credit. Even paying my VyStar credit card with my VyStar checking account takes several days for the payment to post. Capital One does it instantly. I thought Capital One shopping was pretty silly until I used it. Now I’m getting rebates for things that I was going to buy anyway, and they’re giving me the option to buy it at better prices. I don’t always do that based on the vendor and the shipping, but it’s nice to know I can get a better price if I wanted to. All around, I am very impressed with Capital One and their app. I was a customer in the 1990s and I had such a bad experience I left and closed my account. I came back several years ago and it’s been a completely different experience. After Vystar’s disastrous technology upgrade earlier this year I open the Capital One checking account also. It’s been a great experience with Capital One and their app is very well designed and user-friendly.

I have yet to transfer my monies to a better account. This bank fails to update your balances regularly - let’s say you get paid on Friday and Decide to have a nice weekend out with your boo or some friends… you won’t know what you’re actual balance is until about Tuesday or Wednesday’s because they don’t calculate those things on the weekend. It’s horrible. I’ve literally ended up having to take out so much money out of my savings because this bank doesn’t tally the checking account accurately and will hold off on cash that you actually have in there until the weekend is over with. Then you’ll look back at ur account on Wednesday and there like 800$ extra available cash. Very frustrating. I’ve even had one of their representatives who also banks with them say the same thing and understands the complaint. Get it together guys!

The app itself is fine, but when I needed customer service, we were send all over the place. We got scammed for $1000 and tried to dispute the charge. Even though Capital One said they agreed that we should have had my money back, we still lost the case. Very confusing. Even with all the proof that we had. On top of this, we got directed to multiple representatives, and everyone of them never made any notes, so never knew the status of our case and what has been said. Representatives were nice to us, which is of course important, but that doesn’t help the frustration of not getting where we need to be. We are very disappointed, and will also never use Capitol One again. A very unfair loss of money, where we think a bank should have backed us up. Especially when it was so obviously clear.

And that one thing, is the ability to pay for your bills separately instead of in one lump sum, I am currently waiting for an insurance to be canceled, but would like to get my other bills out of the way, but can’t because I can only pay the full amount, yes it gives you the option to pay in a different amount, however, cents are not part of that choice, nor can you pick each bill individually, so let’s say there’s an item I bought worth $9.00, I type $9.00 in, hit pay, but what I just paid for was a random amount of $9.00 out of let’s say $100 of the total sum, not an amount directly linked to the $9.00 item… when you go to pay for the items, it should list them like it does regularly and then you can either pick the ones you want to pay off or tap all

make account/routing info copyable with a long press. PLEASE. I was so looking forward to using my new 360 checking account after getting hosed repeatedly with overdraft fees by other major banking institutions - but if you have failed to meet this simplest of standards right out of the gate then I am wary of what may be in store…! And the fact is that I will not be manually typing in account/routing information for the multiple credit cards, utilities & other billers I had intended to migrate over to what was to be my new all-purpose checking account. Sure I could try logging into the website to see if it’s possible to copy the info from there, or write out the info manually into a document & copy/paste from that, but why should I have to? What’s the app for? Big flop capital one! The app (what I’ve seen of it in the 1 day it took to alienate me as a user) is beautiful & functional otherwise and your phone support was A+ top notch helping me get the account set up. If this copy/pasting of account information is a feature request that can reasonably be addressed & provided in the near future then I will absolutely be using this account! But not until!

Honestly do not write reviews often but compared to other bank apps that I use, Capital One takes the cake. Ease of use, having all sorts of info from deals/offers to transaction details to personal things like when your promotional 0% APR ends. Sure you could look those things up on the website of your other banks but having the accessibility and convenience to do so all within the app makes this the best for me, personally. Payments made are reflected instantly and deducted from the primary checking account within a day so planning expenses are easier. The push notifications for every transactions are a big plus as well. Hopefully other bank apps catch on. Nothing bad to say, just good rants!

I am grate full for your contribution to my necessary and required services! Thankyou so much for helping me and making sure that I am not in fact insane! You will be rewarded for your investment in me as I have been rewarded by you! I will not let humanity down and I will continue to take the necessary steps required of me to see my family and continue to prosper! I feel hungry now and I’d like to make some food while I “wait” and prepare for what might come next! I will wait to be told what to think by the tv tonight before tomorrow happens and I will not plan a single day ahead of tomorrow because I’ve just been given a golden ticket to success and I need to make sure that I am not questioning myself nor my very own thoughts themselves! I have been blinded and now I can see clearly that the rain is gone!!!!!!! I love whoever is responsible for taking notice, I cannot quantify the amount of love I feel right now! And I do not regret a single step I’ve taken this far because I am a product of my environment and I have been reacting to things I knew would happen! This is liberation day mark my words!

The process was straight to the point, and it was one of the easiest I've done applying for anything. Once you click that you are interested, quicksilver capital one walks you through the steps, and you just put your information in your application. They have to check to make sure you're working, but then within 24 hours, the money is in the account. Also, the payment plan is fine in terms of it's not large amounts. when they're gonna take the payment, and I make sure the money is on my cheking account. They take it and upload it to the credit bureau as I pay it down. I hope soon they will increase my credit limit and send me an offer with zero perecent interest for 15 months!!!

Not only do they offer me refinance options on a car from 2021 at the age of 21 years old to pay off sooner, they have helped dispute charges that would otherwise be left unchecked. The process was very easy, and the customer service agent i spoke with was happy to help, was quick, and very concise and knew the exact steps to take. I began with a credit card with not good spending habits at 19 years old, they stuck around with me from working at a factory, until (without doxing myself) now, making... lets say very good money. I now have both a credit and debit account with them, and i highly suggest all types of people to be with this company. Our company is now going to be considering capital one for future endeavors and processing transactions. Shoutout from south loop Chicago, and thank you for being on top of your game in all aspects. I find that rare in companies nowadays, but you deserve recognition for that.

reviews.t: Unnecessary updates and long transfer times $
reviews.x: There are frequent changes to the app that are so minor they are obviously just to keep people busy and not to enhance the customer’s accessibility to their cards/accts. The transfer time from an outside bank to capital one is insanely long. They hold my funds for 6-8 days even though I have 4 credit cards, a car loan, CDs etc. It’s crazy Capital One doesn’t trust its best customers to make transfers from the same accounts they’ve used for years. I made a transfer this morning and it is on hold until Tuesday! That’s 6 days! Why? An ACH is done processing in no more than 48 hours. They clearly don’t want people to move money easily. Very outdated. Wish they would stop pretending to be a “fintech” company and just do basic banking efficiently. Stop wasting money on stock grants to Rich Fairbank, a billion dollars net worth is enough!! I promise you’ll survive, and so will your 10 children who contribute zero to society but will live like royalty.

reviews.t: Capital One is why Finance is Moving to Decentralization (blockchain/cryptocurrencies)
reviews.x: They thought they had a right to money and held it hostage for a month and a half. They held my $ captive & had the nerve to not give me a reason why costing $ in late fees & such and negative effects to my credit. This is exactly why banks like Capital One are on the way out, while decentralized cryptocurrencies and blockchain in general are on the rise to replace their VERY flawed centralized systems. So, I signed up for a 360 checking acct a couple months ago due solely to the fact they were offering $250 to do so. I completed the qualifying steps and just today found they froze my account for no apparent reason; held my own $ captive. They caused me to miss some bill payments which will now cost me $ & negatively effect my credit. Then I’m told they’re closing my account, again for no reason as my financial situation was unchanged since they approved me for it a couple months ago! And they do this with impunity!! Had me go through the trouble and time of transferring my direct deposit income to said account, and now I have to get it transferred back to my other bank account which takes a month or two to be processed back. And now after fully completing the requirements for the $250 bonus, they are reneging on their word/obligation, again, with impunity. This is a despicable, money-grubbing, deceitful company!

I used Capital One for a couple years. Closed out my account after Covid hit and I lost my job, and paid off the balance. Apparently two days later, they charged me $7 and some odd cents, but did not notify me about this charge IN ANY WAY. No call, no bill, etc until MONTHS later when the amount was now over $60. They refuse to take off the fee and let me pay what I owed. It could be much worse than $60 but it is very frustrating that something that was not communicated on their behalf has become my responsibility. I was told the amount I owed. I paid it in full. The account was closed. I have spoken to multiple customer service reps with no resolution other than an “Im sorry for the inconvenience” AFTER being told that “yes, it looks like we never contacted you. I’m so sorry about that.” Terrible customer service. It’s shady and I don’t recommend using this card if you’re trying to build your credit. Years of work building my credit to be undone by a charge that was originally under $10. Ridiculous!

Website and help says mobile deposits available next day. Not true. Account has NEVER been negative or over drafted. Open almost a year. Mobile deposited a dispersement from retirement account from major financial institution not a personal check. 4 day hold. Called within 10 minutes of deposit to cancel. They claim they can’t even though I did not get email saying deposit was processed until 2 hours later. They don’t make a portion available. They could not direct me anywhere on website disclosing this 4 day 100% hold. They said they have to protect themselves. Venmo can check an account instantly. Capital one takes 4 days from a fellow institution with no warning. And “customer service” is false advertising. They said there were trying to help me. Couldn’t point to disclosure. Couldn’t cancel deposit. Couldn’t even release a small portion of funds from another bank. Deeply regret choosing to trust them with my money.

For over 9 months Capital One fraud representatives cannot find a way to stop a charge forwarded from a card turned off last year. They turn off my credit card and send me a new one. Before it arrives new fraud charges are on the new card. And the cycle repeats. Over and over. I have probably spent 30 hours on the phone with your team. Certainly I am not only person with this issue. The fraudulent charges are only at two companies yet your peoples tools to block these are woefully inadequate and obviously no significant energy has been dedicated by leadership to create a measures to make your company better or service your customers. I am frustrated to the point I am willing to take a credit hit for closing my account and taking my business elsewhere.

reviews.t: I wish they had more bank locations to make cash deposits
reviews.x: Unless you live in the DTLA area or wherever this bank location is located, you can only visit a participating CVS PHARMACY and make a cash deposit there. Otherwise, you are muffed and have to figure out another way to make a deposit to prevent an overdraft charge. Mind you, that you are only given ONE TIME ONLY reverse charge. That right there would have been a red flag for me to not have opened an account with Capital One in the first place. But I still have my account till this day. And in search of another option to take my business. I mean Capital One advertises NO FEES in big bold lettering, yet I am still charged with a $35 fee. I am not saying Capital One is not a good bank at all, because they are pretty good bank otherwise my little behind wouldn’t still be doing business with them. All in all, I am pretty happy with Capital One and I would refer my friends and family to come aboard. The app is user friendly and easy to navigate through.

I had no problem whatsoever with the app before. In the last few months I can’t login and I have to reset my password online every time I will want to try to use the app. Then I go back to the app and that new password will not work. I’ve tried calling customer service. I’ve tried using online report mechanisms. I can’t even get through to report an issue unless I indicate a product that I purchased. It would be nice if they would fix this app so that it’s user-friendly. Right now I can’t even get it to delete from my iCloud. I’ve tried several times. When I try to reinstall the app it just download the faulty app that’s in my iCloud. Please help if you can

reviews.t: I will forever be a Capital One customer.
reviews.x: I had some bogus charges from Walmart for a subscription service I know I canceled and all I had to do to dispute these charges that Walmart refused to give me my money back for by calling your professional and nice agents at capital one. Now I know people say that they canceled subscriptions all the time when they didn’t but in this case I actually did and I want to thank you and your representatives were believing me and getting me my money back. Because of this and because of the professionalism of your agents I will forever be a Capital One customer. Also, getting a secured Capital One card and paying it off every month was the first step in raising my credit. Also, because of that card I now have 11 other credit cards and my credit score went from 420 to 740 in 3 years. Forever a PROUD customer.

reviews.t: Terrible customer service and so many error they could not fix
reviews.x: This was the worst experience I’ve had with obtaining a credit card, as I have many credit cards, great credit, and also a business so I have business lines of credit also. I was told I would have a virtual number to use until I physically received my card bc it takes them 2-3 business days to receive the card, however that was not the case they DO NOT allow you to you the card until you receive the card. Having received most of my cards via 24hr overnight shipping, I applied for the card to use in the next 24-48 hrs as I have many big purchases I will be making (5k+) and wanted to make use of the card point benefits. This was not the case. Also, I am moving from my apartment in 2 days so if the card does not come in time they will not forward or change the receipt address to my new home in another state. They do not allow any changes for 10 days. This is ridiculous because I am moving and and wanted to use the card for moving expenses as I am moving from the mainland to Hawaii. This has been thee worst experience and customer service I have ever received. So now I will not be able to use the card for at least 2 weeks due to me moving and I cannot use the benefit of the lounge in 2 days when I travel which was also another benefit I was looking forward to. I wish I never applied for this card. It has caused more headaches than what I will benefit after I receive it in 2 weeks. What a waste of my time and effort.

reviews.t: Nice UI design and features; some improvements needed
reviews.x: The Good: Sleek designs in main page and once you select the card details, shows useful information at a quick glance like current balance, remaining credit line, rewards points. Even has a tracker for sign up bonus. Transaction details are clear showing merchant name, address, even phone numbers. Can do many things in the various settings like refer friends, add authorized user, see statements. The Bad: Unique among card issuers, only lets you pick 5-6 due dates for credit card bills? Also, doesn’t show anywhere in the app when your statement ends. Also, why are the Capital One shopping offers so hard to use, you have to click the link through the app and make your purchase immediately on your phone browser? Other card issuers like Chase and Bank of America lets you “activate” the offer in their app, and you can pay with the card anytime until the deal expires, on any platform, and earn the cash back. These features are standard among Capital One’s competitors so not sure why they refuse to offer these basics.

reviews.t: Way to treat us like criminals
reviews.x: I had a capital one card about 3-4 years back and because it got behind on payments with me being laid off due to covid and even tho it had been completely paid off, and is now 3 years later they flagged my name. I applied for a Walmart credit car and was approved and received the card but when I tried to access online acc it told me to contact customer service which I did and it has gone downhill since. They have my names flagged for fraud and have forced me to spend hours now just trying to change a password and put my new phone number in. I’ve had to send pictures of my ID 3 separate times and Was told it was due to fraud issues that they couldn’t do anything and then proceeded to email me And have me send another picture of my ID No it was due to the fact that I had an outstanding balance and even tho it’s been paid for over a year they have me pinned and have made me waste so much of my afternoon just for a password change. They then said they’d contact me and I still havnt heard back. Why couldn’t I just make a new online account. If they are going to treat people like criminals they should probably not allow them to be approved for a different card. I felt so disrespected at the fact that I’ve had to go through all of this just to have access to an online account all while holding the active card in my hand. So in the end they said the card is active I just cannot access anything online or on the app due to my fraudulent past. It’s demeaning

reviews.t: Not here to help others in need
reviews.x: Needed assistance with extending my car loan after getting Covid back in October 2021. Had it all set until a week later, they decided that I wasn’t in need of the extension because I didn’t qualify. I was out two weeks and DID NOT GET PAID for those two weeks. That job alone pays for my car and car insurance for my family. They decided that during 2020, to give assistance, and now they don’t care if you get Covid and are out of work. Im STILL paying catch up for one payment because they’re not willing to budge for anything. So over it all. Capital One says they try to be helpful, when all they do is make your life more difficult and stressful just to get their money. I know my responsibilities. I pay all my credit card and auto payments ON TIME, with the exception of when I had Covid, and they just don’t care at all. I will NEVER recommend them for an auto loan ever again. I have NEVER had a problem with any finance company or bank extending my loan especially with my good standing with paying my car payments on time. Never again with Capital One, auto finance!

The customer service at Capital One is the best ever. I got Deseree twice. She remembered me and was awesome as the first time! Keep up the good job!🙏🙏🙏🤔🙏🙏❤️❤️❤️❤️👏👏👏👏👏👏👏👏🎊 I got Jasmine s few months ago and she was so patient and kind she treated me as if I were her mother. She was super tolerant. Hope it’s not CU because they’re notes about me being slow! Anyway she was on the line to pick the money up from the loan spot and stayed with me while I drove to the CU nearby and was on hold while I made the necessary transfer then completed my payment and reversed the late fees because it took me a while to get the wherewithal to take care of the situation. That girl should be given a raise or stipend for her skills in dealing with people with impairment!! Jasmine is so good at what she does. You can tell she does what she does what sheloves and loves what she does🦊

This card is exactly what I’ve been looking for. The rewards, cash back, Discounts and travel and travel rewards are truly outstanding. I am really looking forward to see what my credit line increase is going to be from what it is now. Never been late always paid on or before time never had an issue. Customer service is outstanding truly amazing they will go out of their way to try to solve or resolve the issue whatever it may be or my issues .I can’t speak for nobody else. I would truly recommend this card to friends and family members. Can’t wait to get another year under my belt with this card. It’s going to be real interesting in a couple more weeks which would be my six month review for a credit line increase on what it is going to be. I am looking for a double increase 😆😆crossing my fingers and toes.🤞🏼🤞🏼

Terrible app, I checked my balance 4 times the other day, I know I had money on there, then the next day the app tells me my account is in the negative balance, but if I had overdrafted it would have text and emailed me and I would have known , being that I check my balances before I spend… now somehow mysteriously I owe money back that I shouldn’t owe, the capital one manager I spoke with said the app had many flaws to just sign in on my web browser, another thing this stupid Available VS Current balance is stupid as H and confusing….. I was going off of my current balance thinking that’s what I had currently, but turns out it was actually my available balance that I really had… be easier if it said “Spending balance” and “funds not processed yet balanced “ capital one has caused me so many financial issues and put me in debt, I’m going to go with Bb&T/Truist as soon as I can …

reviews.t: Never has this app not done what I’ve needed it too but…
reviews.x: Love the app ever since switching from pnc and have never had any hitches or anything of the sort. I’m really only writing this review to see if getting a dark mode is in talks from within the development team any time soon. Its only one of many select features that every app should be pushed out with especially now a days. As well as I’m not sure if it’s done it but just from what I’ve noticed my app doesn’t seem to notify with a notification when money either comes in from direct deposit or direct person to person transactions. More times than I can remember is only know because I’d get an email telling me someone has sent me money and then I’d check but I’d rather have my app push the notification out to me instead in real time. But other than that those are my only two gripes I guess that I would like to see added everything else works as intended and couldn’t be more happy with the app as is.

I’m about 4.5 years to using their credit card. Once I turned 18 my uncle helped me get a CD Loan set up and then eventually I fulfilled that. I signed up for what was next and decided to get a credit card and I decided on Capital One. My overall experience falls on a scale of 1-10 from 1 being the worst and 10 being the best. App Navigation: 7.5 As time progressed i felt as the app started to feel like it was separating everything into its own individual folder and it felt convenient for my needs. Scheduling payments: 10 Easy to schedule payments with a variety of methods. If I wasn’t able to schedule the payment arrangement that was comfortable for my financial needs all I had to do was customer service. Customer Service: 10 Hold time is never an issue, Reps are very knowledgeable and polite, Usual phone call duration on a busy day would be 10-15 minutes, I never had an issue arranging a payment plan that was fit best. Overall personal experience: 8.5 What brought me here to finally leave a review was the new custom payment plan feature. Recently been in a roller coaster of financial stability due to some career changes in the last year and being able to set this up was a great feeling being able to catch up. Thanks.

Honestly could not recommend this app more. Especially to newbies in credit cards, this app provides help understanding everything about credit cards, how to keep a good credit score, why your credit score may have dropped, and much more. I honestly couldn’t be more pleased. This app also contains information about any other credit cards you may have and how they’re affecting your score. It lets you know your credit card usage, any loans you may have, and you are able to check your credit score whenever you’d like for free. Like I said, if your new to credit cards this app is a great beginning to understand the ins and outs of a good credit score. Thank you Capital one!!! -from a beginning credit card user (teenager)

From checking, savings to my Walmart card I am very pleased and satisfied with Capital One! The app is very user friendly and I am able to access all of my accounts in one place. In addition, I am able to move my money around with ease and expediency. Also I can make payments to my Walmart card or other Capital One cards in one place with the same ease. Customer service reps have gone above and beyond for me and in my experience, very friendly!! Because of the customer service reps I've spoken to I feel that my accounts are in good hands and I know I'll be contacted and protected if anything suspicious happens (which has already transpired and saved me from payments I didn't recognize). I recommend Capital One to anyone who wants easy and free banking ☺️

Capital one has been wonderful for building my credit, their application process is not difficult and works very quickly. Their app is easy to use and has a lot of really helpful tools and information to responsibly mange your credit. I started with a credit score in the low 500’s and about a year and a half later I was at 730, this has had a huge impact on my ability to get a car loan and also how much that car loan will cost me to pay off. If you don’t have a credit card and you feel confident that you have the self control to use it responsibly, not buying things you can’t afford to pay off within a month or two, then I highly recommend getting a capital one card to learn how credit cards work and build your credit.

Had a credit card for a bit and never late on my payments they’d take like at least 2 days to withdrawal my payments and ended up closing my account even though I always made my deposits on time and my bank would cancel transactions for them taking long so that cause to return payment even tho I would make my payments a day early or so they’d still take long to withdraw from account and closed my account and sent a letter saying it’s closed cause of Fraud like I don’t get how that’s fraud when it’s on their end they failed to withdraw my payments on time. I’d look for a better credit ling if this how they work with people highly disappointed

I love my capital one card. I like how easy it is to view my statement and how easy it is to understand. I immediately get alerts of usage. This is very reassuring. I enjoy looking at my points stacking up and looking forward to using them for miles on my next adventure. I also like the security of this card for travel. As already mentioned I get immediate alerts, this gives me peace of mind as I travel abroad because I know Capital One has my back. If anything suspicious occurs I know Capital One will fight my battles for me. This makes me be able to relax and enjoy my much needed vacation. I am happy I have switched to Capital One. It now is my only major credit card. 😊

Cap One stopped my OD protection from my Cap One savings account to my Cap One checking account because they made my checking account an Online account only (thus changing the type of account and nullifying the OD transfer option somehow). I called customer service to try and set up OD because my mortgage payment comes out of that checking account (opened since 1989 while i was at Chevy Chase Bank) and it’s extremely important to me that my Mortgage payment NEVER gets returned). He said I could easily (NOT) go to the app and set OD from my savings account. Could NOT get this done. I’ve been a customer of Cap. One (they bought Chevy Chase bank along the way) since 1989 and feel as though they don’t care about the customer anymore. It also seems you can’t go to any branches anymore to get answers. Too bad a Credit Card company bought a great bank and messed it all up. All I want is OD protection from my Cap One savings account but I have almost no faith that it will ever get done. I miss Chevy Chase Bank.

I chose capitol one because it seemed so simple and easy and has so many benefits. But a little voice in my head was thinking, “so what’s the catch ? They have everything!” Here’s the catch: Any time I try to use my debit card I get an email saying there is fraudulent activity on your card. Every single time. How can I ever buy anything ? I tried to buy diapers at a regular store and nope! “We’re seeing some fraudulent activity on your card. We went ahead and froze your account. Go ahead and call us to resolve this issue.” I called and they simply said we can’t stop it from doing this on certain websites like delta. So I just can’t buy a flight through delta ever in my life I guess amongst other things. I had to call my father and use his card to buy something for $11. It’s so ridiculous if I could give 0 stars I would. So what do you want me to do capitol one? Call you EVERY TIME I need to simply buy gum or tampons at a store ? People need debit cards. Or is it just for show. I have called customer service so many times, but I shouldn’t have to do this on and on and on again. I just got the account and I’m already going to cancel it. I can’t handle being treated so terrible. This is absolutely ridiculous.

reviews.t: Just a bunch of wasted time
reviews.x: This is the worst app on my phone. I have had to spend so much time on the phone with people that work at capital one trying to fix the bugs in this app. I hate their verify me website, which has kept me in an endless cycle of trying to prove that I am me when I have been using a Capital One app on this phone for six or seven years. I cannot wait to close my checking account and find a new bank. And now I wish I could give it no stars because it won’t even let me leave a review without assigning a nickname. Every nickname I try to use, no matter how obscure, it says that nickname is already taken. That is just typical of the type of problems I have encountered with this app.

I have been using this app for awhile now and haven’t run into a problem until recently when I had to file a charge dispute through Capital One. Back in November of last year I had made a reservation for a hotel room in Arizona where I’d plan to travel to to see a concert. Now about a week before the concert was scheduled to be I received a notice that the concert had been postponed because of a small Covid outbreak. So I went to cancel my hotel room because I wouldn’t be able to go. I went through the email that the hotel sent me to go and cancel my reservation. After I was done I took a screenshot of the page that indicates that my reservation was fully canceled. But about a week later on the day the concert would of been I received a charge for the canceled hotel room. I first went through the hotel themselves to explain to them I had canceled and had my screenshot proving it. They didn’t care whatsoever. So I then filled out the required paperwork to submit a dispute directly with Capital One and I included a print out of my screenshot of the canceled room. At first they reversed the charge but then the hotel company fought it and Capital One then reversed back without any proof from Red Roof. I then sent another letter and received a message back saying that Capital One wouldn’t do anything even though I’m the only one who can provide proof of cancellation. So just know that if you’re being actively false charged that Capital One will NOT do anything to stop it.

We were asked to update our financial information. I called in and Bob preceded to take my information and change/update my records. He created a mess, we could not login to our account for 3 weeks. Called back 10 different times, connecting to the digital department who said they could not see any updates done by previous digital department. Every time they told us we had to wait 72 hours, ask to speak to supervisor who then could not do anything, put me back with digital department who could not find any notes or update and preceded to update until he finally found previous update. Had to wait another 72 hours before we could login. This has been my only issue with Capital One over the last 10 years we have had the card. But very frustrating when you can’t check your transactions over 3 weeks. Had to call and go over each transactions and at this point could not remember if all were good.

I will be paying my amount owed off and be canceling the card. I had a fraudulent attack on my debit card and credit card. My debit card was fixed in 2 days!!!! On the day it happened I spoke with a lady for capital one fraudulent and she had said it would be taken care of with a credit to my account until the investigation is completed which can take about 6 days. This was fine! I was cool with this and thought it hey they will take care of me and are such a good company. Well the transaction posted and they did not credit my account. I called and spoke to 3 different people and they told me it would take approx 60-90 days to be fixed, if it’s fixed. Then proceeds to tell me it’s only an hours work but it depends on how quickly they can get to it. Very annoyed as one tells you one thing and another tells you another thing. I heard SOOO many good things about their fraudulent program and they are not at all what I was told and will be telling EVERYONE that told me they were great because it was not. It’s probably because they actually had theirs resolved when they said they would. So either they favor people and take care of some quicker than others or they have very inconsistent customer service which both are pathetic. The guy also kept asking if I knew the difference between a debit and credit, and that processes are different which is VERY INSULTING as it’s obvious there’s a difference but with what I have been told about the company there were expectations and capital one has failed. I was told one thing on the day it happened and then another thing today. I will be posting this review to every one of their comment sections so everyone can know how I was treated when going through a fraudulent situation which is already stressful. Thanks for making my situation worse capital one.

First of all, I would like to recommend this app for any teen/parent users! This app is super easy to manage, and get notifications from the app. I think that if you want to introduce your teen/child to banking, this will be the app for you. You can even set it so that if you forget to give your child weekly allowance, the app will automatically do it for you. One of the features that I personally really enjoy is setting a goal for yourself. Once you set up an account for your child, it will allow them to put as much money from the account into saving for let’s say, a cool pair of shoes. You can also set it to put let’s say 4 dollars into saving every week, or every other week or so. Overall, I definitely recommend this app for any users who are into in banking/ savings. Great job !!!

reviews.t: Only cares about “credit wise” and dodges everything else
reviews.x: Got credit wise a while ago and decided to get a credit card through capitol one , got my first bill in the mail and went on the app and online to get it set up and pay my first bill and no matter what I do to sign in on make a payment it redirects me to credit wise and never takes me to the actual credit card account page/info all it does it show me my credit wise report and show everything about what todo or what to apply for with my credit even though I just clicked the link that says make a payment, also the website /app only shows things for credit wise and it’s very small and hidden under multiple tabs where you find credit card make a payment link and it just redirects you to credit wise , on the app you can try and add credit card to profile and the app says “something went wrong we hit a snag” and I’ve signed out and reinstalled the app multiple times and it still comes up with this error. Capitol one is a scam/dodgy sneaky company and i wish I never participated in there credit check/ credit cards due to this sneaky / dodgy frustrating structure they put together. STAY AWAY SAVE YOURSELF THE HEADACHES

reviews.t: No presents under the tree for 2021.
reviews.x: I received my new card on the 14th of December and was very excited to have a back up for emergencies, breakdowns and Christmas presents. Unfortunately, from the first transaction my card and account has been on fraud restrictions. I was denied purchases on the 22nd and 23rd buying presents for 5 children and 12 grandchildren. The fraud specialist was supposed to call me to lift restrictions but failed to do so and we spent Christmas looking at an empty Christmas tree. Since the 14th I’ve had to call or wait for a call to lift fraud restrictions every single day, for almost 2 weeks everyday my account has been frozen, halted, stopped, denied, and restricted by the Capital One’s Fraud “Scrooge” Department. A representative told me she’s never seen an account be restricted like this! So, the 19 family members sat looking at an empty tree for Christmas thinking of Capital One’s “Scrooge “ Fraud Department, while little ones cried, I felt like throwing up.

Have used capital one for quite some time now for personal and business. The personal side I have no problems. Business side? I personally would be embarrassed to call myself a bank considering all the problems I have had just trying to download my statements. I have a 1 out of 10 chance that I can remote deposit check…always something wrong that they are supposedly working on. Their suggestion that I deposit directly via atm or mail in would be fine if the nearest bank was not 200 miles away or the pony express had come by here the in the past 100 years. And yes I am reviewing after once being denied a business deposit

reviews.t: Please update this app to the 21st-century!
reviews.x: For your consumer please redo this app so that the running actual balance is next to the charges each item line number and each credit with the running balance after the credits applied for each line item number this way the customer can understand what is the real balance and what’s been charged and what happens to the balance and when the credit is applied and what happens to the balance rather than just having a single balance at the end of the statement which may not be actual based on pending charges do what other credit card companies do I make it very easy for the customer to know what’s going on what’s been applied what’s been charged!

I usually love Capital One but there banking has proven to be a systematic screw up by “their computer.” First- I set up bill-pay to pay Eddie Bauer. I set it up for the 1st and for 10 months, Capital One insisted they were being paid then. Come to find out - they weren’t sending it over for 3-4 days. I ended up with 10 months of late payment before I figured it out. Nothing on the website warning it might take that long - NOTHING. They screwed me out of $400!! Then - I am paid every two weeks by check. Capital One - months later - is STILL not releasing my check for two days. This last pay day it surprised me and said i had access to part of the funds that day - But it LIED. I went to the store and was totally embarrassed when my card didn’t go through. The people on the phone for Capital One simply said - I’m so sorry, that doesn’t sound right - I’ll let them know your “feedback.” At this point, it isn’t feedback. At the very least - Capital One owes me $400.

I am just begining to reestablish my credit and I got a couple of low limit credit cards and this one is the one I trust. I pay as much as I can every month and then use it as my spending money for the month. I have two others but I continue to treat this one as my main card. They didn’t charge me a penny for annual fees like the others. In fact, it seems like they haven’t charged me for anything. It’s more like a debit card then a credit card. Everytime Zi use the card I immediately get a notification and a thank you. When I pay into it each month I have access to that amount immediately. I have another card that took no joking, 6 weeks before the amount was added to my credit limit! If your starting to get credit again or if you just want a good dependable credit card, go with Capitol One!! The app is awesome and you get access to your fico score for free!

My feedback in situations like this, for every app that holds me hostage for my opinion before releasing me to go about my business ,as I had planned, is evermore the same “Stop!“ Please show me the respect and common decency that I deserve by not hijacking my process and requiring me to answer a question before I can be free to complete my tasks. Please assume my intelligence and ability to find an use a “contact us” link to submit my suggestions and feedback should I choose to do so. I am extremely busy and have difficulty focusing on any one task in the midst of annoyances and distractions. It seems to me the reasonable question for your company would be: “do we want this individual using/exploring the benefits of our product or would we rather interrupt his thought process and cause him to forget what the heck he was trying to use it for in the first place, or would we rather have him click yes or no and then give us an answer that we won’t be actionable with anyway, and in this way end up with no changes to our annoying policies and now a potential upgrade gone, or a referral to new business is left feeling unappreciated and frustrated with nothing nice to say about the product?”

About two months ago was sent a Walmart capital one credit card. Used it 4 pr 5 times and than all of sudden was rejected at the check out. Had use another card. 1st call to capital one about the situation was like a 2 1/2 hr call. The girl kept putting me on hold. End result was the needed proof of identification. This included copy of social card, drivers license, and utility bill. A copy of the social security card really scared me. You are always warned about about keeping it confidential. I expressed my concerns about the sending the the card. Now I have two other accounts with capital one. Which they aren’t questioning me about. Same email address. They won’t give me any more information. Was told they would send me a special email encrypted, so I can email the copies back to them. Basically this conversation went on two more times. NEVER got the emails. My email address is good. They never had their IT people check out why I couldn’t receive the special email from them. Never heard from them about my other accounts. Why this one, if I don’t call them, the never call me. Everything is so secretive . I pay my bills on time. The way this whole thing is being handled is very scary to me.

Capital One has a great app - Their app is very user friendly and best of all, they didn’t change it for the sake of changing it - they just made improvements! Competing banks make unnecessary changes as their tech personnel turn over - and the apps tend to get worse. Many years ago, they stuck with me through financial hardships and never cancelled any of my accounts, so they have my total loyalty! Also, Capital One was the first card issuer (five or more years ago) to implement phone calls text messages and alerts when unusual activity on credit cards occurred - very reassuring, and they rejected false charges, saving me a lot of hassle. This has prevented fraud several times years ago! I love the company and their automated services and account protection! Additionally, their platinum card was the first major card to offer generous awards. Also, the standard no-rewards card has an extremely low APR on balances. Their customer service is also outstanding!

reviews.t: No push notifications for 360 checking account
reviews.x: This app offers a lot of good features but it is missing push notifications for their 360 checking accounts. I do not receive any push notifications when I make a transaction with my debit card or when I deposit money through an ATM. This is a basic feature of an app that should not be overlooked in 2021. These notifications are necessary in helping users to identify fraud immediately and not only when they manually check their bank account. You do have the option to set up “alerts” via text or email through the Capital One website but that should be an alternative to push notifications and not the only option. Users shouldn’t have to dig through texts or emails to see if any unauthorized purchases were made in their accounts. I hope Capital One addresses this issue quickly but it seems this has been a problem for many years.

reviews.t: Love the bank and the app but…
reviews.x: My feedback in situations like this, for every app that holds me hostage for my opinion before releasing me to go about my business ,as I had planned, is evermore the same “Stop!“ Please show me the respect and common decency that I deserve by not hijacking my process and requiring me to answer a question before I can be free to complete my tasks. Please assume my intelligence and ability to find an use a “contact us” link to submit my suggestions and feedback should I choose to do so. I am extremely busy and have difficulty focusing on any one task in the midst of annoyances and distractions. It seems to me the reasonable question for your company would be: “do we want this individual using/exploring the benefits of our product or would we rather interrupt his thought process and cause him to forget what the heck he was trying to use it for in the first place, or would we rather have him click yes or no and then give us an answer that we won’t be actionable with anyway, and in this way end up with no changes to our annoying policies and now a potential upgrade gone, or a referral to new business is left feeling unappreciated and frustrated with nothing nice to say about the product?”

My debit was compromised and it’s been over two weeks and still can’t get access to my account. No bank tellers for literally hundreds of miles. Unacceptable. And each rep I spoke to just doesn’t seem to care. Not their fault but why have a bank like this? After two weeks of waiting I was offered an expedited card but it may arrive when the originally requested one does. Are you serious? Also help when your account is compromised is slow and scary all by itself. As soon as my card arrives I’m closing my checking and savings account and completing my move to citadel. At least they have physical tellers you can get your money from not ambassadors that don’t kno what’s going on. I use to really like capital one bank but after this…I can’t have this again.

I started my bank account 3 years ago with capital one. I am so impressed. I scan a check on a Thursday night at 9:00 PM, 3 hours later it’s deposited. How? I have no idea. I run out of money in my checking account and need to squeeze a tank of gas in my truck… no problem, keep $1.00 in my account and no overdraft fee. Forget that pesky subscription comes out the 20th and bounce a check? No problem. No fee. Want to create 1500 checking accounts in one day? Easy. Want just as many savings accounts? Done. Want to send money to Taiwan via zelle? Seamless. So it’s 6:30 PM on a Friday and your card gets declined for to big of a purchase? Say a down payment on a high demand truck. No problem, they will answer if it is 3 am on a Sunday. “ hey, can you increase my spending limit just for today? Yes sir, no problem.” Bet. The solution to all personal banking problems. In person banks are annoying nowadays anyway because of COVID… not sure why exactly you would ever need a bank visit anymore tbh… unless your technologically challenged I guess. Thank you capital one!

reviews.t: Unable to log into the app.
reviews.x: I do not own a cell phone. I entered my home phone number for verification purposes on the Capital One website. After deleting all of my apps and reinstalling them, I am unable to to sign into Capital One because it is trying to verify my information with a text message sent to my home phone line. My home phone line is unable to receive text messages because it is a landline.I chose to not have contact information go through my landline because I am unable to receive text messages. I do not understand why the app will not use the alternate email address that I provided instead of insisting that I use a mobile phone text message for which I do not own a mobile phone.I am able to log onto Capital One’s website. I am not able to rectify the situation on the Capital One website. I am only having this problem with the app.

reviews.t: If I could give 0 stars, I would.
reviews.x: This company is the most incompetent banking institution that I’ve come across in my 34 years of existence. We have an auto loan and a checking account with them. My husband tried to make a lump payment on our auto loan and the app required so many temporary text codes that he got locked out of the app for 24 hours. We have not been able to turn on our debit card all day to access our money. My husband has called a minimum of 10 times and spent hours on hold for us to have to find other ways to try to access our funds (set up backup card on ApplePay) which have now been shut down due to “fraudulent activity.” Not a single representative we spoke to was able to help or even attempt to fix this. We’ve stopped calling because we were sick of spending hours on hold to be hung up on. As soon as we finish paying our auto loan in a couple months, we will be switching banks.

reviews.t: Convenient app with many great features
reviews.x: The Capital One App is very convenient and a time saver. I can check my accounts for current balances and pay them off immediately with my linked bank accounts, that way I never get charged late fees. In addition, I appreciate the cash back rewards. I always apply them to my balance. I also like the ability to check my credit rating and what I can do to improve it. The credit rating feature also allows me to see if there have been any breaches to my personal information, for example, I was alerted that one of my email accounts was on the dark web and the password had been accessed. I wouldn’t have known this otherwise. Great app!

I love how if something is billed twice I get a warning-I LOVE if I call one of the Capitol One reps to ask a question I totally understand them regardless of what country they are from-I love that I can look see any day I want what my bill is. What I do NOT like is I wish the pending items would be included straight away to my account instead of having to wait. I am horrid at math and have to get pencil and paper out to calculate my total-Waaah, Waaah. I also wish I had a better interest rate-I always pay on time-I have been a consistent purchaser-give me a better rate please? I get offers from other companies but love Capitol One and want to stay…….anyone reading this, do you hear me? Please give me a better interest rate.

When i was in college, i dropped out and defaulted on my student loans since I was young and stupid. this destroyed my credit and I had a hard time finding a credit card. Capital one gave me a chance with a low limit credit card. Fast forward, after 2 and a half years, they have helped build my credit from 530 to 700. I now have 3 credit cards with them and am thinking about opening a checking account because of how amazing they are. I now have a “ventureone” card (i don’t spend too much so there’s no need for the similar “venture” card for me), a quicksilver card, and my old platinum card. I feel they trust me on my finances now and I have officially realized how loyal of a customer I want to be with them. They are the sole reason I am able to be in a financially stable position and I have nothing but gratitude for all they have offered. Needless to say they are the best if you are looking to rebuild your credit and want to prove you are financially responsible now. I went from a $300 credit limit to $9600 limit in just 2 and a half years. Trust me. They are a great bank, and the only bank I can truly trust with my finances. i am extremely happy with the relationship I have built with them and you will be too.

For one, these days, there are any number of cards you can get, at different APRs, different fee schedules, as well as annual fees. They are Competitive in that regard, and actually don’t Charge an annual fee- pretty cool when you figure some charge as much as $99. Capital One justhassolidname Recognition, and you never hear anyone complaining about them. Wells Fargo and Bank of America, not so: I never hear anyone say they have good experiences with them, in fact quite the opposite . So as far as word on the street,Capitol One just seems to work for the average person. I actually got a “repair your credit” type card - and Capitol One had the lowest APR and matched what I deposited on the secure card, but also gave $100 in actual credit- something none of the other secured cards do. In about 5 months my credit rating about doubled, going from deplorable, to respectable.I can’t help but think that’s their “name recognition” at play, or at least they are reporting my positive Credit moves, something other cards just don’t do. I’ve read other cards reviews, and they don’t always report your responsible credit card behavior in a timely manner. Maybe I’m wrong, but going with Capitol One has been an extremely positive experience to MY benefit. And I’ve hardly been charged any interest or fees at all, partly because I’m constantly paying down my balance, but using up the Credit - but always making payments, every week. If I wasn’t using it so much, my Credit score would be a hair away from 800, after being half that for years.

Once my credit card got compromised, I called Capital One customer service to get me a new Card, as I had recurring payments attached to my card. So, instead of mailing my card via express, they first promised I will get a new card mailed 4-6 days, it didn’t arrive. They then said within 10 days, still the card didn’t show. Finally, I got an email saying the card wouldn’t arrive until 2 weeks since my fraud reporting. I called customer service more than 7 times, each times explained my issue to the new agent (which is incredibly frustrating). They now offer express mail instead of doing that the first time. So, I got stranded on my essential recurring payments for 2 weeks. If Capital One keeps being reluctant on improving their customer service and fraud management processes, they’re going to continue losing their customers (like myself) to their competitors.

The past few months I started to receive mail from Capital One every time I did a deposit with my mobile app. In the past when I deposited my check through the app I used to get a confirmation email plus I could see the picture of my deposit on the app in transactions. Suddenly this stopped. I have always been signed up for paperless on both website and phone. Now for some inexplicable reason the setting has disappeared on my app. When I do a deposit I now receive confirmation via paper mail. No one at Capital One can figure out why this is happening. I do not want my personal bank information floating out there regarding money going into my account. Why can’t the account info for account settings be streamlined with the app. The crazy thing is the mail arrived 3 weeks later after the deposit. I am very frustrated with Capital One regarding this matter. Until it is resolved one star

reviews.t: Late fee even though their app crashed when increasing my payment amount
reviews.x: My review has been lowered from 5 to 1 star after this experience. One week before my payment was due, I went on to the app and tried to increase my payment. The app told me that it could not process my request at that time so I let it be thinking that my regularly scheduled payment would post on the day it was due. I have been a loyal customer for 3 and 1/2 years never once one minute late with a payment. This morning I did not receive my alert thanking me for my payment so I logged in to the app and found that I was charged a late fee for missing a payment. I immediately schedule a payment for double of what should of been paid on the due date and called in to the help desk. My experience was awful. They denied my request for the fee to be reversed because of their error stating that they did not have a record of any crash with regards to the app. (Keep in mind that I called 7 hours after the payment was due and paid more than 3 x’s the minimum payment due). I explained that the app said it could not process my request and they just kept saying I canceled my payment. Even after explaining to the supervisor what had happened and pointing out that I called in not a week later and not to try and pay the minimum payment but the second I woke up and paid 3 and 1/2 times the minimum payment due, I was told there was nothing they can do because I canceled my payment even though their app said that my request to change the payment was interrupted by the error “your request cannot be processed at this time”! My advice to anyone using this app is to call in the day your payment is due and confirm it was paid.

reviews.t: Don’t believe anything their phone operators tell you
reviews.x: I have had my Capitol one Platnium and Quiksilver for over 2 years now and have paid every months payment on time and for the full balance of the card, with the exception of 6 months into the pandemic things we’re getting tight and I was trying to penny pinch anywhere I could. I remembered that capital one had a payment forgiveness deferral for times of hardship. I had the money to pay it, but at same time that would create a little breathing room. I spoke with Capital one and said I only wanted to do it if it had zero impact to my credit. They assured me that it wouldn’t as there was a pandemic, so I pushed one months payment on both cards back a month. Fast forward 6 months later I had a really good year with stocks and had 30k for a vehicle. My vehicle of choice was 40k so I needed to finance 10k, I figured Capital one has loan program, I’m already with them why not just get it there. So I applied stating I had 30k. I was denied all because of one months deferred payment, denied by the same people who garentee that it has absolutely no affect on your credit . To boot now I can’t even get a credit increase on either card. They double screwed me. I was shopping for loans and was approved everywhere else I went. Other banks thought it was cray how it worked out, and didn’t understand how they could do exactly what they said they wouldn’t. Anyhow I’m talking to a lawyer now and it seems I have a case since they made a breach in contract and the ordinal agreement.

It would make things easier if I was able to pay directly with my account (pay card). It is exactly like a bank account, except it has a MasterCard logo. I have a “checking” account and a “savings” account but it is all done digitally through the payroll company at my employer. It’s not a big deal and it keeps me accountable and responsible to stay updated to pay every month but after awhile, the fees do add up, especially since my loan rate (APR) is causing me to pay double the worth of the car (again, grateful to have the loan when my credit wasn’t up to par at the time)-just saying every penny counts being a single parent working barely above minimum wage. Other than that, the app is wonderful, convenient, fast, easy, no run around-straight and to the point. I wish all were like this!

reviews.t: Why change the app to make it worse
reviews.x: I have used this app for a long time, loved it, still love it, but don’t like that they removed my favorite feature. I liked being able to create virtual cards, but they removed that feature from the app and when I tried going online to access my account to see if I could create a virtual card online it says I have to download an app to my desktop in order to create virtual cards now. I don’t like that you are trying to force me to download more software to do something I was already able to do. I especially do not like that it has to be installed on my desktop. I absolutely never shop from my desktop and would have to go out of my way to do so since I am rarely near my computer when I am using my virtual cards. Please bring that feature back. I’ve actually almost completely stopped using my capital one card just because that feature is missing.

I’ve had my Capital One credit card for 4 years and 11 months. Never missed a payment. In fact I pay the entire balance off each month before the due date. My credit limit is a whopping $1050. I’ve requested credit limit increases many times over the years and am routinely denied because I “don’t utilize the credit” already offered. This is to be interpreted as ; since you don’t carry a balance we aren’t making any money off of you. So of course they are entitled to make money. And I’m entitled to use the companies that increase my credit limit so that I can have better credit scores (and thus lower interest rates)when I’m buying a car or a house. I get offers from Capital One regularly to utilize them for a car loan, personal loan, etc. Why would I work with them when they won’t work with me? Never. I’ll stay with, and do business with companies that respect hard working people who pay on time. That’s loyalty and that’ll be who I give good reviews to. Not money grubbing poorly run companies.

I am happy with the bank but extremely disappointed with this ‘Updated’ App. Things started to go downhill in January 2021 when an upgrade was made. I was left with a message that popped up saying I needed to download the latest iOS version (which I had done 1 week prior) The App supposedly supported 12.0 and above. I called support and spoke to several people in the bank branch and no one could explain why the pop up message continued. Now I can no longer use this App because it supports 13.0. Every other App I have considers the need for 12.0. I don’t understand why Capital One developers made This change but I’m certain I’m not the only one affected by it. Not everyone has a new phone or should be expected to buy a new phone just to use an App. I imagine Capital One is going to lose a lot of customers for lack of consideration by the App designers. Extremely disappointed in this (non) service. Do the developers even read the comments? There are an extraordinary number of dissatisfied and disappointed customers that have written reviews here re: the inability to use the App because they can’t upgrade their phones to iOS 13. Probably soon to be ex-customers if you are unwilling to rework to App to include everyone. Thank you

reviews.t: Capital One Gave Me a Chance
reviews.x: I have been with Capital One for some time now and I have honestly been very satisfied in more ways than one. The App itself, it's extremely useful and easy to use. Once you open the App you intuitively know where to go and what to do; make your payments, see your due dates in advance, activities on where you may have used your Capital One, emails/texts notification, and so much more. Furthermore, at a much more personal level, Capital One Gave Me a Chance with a credit card, when every single other credit card industry in USA rejected me. I once had an impressive high FICO score for many years in my life, being financially super responsible with my financial obligations, until I went to an university to get an American dream education and I ended up with students loans that became impossible to repay. After other personal circumstances took root and literally destroyed my every hope in life to have a future, I then risked a personal emotion applying for Capital One and they accepted me. I cried, because I felt they saw perhaps the injustice of someone's demise and Capital One took me in. I am extremely grateful and very appreciative for the opportunity to be a happy Capital one member. Thank you so much Capital One. I’m grateful and very pleased. Thank you Capital One.

Overall, I’ve been satisfied with Capital One and this app. The problem is, it keeps saying I need to upgrade my iOS to version 13.0, because my current version won’t be supported on here much longer. I have an older phone, and I downloaded the most recent iOS version of 12.5.2 recently.
