Capital One needs to keep this version working with my iOS, because I see no reason up upgrade my perfectly working phone to keep using your app. If the app stops working, then I’ll stop being a Capital One customer. Edit: Downgraded rating from 3 to 1 star. The older version of this app is no longer working. It won’t let me upgrade to the newest version of the app because my phone hasn’t been upgraded to a version 13.0. I have the most recently updated iOS on my phone, 12.5.3. The only way for me to update to a version 13.0 is to get a new phone, which I don’t need. If Capital One wants to buy me a new phone, I might consider continuing to use their app. I have never missed a payment, but perhaps Capital One doesn’t like my money, anymore.

Bad enough they want the latest version of their app but that they also want you to keep buying a new phone along with it? The latest version they didn't make for the latest version of earlier iOS versions and unlike other banking apps such as wells fargo, citi, bank of america, american express, which work and provide updates, Capital one somehow insists on some feature in the latest version of iOS that is just imperative to function. I think not. Fix that, not everyone has a new phone. Even spare phones that one uses in the mean time just to get by when they lose ability to use their phone (lost/broken/etc) cannot do any banking. Don't tell me you have more security than all those other big-name banks either. Note that there isn't a "new update" released they want you to use that came out arbitrarily rendering prior ones useless, but an internal decision to just make prior versions no long work after phoning home. They only want to write an app that uses stuff in iOS 13 and 14, which nothing exists that is required to do banking, i'm sorry! There just isn't. Lazy programmers. What this does, is just have me use the banks i can actually use-your lack of thoughtfulness and consideration just shoots your own self in the foot! Bye!

reviews.t: Excellent except for one very big flaw
reviews.x: I am often out of the country and when I am I use the local mobile phone service, meaning I do not have access to my US phone number. Capital One only offers one method for a security check in the App - a text message to a US number. So I can never activate my App if the security check is required when I am not in the US. This is stupid. All my other bank and card services offer alternative ways for a security check - either by email or through the App on another device. Capital One does not, and I have no idea why. I have reported this problem to Capital One many times in the last few years - nothing has changed. I can’t believe I am the only one with this problem. The result is that I am reluctant to use my card while abroad...

I recently added my son to my account as a way to pay him allowance money and help him learn how to save. However, on his account I have not been able to add external accounts. The accounts I want to add for him are the same ones that are currently attached to my credit card. When I try to add my info again it states that the external account is waiting for verification. It has now been several weeks and still the account has not been linked for me to set-up easy transfers. Also, the app does not explain how to allow him access to the app without sharing my info. I would prefer him not to be able to see where all holiday gifts are coming from and how much I am spending. The app has also not allowed me to switch his money from spendable to save. Just updated the app to see if it would help but the issues are still occurring.

This is an easy to use, fast app that has everything I’m looking for at my fingertips... I wish they would add one feature. I get notifications for all my upcoming due dates for all my credit cards via SMS. But when I tried to add the notifications for my car payment, it only has the option to send the notification to my email and not to send me a text. I really would love if that feature could be added. I recommend Capital One for their credit cards, they have great auto loan rates and applying for an auto loan was amazingly easy, I just wish I could be kept up to date on my auto loan as conveniently as I’m kept up to date with my credit cards. But that is an App issue not an actual issue with Capital One itself.

Hello Capital 1. I have been a user of your app for a while and I would like to recommend something that it’s missing. When you transfer money at the bottom there's a part to add memos so that you aware of what are you transferring. I recently was checking some transactions on my account and I needed to see what was that money for but I couldn't see it in the memos. I thought it we weird cause I knew I always add them but I couldn't see them on the app. When I used the website and clicked on the same transfer I was able to see the memo I added. I know it's no a big deal but it will be good if you consult this to your app engineering so they can update this issue. You should be able to see your memos not only on a computer but on the app too. Thank you.

Every time I go to an ATM from capital one, the ATM “is not currently accepting” deposits. It is so annoying that from every 10x, nine is broken. It is so annoying that I start thinking to banking with the big nationals branches, was not bad even when they charge a monthly fee was worth it I guess. This bank have ONE ATM only at every target and the next one is another word mikes away and for the same reason is also “unable to accept deposits”. Honestly I would not recommend this bank at all. Also their toll free is not 24 hours and even worse it is with eats cost which is SO EARLY when they are closed on the east cost, 7pm to us (pacific). Easy cost no branches, no ATM (unless you only need to withdraw money) and no phone customer service. Online services are awesome, at least they did ONE thing right. For me it is annoying driving to an ATM that I am crossing my fingers that it will be accepting deposits.

I only see one of the recent reviewers mentioning that they can’t pay bills since the last update. I am having that problem because Capital One did some kind of change with checking accounts back in January and now it shows to checkingAccounts and one that is not closed shows the balance available until you go in and then everything is zero and you cannot do anything with that account. Someone please fix!!!!Capital One used to be great I would have given the app five stars. I do feel like all the sudden everything is more difficult with Capital One in a time where technology is making everything else easier suddenly it takes longer for everything to post and I started getting snail mail letters instead of emails of the final verification for all mobile deposits!!

Out of all my banking and credit card apps (twelve and counting), the Capital One App is, by far, the best. With two Capital One Bank Accounts and three Capital One Credit Cards, ease of navigation is an important factor in my summation. Upon opening the app; however, having all of my accounts right there, on the home page, attractively displayed, with all of the relevant and needful information shown without requiring an action on my part... Well... That is what makes this the best of my apps. It’s aesthetic, comprehensive, functional, and, if it were a financially sound decision, I would use Capital One exclusively for my banking needs. Alas... Must need diversity. My other financial providers should use Capital One’s app as a template for their own.

I’ve been a customer since the ING days, and though I still think Capital One is a good place to be, the app’s becoming a bit of an overstuffed, twitchy mess. It really doesn’t need to do/be/show everything, does it? If I want general auto finance info or lists of merchants with whom I might get a small discount for linking my Cap One credit card to them (i.e., marketing offers), I’m happy to use the full site in exchange for having better, more detailed information on my actual bank & credit card accounts in the app. After the most recent update, credit card account info was inaccessible for 24+ hours, I’ve had to redo account display options settings several times (this is always a problem post-updates), and Memo fields can’t seem to make up their minds if they’re alpha only or alpha-numeric. Both the app and the full site dropped a savings-to-checking transfer set up 2 days in advance; I reentered it tonight & it ended up being duplicated. An inter-account transfer to correct the duplication did not appear immediately, as it should. The redesign of the app displays might work on a large monitor, but on an iPhone screen not so much. It’s not helpful to have the “I want to...” box take up 1/3 of the screen so I have to scroll down to see account activity, or to click the info icon and instead of a window opening get a jerky slide down the screen to another outsized box with the Account Info items. (By the way, including Current Balance in said Account Info is superfluous since it’s already shown at the top of the screen when I click open a specific account.) And it would be nice to be able to edit future credit card payments instead of having to cancel and start over just to change the date or amount. Thanks, and apologies for my perhaps overstuffed review.

They don’t charge you any money to keep your money, the capital one venture card it’s very easy to use and the rewards are good, the people are friendly whenever you have to talk to themAnd it’s not very difficult to get one of them on the phone. Capital one is my favorite bank I also bank with Bank of America and Chase and I do quite a bit would be a VA but I still don’t like them as much is capital one. Chase Bank and everybody else have a long way to go to catch up. The only problem I can find is that there are very very very few actual locations where you can go inside and do any banking. There needs to be a few more locations to make capital one competitively accessible. I also live in a very densely populated area (Dallas Fort Worth ) and there is still only two and I have to drive over 10 miles to get to either one. And all I would say if you were a person who needs a bank account and you do not have a capital one account you will be making a mistake. Even if you already have another these are very easy to get and highly convenient to have cheers!

I have been a Cap1 customer since it was ING. I made payments on time for years and when I asked for a reduction in the exorbitant interest rate I was basically told NO. And was given options to pay it down quicker WHICH is my problem because I have been struggling with the covid issue. I have since missed payment or been late because I don’t have enough to make even a dent in the principal. I have to pay double the min payment as it’s $300/mo in interest! I haven’t been able to pay it down even a little for over 5 years. And I keep having to use it emergencies or necessities, but feel like I am spinning my wheels because you won’t do anything to help as you are living like kings off of peoples hardships, completely unwilling to help even a little. (And I am taking more than the 1.5% reduction for 6 months that you gave me a couple years ago which was basically insulting to my loyalty. I hope to be able to transfer the balance to a better company and close all of my Cap1 accounts.

i return something on Monday, get Credit on Acct thurs, get notification on Sunday....3 days later and always laugh ! what good is something that lags days behind. also i have diff accts to pay diff charges from , i set day to pay, amount to pay then check the acct. if need be i change acct and it wipes out everything i put it. no access to virtual credit card number, rewards totals should be listed on front page not have to go looking in redeem rewards. use cap one shopping , installed and deleted in 1/2 hour as it is bait and switch pricing. was looking for a case, 10 reams of 500 sheets. i found a great deal on staples and cap one keeps pushing cap one shopping. downloaded it found same paper same number of reams listed on ebay for $10 less. thanks cap one...followed link to ebay and almost got suckered. the great price listed on cap one shopping .....well it was for 3 reams so $32 for 10 reams on staples site and $23 for 3 reams using cap one shopping. i could have paid $77 MORE if i bought following Cap one shopping. i tried few other items and even got sites that listed product the following link found the product was nowhere to be found but lots of diff items. For me this is not best app. i like cap one card would not have anything else but it. however the app is severely lacking

reviews.t: Sign in security measures do not work
reviews.x: I am active duty military, stationed overseas. My phone (an iPhone 6) has a foreign number which Capital One will not let me use to verify my account in order to sign in. Recently the app has added a feature where you can place your credit card on your phone and use Near Field Communication in order to verify your account. Only problem is that it doesn’t work. I have gone through the help section offered by Capital One on the app and have tried every variation of placing my card on my phone, but have gotten nowhere. I also cannot email anyone from Capital One because there is no customer service email address. Update 29 January 2021: Still nothing has been done to help active duty service members stationed overseas with access to this app. Why have you created a Near Field Communication feature when it doesn’t work, and you still do not have an option to verify identities using anything other than a U.S. phone number? This is not that complicated a problem. Figure it out.

Why would you charge customers for each item of a overdraft fee when other banks charge for one fee in total of the account? That’s ridiculous. For each item 35 dollars you guys are out of your mind. Other banks I still bank with their over draft fees like Bank of America, wellsfargo, Citibank, not even prepaid banks charge each item of the checking account $35? They charge $35 fee for the whole account instead of being a great bank you guys are trying to screw people over for fees of each item instead of being a fee of the entire account. People won’t see it until they go thru it them self ones they see that they will complain like I have and capital one so-called great bank and they want them to refer customers to their banks I won’t send my family and friends to a bank that in case they go over their debit card account they going to be screwed over $35 for each transaction posted on a same day? Nope I won’t do that to the people I know. I learn the hard way. In times of covid capital one of instead of replacing their fee they want to hurt their customers like that? that’s ridiculous. I can even screenshot all transactions made in one day from my checking where made in one day and they shove 5 times $35 overdraft fees when other banks do one fee to cover the whole account. And I’m a very loyal customer that never complain and these fees are ridiculous and should be attended and fix by the company. I don’t want others to go they this them self it’s to much money they taking away for customers to cover their purchases and then to get screwed at the end for a lot of fees.

reviews.t: I like capital one, but not their representatives.
reviews.x: I have been with capital one for many years now, and when I have asked in the past to see if they could lower my interest rates I was informed that they can’t do that. But they could give me a lower rate for 7 months and after that it would return to the normal rate. That was always helpful for me to be able to pay down my bill faster, and when I was short on cash. But this time when I called hoping that I would be able to get my interest down every for a short period of a time. When I asked the representative if I could get a lower rate this time I was TURNED DOWN FLAT and was refused any help on getting it lowered. Not even for a short term. Instead I was told that if I want to get it lower I should make higher or more payments or make early payments to reduce the interest, I AM ON A TIGHT BUDGET AND AND CAN ONLY AFFORD SO MUCH A MONTH!!!!!! is that how you treat your costumers? I just about smashed that card because of the way that I was treated by you and just might start using the other companies card that does have a lower rate then yours.

Mostly things are great with the bank and their customer service. 1st problem is that the app does not clearly show your payment due date. You really have to go from menu to menu to find it. 2nd problem is the the app does not include previous statement balance to current total balance. I always try to pay my payments weekly to avoid the high interest fees but it seems that Capital one always have additional balance due after you fully pay off the account and always finds a way to charge the interest fees... If they fix these 2 problems this credit card company might be ranked above all others

reviews.t: Love this, Check it every day
reviews.x: I check my accounts on here multiple times a day. It’s a speedy experience, and the layout is extremely comprehensible. I love that I can know exactly which account is what just by seeing them on the screen summary before I even select one, and I can know exactly what my situation is. When I make a payment using one account to the other, the transfer is speedy on the app so there’s no guessing how much I have left in my accounts after transactions. I get IMMEDIATE notifications when there’s ANY activity on my accounts, and this helped me get one step ahead on fraud just two days ago. I ordered a new card and spoke to the support clerk about what my next steps would be within minutes of the unapproved charge even happening, and it’s all because of the efficiency of this app.

So I’ve had Capital One for about a month now and I’m not happy with the app. I assumed the app would be something like a banking mobile app meaning, I’m able to look at my spending and balance. Unfortunately I haven’t been able to do it. I don’t know if it’s because the site it’s self isn’t working or not but I’m getting frustrated. I don’t want to have to call the customer line to get a accurate balance. I want the convenience of being able to login to the app and BOOM my available balance is there as well as transaction history. I like Capital One so far, I just don’t care for the app at the moment. What’s use of it if it can’t tell me where I stand? Oh it does have perk, you can view your credit score anytime and it’s accurate.

I’ve been a Capital One customer for over 3 years. Everything was great and I really use to enjoy using my card and the ease of the app. In 2020 during Covid I had some fraud on my card so I filed a dispute. The first dispute I’ve ever filed in my entire life. Spoke to 2 customer service reps and was told “ohhh it’s fine, we will give you a temp credit, you fill out a few docs, and you’ll be good to go” ... What they failed to say is that they lock your card and hold your balance (even my previous available balance that had nothing to do with the dispute) for months until the issue is resolved. There was just a ton of information that the “disputes team” failed to tell me. I honestly wouldn’t even have filed the dispute if I knew it would be this bad, during a hardship/pandemic at that. I work in customer service so I know how companies use foreigners for call centers, but the foreigners at this call center are honestly horrible. Reading straight from a script and can not answer any specific detailed questions. Also very rude and get angry quickly when you challenge what they are saying. I’m done with Capital one for a while, maybe they will improve their customer service in the future.

My card was compromised and I was stuck. Capital One sent me a text and told me to call the number to report the issue. For three days I attempted to call waiting on hold each time at least 15 to 20 minutes. Finally, when I could wait no longer, I called the third day. I was on hold for 30 minutes and got disconnected. I called back and was on hold for another 30 minutes and had to hang up. I then called one more time and was on hold an HOUR AND A HALF before someone finally answered. This is unacceptable. When Fraud is detected, why is this not more urgent for Capital One? Why is Customer Service not being addressed? Why do you not have enough people in your support center to answer the many calls? Why is there not a separate fraud division to immediately handle issues? This truly makes me question my relationship with capital one. I am a long-time customer, but if I cannot get service when desperately needed, why should I be loyal to you?

They punish their excellent rated customers. They lowered my credit line 75%, because I did not use my full line for several months. I worked very hard for that credit line over several years and they just simply say... goodbye! What if I needed it for an emergency or large purchase? Isn’t that what it’s for? I was not going to apologize because I had everything that I needed at that moment and there was no big ticket item that I needed to purchase. Did they punish me because I did not incur any late fees? Or that I did not carry a monthly balance? I don’t know for sure. I followed what there Credit Wise platform had suggested. It’s okay, Apple/Goldman Sachs stepped right in their place and replaced that credit line, In all honesty I’d rather deal with a company that does not sh** on their 820 FICO customer because obviously they want late fee’s and customers who carry a monthly balance at their high rates. I will be posting my review on all my social media platforms, so people will know the truth about this company.

capital one is a pretty okay bank. especially in terms of having little to no monthly/yearly fees. but they also have a LOT of bs with them.. 1) at least 5 times a year, the app locks everybody out and refuses to let us sign in. or it lets us sign in and we see that our bank accounts have either been drained or have disappeared completely. and most of the time i wouldn't even notice this until i'd go to swipe my card and it declines (embarrassing!) when i know full well i do have money in the account. this issue is usually resolved within a few hours, but still, thats a major security issue.. 2) the available balance/remaining balance calculator is often inaccurate. which results in overspending and going into the negatives. i recently bought a spending log to keep track of my own purchases for this reason, but most people dont have time to stop and do the math after every purchase and trust that the app their bank provides them with will accurately do it for them (because it should), but it doesnt. 3) this one is more personal than the others but still should be addressed. i made a mobile payment to my credit card last week. i got a notification the next day saying my payment was posted and saw where my available balance and credit card balance both decreased by the amount that i'd paid .. fast forward through the weekend, i wake up bright and early and see that i have an email from capital one saying that they'd taken the money out of my account this morning. checked my account, and sure enough, its gone. but the money was supposed to be gone last week, because thats what the app and email told me. so it looks like the money was processed out of my checkings account twice (especially since i've been keeping track of my purchases and i'm sure that i haven't spent more than what i had) and that's really put a damper on my week because the money that i had left was supposed to get me through the week. and it's just really frustrating that i constantly feel like i have a bank who i cant trust with my money. will be switching banks soon

I went to unlock my card last Saturday night and found both my checking account and savings account were missing from the app. There was a message “there is a problem with your account, please contact customer service to resolve it.” Unfortunately it was midnight so no customer service reps were available. I called the next day and they said there was no problem and it was most likely a glitch in the app and I should try updating it. I had the most recent version and the problem resolved itself. But just the inconvenience of not being able to access my money makes mE not want to use this bank anymore. I suggest everyone switch to Chime. Great customer service. Great mobile app. And direct deposits are available up to 48 hours earlier than Capital One. Oh. And yes I have several times seen my balance drop without any record of withdrawal. Chime sends you a daily alert with your balance. So I know exactly how much money I have. #ByeBoomers

reviews.t: Bait and switch with interest-bearing savings account
reviews.x: Capital One did a bait and switch for the interest-bearing savings account. My partner and I both transferred funds into their interest-bearing savings account because they offered a $500 sign on bonus. My partner got his $500 but they told me I wasn’t going to get my $500 because I filed after the deadline. I initiated the account during the deadline but the transfers that allow money to wire back-and-forth was not processed till after the date. Capital One is claiming that I don’t qualify for the sign on bonus. It’s too bad because I will probably be transferring my money out if they do not honor the sign on bonus. And I may be able to get my partner to transfer his funds as well.

I tried to deposit my check last week. Glitch found. The app is not distinguishing the difference in check numbers. The check was from the same source for the same amount. When uploading the photos, the app response was “this check was already deposited”. I tried several times with the same response. I obtained another check from the same source for the same amount. Once again, “this check was already deposited. The pictures were clear in good lighting on a dark wood service. I had to go to the bank. Please fix this. I have limited mobility and no car. Expensive trip to the bank.

First, y’all need to add electronic funds transfer that allows checking account to checking account electronic deposit transfer this eliminates paper check delays in the mail; such as with regular web bill pay, and makes things far more efficient. Please add this feature other banks do, I’ve had this feature before thru other banks, Capital One should have this as big name as it is Secondly, why can’t I see my recurring transfers or any transfers in pending status and why isn’t there an ability to add or edit as such on the app. I have to go to the website to see and/or edit my transfers, otherwise the app just allows you to make a one time transfer and set one up . Features need to be enhanced to allow display of current transfers n the ability to set up recurring transfers and to edit. Aside from that, I’m happy with Capital One... another feature that would be nice, would be to add categories to the savings in which you can direct portions of your savings to go, car maintenance in one stash, vacation in another stash, a date night stash, emergency funds stash we could edit each stash to make it our own... this would be fun n convenient, but the first two paragraphs are about business and are high priority on my list as I’m sure it is for others also

reviews.t: Not impressed can’t even log into the app
reviews.x: Where to start? So far a pretty big let down right from the beginning! The app never loads for me and I can’t get into my account so I have to use the website. That usually makes me put in all kinds of security codes so not exactly convenient. I opened the account and they didn’t even ship the card until the next week, which then takes another 6-10 days to be delivered they told me! So that’s now over two weeks just to get my debit card from them. Took 5 days for my deposit to show up and become available, doesn’t matter anyway, can’t do anything with the money without a debit card! Called customer service and they barely knew what to tell me other than sorry! Thank god I have another bank I use because this is not a basket I would put all my eggs in!!

I enjoy Capital One and I think they are a great bank for Savings and Checking. However I believe that their app is tailored to credit card holders. The Push Notifications are literally nonexistent for checking and savings accounts. This a deal breaker for me. When my card is swiped, no notification. When money is transferred, no notifications. When money is withdrawn, no notifications. When I receive a direct deposit, no notification. When money is moved from my account without me know, no notifications. This is a very important feature for me because I trust a lot of my money with this bank. I have checked my settings multiple times, on iOS and in the app. I have always had this problem no matter the update. It’s annoying. Update: (6/21) Still no fix. I just came to update to say that the app is virtually useless. Why have an app if your gonna send me to the web to do anything involving my accounts. I never had this problem with other banks. Apps are supposed to make life convenient.

I’ve had capital one for a few years now and i would say a good 80-90% of the time i go to sign in to check my account they are either doing “maintenance” or its just doesnt allow me to sign in and keeps showing the loading bar. I have 3 other credit cards and none of their apps have i had this issue with. I keep updates turned on and even with deleting and reinstalling the app it consistently gives me issues. I’m so done with this company for so many reasons but i dont want to close the account because that will affect my credit and i have to use it every couple months otherwise they will automatically close my account. Customer service is a joke (even before the pandemic). When the app actually does work its pretty decent and up to par with other banking apps as far as functionality and ease of use. Unfortunately thats a rare occurrence so thats why i give it a 1 star rating.

In today’s electronic age it should not take 4 days for funds to transfer between banks, ie; from Bank of America to CapOne takes 4 days, why? Peoples is 1 day but CapOne has best interest on savings. But I opened savings because of the awesome interest rate, well awesome as it can be 1.4. Sounds so tiny compared to what banks make off of us at 23.9 on most credit cards, crazy. I would also like to see alerts in the app vs coming thru text. And I had to open a checking account in order to get access to my savings via a atm debit card. Just in case I need any savings I can get it, or else I would have to wait 4 BUSINESS days to get it to another bank account with debit card access.

This app used to work flawlessly for me. However, over the past few months it has been buggy. I’m working with an iPhone 6s which as of this review is still supported. Here’s how it’s buggy. I’ll try to open the app and it’ll take around 30 seconds in trying to load before it crashes. I’ll usually have to try to open the app at least 2 or more times before it’ll finally decide to display the log in menu. Once I’m in, it usually works from there but I’ve also experienced bugs after logging in as well where it says “sorry something went wrong try again later”. I’ve had instances when I’ll tap one one of my accounts only to find myself stuck in it and I’ll have to close the app and reopen it again. Assuming I get past the constant crashes before getting to the log in menu. I’ve also notice that it has to think a lot which causes the app to be laggy. I understand the security can sometimes make applications slow but this has been going on for quite some time and it’s getting progressively worse. It’s a great app and it does what I need it to do when it works. But there’s a lot that needs to be fix and optimized.

I have had this and many other apps for years dependent on my unlimited data only / no WiFi access at home. until now - latest update will NOT download - exceeds 200mb - I have chatted with Victor, Teresa and Ricardo only to have my session ended before any resolution. Seeking out WiFi for every update when it was not necessary in the past for this app or any other will not be an option for me. I have allowed for extra storage in my data - I have attempted to download through personal hotspot. Unbelievable how much time I have spent on this / have two Capital one accounts - need to check activity, balances and make deposits and payments is all. All I want is to continue using their app but customer service has been an all time worst. At this point I am frustrated and I’m appalled - Only alternative is to use different cards with a functioning app- DO NOT DO BUSINESS WITH CAPITAL ONE - too many good ones to choose from to put up with this! Seriously over two hours just tonight

This is a user friendly app that makes it easy for me to lock my card, check transactions and verify my balance or availability. ***I’d like more individual transaction options. For example, Apple credit card allows you to select a transaction to dispute or further research. It also allows you to dispute the transaction via the app /remotely without having to call. This is especially useful when wait times are over an hour.. especially when your call back feature isn’t secure (eg rep calls from a number that comes up as a scam , says their in AZ but number is CA and you don’t know whether they’re actually CapOne lol). Also, time being my most precious asset; is rather reduce the amount of time I spend on any issues. Your app makes it quick to do most things except that (address issues). Kudos on the easy card lock feature. ***It would be nice to be able to access my account via the app without having to unlock my card since I’m obviously the end user/card holder. Thanks !

reviews.t: It didn’t work for me, now it does
reviews.x: I used this app for a couple of years, it was quite good. But about a week ago, it stopped working. My first try to open always fails, second try bring up the sign-in page. The user name is there, I enter the password, it’s working...working, then I get this: “Looks like we need to fix something, we’re working on it. Try again later.” The only exit is “OK”. I have been trying it every day or two, but it’s always the same. So I always have to go to the website, which is not as good. UPDATE: Always seems a big hassle to get things fixed, but the CS people are always friendly and try hard. My first try to open still fails, but 2nd try works fine, both my credit cards are accessible, I’m happy now.

Yes, this is a real review. Which probably already makes it sound fake. Whatever, read it if you want. This is an intelligently designed app with a home screen that really only has 3main options on its home screen. These include profile, credit score thing, and whatever accounts you have. After that it works like an ancestry tree. Once you select the broad option you want to go into, it branches in to several more detailed options that only relate to the broad subject you chose. Really easy to figure out. Only annoyance I’ve had is it can sometimes lag when logging in, meaning it takes a little longer to load than my other bank apps.

reviews.t: I highly DO NOT RECOMMEND capital one.. they don't care about customers
reviews.x: In these unprecedented times capital one comes out on the bottom in comparison to other credit card companies. I have lost my job for over 8 weeks. I called other credit card companies to help offset my compounding credit card interest fees debts. Discover and a few other credit card companies has offered such relief. Discover is really great, maybe the greatest credit card company. They eliminated the interest fees from the present, future and past monthly interest fees. I know, That's crazy right? However capital one won't give you back a penny. They only offer to extend your minimum payment. That's not an offer because you're still accruing interest on your balance. It's times like this which shows the true character of a company. I liked capital one before but after experiencing very little effort to extend any kind of incentives to their customers I'll stick with other credit card companies. Sorry capital one. I've lost trust and loyalty for your company. I can't wait to pay off my balance to close my credit card with you. The catchy slogans and commercials are bull$|-|it. They want to keep their credit card in your pocket so you keep paying those ridiculous interest rates. They're only looking to make money off of you. You're just a number. Go with other more understanding credit card companies. I highly DO NOT RECOMMEND capital one

reviews.t: app is below average and customer service lays low and below the app
reviews.x: Frustrated- during Covid crisis after seeing an error being charged too much interest and a valid membership fee I called in to discuss the error in the interest charge and pleaded for them to please waive the annual membership fee. I was appalled by the way I was spoken down to. Everyone in my household has lost their jobs, we can’t get through to unemployment for finacial assistance, and I was hoping that Capital One would be there to help, show empathy and consideration as we have been long time members. We have never been late on ANY PAYMENTS...ever!!! Capital One should be ashamed as they have revealed their true selves...not only are they NOT here to help through the pandemic, but they are extremely rude and let this member know that I “clearly” did not understand basic arithmetic. I called a competitor and they helped pay off one of my capital one balances ... Looking forward to getting help from another competitor to clear the one balance left with C.O. and I can say farewell to this awful institution and hello to lower interest rates and excellent service from your competition.

I have used similar apps for one national bank, a regional bank, and a regional credit union. This one is the most intuitive and the most useful. The checkbook transaction leger shines. When you enter recurring transactions the ones scheduled for the next several weeks are included in the display and there's a running balance. This is very useful in planning near term spending, as your fixed expenses are already budgeted. You can enter checks (as opposed to electronic transactions) so you, in effect, has a full electronic register. You'd think that all banking apps would be set up this way, but they aren't. In both similar apps that I have used the recurring fixed transactions only display as the payments are made.

reviews.t: Love having a Capital One Credit Card! Excellent Experience!!
reviews.x: Capital One is awesome! Love the convenience & security of all and the app. It’s super easy to use &understand. Capital One is not only in my wallet, it’s also on my phone; the Notifications are super fantastic for every transaction or payment, love the instant reminder, which I greatly admire it’s just additional comfort & safety protection for me. I personally are So appreciative & thankful to be a card holder. I don’t feel like a credit card holder, I feel like a family member. Capital One y’all are the... UTMOST FINEST OF EXCELLENCE! Thanks so much for always, being right here at the very moment. Please, Continue, keep up the incredible work, staying awesome with incredible excellences. God Bless, Stay Safe.!

This app is like a ten star meal * Everything about it just smells great * It’s easy to use even if your a beginner in navigating technical electronics * From start to finish it doesn’t disappoint it’s users * Their are a lot of extra’s you can download within the bank app like credit wise * Credit Wise pulls the information from your credit report to show you your credit score * It is very user friendly and your credit score will not be compromised or lowered at all * Other apps are available to give you return money on your purchases * The app will make sure if there is a price drop on recently purchased items; It will notify you via email to get your price difference back* Believe me when I say this app is so very very cool * I hope you enjoy it as much as I do * Tell Next Time Cheers bottoms up *

I read a couple of books last summer, “Click Here to Kill Everyone” and the one Past-president Clinton wrote with Patterson’s writing army. I was experiencing attacks on my iMac and BookPro and yet doubted my perceptions. This stuff, online security, is a real and pressing problem for us as individuals and for business and government. I use Wells’ and Capital One’s banking applications. Both feel secure. C1 feels more robust. Orange, C1’s predecessor was rock solid, confidence-building was crucial in the early days of online service of any kind. C1 feels like a big, glossy bank in comparison to Orange. So, more of a target for bad players. Not as big as WF but a big brother of a bank. Even so, this app feels protective of access on my account.

While the app on a whole is ok it’s flawed. Simple lack of thought in its design. For instance. For several weeks now I’ve been greeted by a “complete account set up” message when I open the app. I added a credit card to the app It’s added as a new account. It keeps asking me to add a user to the card. I am not going to add a user as there is no need to add one. Yet there is no option to tell the stupid app that I am not going to add a user. Thus I continue to see the stupid message every time I use the app. Just a simple “no” option would fix this stupid hassle. Do the idiots that designed it really believe every person will add a user to a card? Like I said it’s a lack of thought in its design. Another irritation is being forced to update it to use it. Maybe I’m not at home and don’t want the download update over my cell connection or maybe I’m in a hurry and don’t have the time to update it at that moment. Again like I said it’s a stupid lack of thought in its design at the simplest level.

• Crashes while loading in Low Power Mode; the app does not work at all in Low Power Mode. Something like this should be instant disqualification from the App Store. • 320+MB for essentially a severely handicapped webview. This is the first app i offload when I run low on space. • still can't show me at least a full month of transactions in my 360 account. Even after I click the "View All Transactions" button. Some artificial limit of ~40 transactions. This. Is. Ridiculous. • cannot search or view ATM/branch locations without logging in 🤦‍♂️. This is public information completely unrelated to my personal accounts. • joint account holder debit card purchases are not labeled (as they are on the full web site) • they made it nearly impossible to re-activate my debit card to Apple Pay. This may not be strictly to blame on this app, but maybe due to "enhanced" security measures since the last time I did it. Sorry, I am not going to upload an image of my ID to be leaked in your next data breach. I tried to do it over the phone and while talking to a rep the call just ended. --- previous review: A banking app that doesn't allow me to view at least a month's worth of transactions is utterly useless and shameful and a joke. I should be able to view all transactions since the beginning of time. But Capital One seems to think that 2 week's worth is just plenty. All the other features don't matter at all, if I can't even see activity from more than 14 days ago. 👎💩

This app is alright for the most part but it needs a lot of work. Its not reliable with ACCURATELY showing available amount, pending amount and transactions. It used to only happen with gas station transactions but now its happening with all kinds of purchases. This is the process- I buy something and it *usually* shows up immediately in the pending section. a few days later the transaction disappears completely- doesnt show up in pending, in finalized transaction, or is taken out of the available balance. So if you havent checked your account for a week or so and forgot about some purchases, you will THINK you have more available balance as your account on the app shows. But then the next day you could have hundreds less than the day before and youre left to wonder what payments it was from because the dates for the finalized transactions dont always add up. Honestly the capital one app is a mess, 2 stars is generous as I never have been and continue to be unimpressed.

The only problem that I have with this app is that where it says WHEN your next payment is due, it does not tell you HOW MUCH is due. It would be really nice to have that info right next to it. I made a payment towards the end of the month to turn my balance into a flat, even, number as I usually do. Then when it was approaching my due date the next month, I was not sure if I had covered minimum payment or not. I called capital one and a representative mis-informed me my minimum payment was already covered. I did not make a further payment. Next time I checked, the account was past due and I was charged a late fee. When I called back the next representative was very nice and removed the fee from my account. BUT, it would be nice to be able to clearly see in the app the remaining balance that is due. Or if it has already been paid, $0 until next statement in order to avoid all of this confusion in the first place. If they do this, 5 star app for sure!

I’m still waiting until iOS 13 bugs are all worked out, which apparently are still ongoing. So, with iOS 12.2, whether on an iPhone or an iPad, the latest version of the app (Version 5.63.0) no longer loads. A launch screen lights up when you tap the app, but the only thing visible is a white background, the Capital One name and the Capital One logo. The app never gets past that initial load or launch screen. Again, this problem for the app is occurring for both my iPhone and iPad. UPDATE: It never loads if... once you tap the app to open, you leave that app open on your screen. However, by accident I discovered that if you leave the app, but you don’t close it - it’s just open in the background while you look at the home screen or some other app - when you go back to the app, it does open. It’s an odd problem, but at least while the developers are working on a fix, there is this work-around.

reviews.t: Awesome App, but needs some fixing
reviews.x: This is a great app and is extremely easy to utilize. I’ve been using this app for years to check balances, make payments, and review my credit score. This has never been easier thanks to this app, however, since the most recent update / bug fix, the app has been taking a long time to load when wanting to quickly log in. Once logged in, I only have access to my balance and not any of the additional features that this app used to have: credit checking, cancelling / freezing a card, the Capital One Mobile assistant, etc. Not sure if this is a simple fix, or a big issue, but it would be nice to have all of the features available again. Hopefully this will be fixed soon.

reviews.t: Worse phone support I ever gotten.
reviews.x: I was having issues receiving money from Zelle. Called the phone support. The first representative made up an excuse to get off the phone. Saying I reach max number of attempts to register a number and to call back in 24 hours. I called back right after for another representative. The wait for a representative was less than 2 minutes (low call demand), he tells me to keep trying to reregister the number. If it was maxed out, why would the second representative tell me to keep trying... asked to speak to a manager but the wait was “really long”. I asked if I can leave a call back number but “they don’t do that”. I used to work in telemarketing and I know it’s hard dealing with frustrated people. I didn’t get loud or rude on the phone. The condescending attitude on the phone was just icing on the cake too after being on the phone with these representative for almost an hour. And I still haven’t gotten the money...

For some reason the app glitches out and rarely ever opens since the last time I updated it. So I've been using online banking through a browser on my phone which is inconvenient when there's supposed to be an app to make it much easier. I've found that like other reviewers here, I have issues with Capital One not updating my balances and putting seemingly random holds on deposits. From the app it only says "hold" but then accessing the accounts online it says the date when it will supposedly go through, which I didn't know until after I already tried to make a payment. Twice. What is the point of choosing a deposit date if the money won't go through until several days later. The payments I wanted to make got returned as the account "didn't have enough funds to cover the payment" which overall makes it look bad. As though I don't have money to pay my bills. Which I do! I've never had a late payment on my card and simply have another bank that I also use and make transfers to and from. Again, why the deposits were placed on hold, I have no idea. I transferred money into my Capital One savings thinking it would be easier to make a payment on my card using a Capital One account. Instead I had no access to the money for almost a week, and wished I'd just made a payment using my outside bank account. What in the world.

I love this app so much I even decided to go paperless with my statements. I can always see what is going on with myCapital One credit cards. I’m notified by text every time my card is charged. My Capital One Venture Card also gives me the option of “erasing” my travel purchases with the points earned on that card and I can take care of that in less than a minute with this app. This app is part of the reason that my Venture card is my favorite card. I have a Citi card too that has a rewards program I like a lot, because they send me a check once a year for my rewards, but their website is so terrible and I’ve never used their app. The only thing I don’t like is the app keeps saying I need to finish my account set up by adding my bank account to make payments which I will never do. I pay all my bills through my bank bill pay and everything is flagged to feed into the budget I made on my bank app.

reviews.t: Misleading Due Date / No App Support
reviews.x: I checked my app on Feb. 27 and it showed “No Payment Due” for March. Opened it again on March 5 to make a payment anyway, and it showed payment due March 2, and assessed $38 late fee. On March 6, it showed payment due April 2, and would only allow me to make minimum payment equivalent to double the monthly amount. I had to call Capital One and make March payment over the phone and speak to two different reps before getting credit for the late fee. I have screenshots of the false/misleading due date info, but Capital One reps did not want me to send to them for investigation and remedy. Feedback within the app is limited to SELECTING ONE OF FIVE FACE EMOJIS- FROWNY TO SMILEY. No text option for meaningful feedback. App support at the App Store level is a link to Capital One website offering general account services only. I can only conclude that Cap One is aware, responsible and happy with the faulty and misleading function of this app as I’m sure that I’m not the only one who has suffered wrongful fees. Will report to State AG, FTC and CFPB.

So this morning I log into the 360 app becouse I needed to find out what the banking hours were, I noticed that the app doesn’t provide that to you, it only let you know the ATM’s and the address wears one closes to you. So I had to log off of the app and instead go onto google and search for the bank closes in Levittown and I click onto website and then I was able to find the banking hours. And another thing I found out earlier this morning when I walked into the bank, I told the teller that I lost my debit card and she showed me wear to go on the app to do it, but then I asked her if I could get a temporary card until my new card comes in the mail, and she explained to be that the new 360 checking doesn’t let you do that all. Which I think it really inconvenient. Everything else I love, it’s just those two different things that annoy me.

reviews.t: Great if you NEVER need to deposit a check
reviews.x: UPDATE: Deposit function is working again and it seems faster and easier than ever!!! Updating my formerly one-star review to reflect how ecstatically happy I am once again. Original review below for anyone interested: * * * Loved this app when I first installed it and loved my 360 account! I could literally check my balance, or deposit a check in seconds. Unfortunately, for the past SIX MONTHS the mobile check deposit function has not been working. The second I tap the deposit option I receive a message saying “We hit a snag”. After uninstalling and reinstalling several times, hard booting my phone and iPads both, getting a brand new SIM card for my phone and several calls to Capital one, the developers STILL don’t care and there is no eta for a fix. Basically the entire point of my opening a capital one 360 account, namely ease of use on mobile apps, is entirely moot. Sadly, I may need to bank elsewhere.

Some odd lack of functions combined with some difficulty trying to navigate some of what is there. Overall not a really “bad” app, just needs some work. Still better than paper billing but it would be nice if I could pay as much as I want, when I want, instead of having to wait on “pending” transactions and then waiting up to 3 days to post credit. Most recent update has rendered app unusable! Login failed, reset password and got in on website to make a payment - but can’t get on app at all! Not with saved password, not with biometric. If I rest password then my credit wise app will not work- what a screwed up situation, circular loop logic fail! And now it wants to update but won’t download without WiFi - I only have hotspot! Cap1 is a great company, has my back on everything EXCEPT THIS APP! Very frustrating... Update about recent update! App refused to work without first updating, refused to update with my hotspot data - must use WiFi, which I don’t use - for 200mb. BS

Very easy to use. There is not one question on this app about your bill that you can’t find the answer to. I love the notifications of every time I use my card that in about five seconds it’s on my phone letting me know that my card is being used. The CreditWise that is in the App is very important free tool which makes me feel that is a genuine company that wants to help every customer to achieve their credit score that they will need in life. From the Balance you owe to the available credit you have to the easiest payment you will ever make and the very important notifications they give you makes this App the best one I have. Capital one gave me a chance and let me have a card when no one else would because I’m young and just starting to build credit and with this App I’m confident that Capital one will be my big break in my future credit score.

I had a low credit karma score 580 It was recommended that I could try to apply without effecting my CC score. I was excited because CapitalOne gave me a unsecured Credit card with a $300 limit and after 6 months they of making payments on time my line of credit increases to $500’s. I highly advise to check the percentage rate and the yearly fee that is charged on other Credit card company’s, And this company % rate is on the high side but I do not have a yearly fee to pay... but other companies will get you on that yearly fee every single month anything over $149 is to high. If you are trying to build your credit then accept those high yearly fees but try get your credit built back up and then call and close those high yearly fee cards. I hope this helps this information helps you.

Hi! I am a user of the capital one money app. This is my first time ever having a card of my own since I have a job now. I love the feature of setting money aside, but, it really doesnt do much if i can spend the money that is set aside when i am going over my spendable. It sort of defeats the purpose of setting aside. I wish that the app could either lock it and then deny the card as if the set aside money wasnt there and then send an immediate notification to the phone saying that the card user went over their spendable, and then have an override option. Like, if u understood u were going over but have to or choose to. Like if the item you are purchasing is important. I feel that these friendly reminders , since most people utilizing the money card are young people, would greatly assist in helping teens grasp the idea of saving and self control when it comes to their money. I know i have a habit of spending a lot of money on clothes that i dont really need. I just feel that this would help.

My credit line was taken away. I had 2 bank cards that were compromised. I am disable and not very sharp in the past months. I was so great full that they approved me. I was making payment from this site if I made them from my bank I would still have my credit line. I called to explain and they did not care. So, on there web site you can put in your bank account to pay your bills but you CAN NOT delete OLD CARDS that are no longer active. That’s were my errors came into play. I choose the wrong bank card numbers and I was not aware until the closed my account. No one called or left any messages, nothing. I have 2 cards the second card I made 1 mistake choosing the wrong bank card. They said they give you one chance, I didn’t get that chance with the second card. I found this site frustrating because thought it would be the best way to pay and not make mistakes, I WAS WRONG. 😩

I have had my account for almost 5 years and last month in preparation for Christmas I began shopping online. I had a decent credit limit but one not high enough to cover Christmas. After spending my limit I had to make payments within November to finish my shopping. Should of stopped using the credit card then but after spending and paying in excess of $2,000 CapitalOne began placing a 7 day hold on my payments. Now these Payne were coming from a Capital One 360 checking account and I received no assistance. They refused to contact my bank and verify funds as previously done. They even took an unauthorized payment from the 360 checking account and after reporting that as fraud and it being returned. The treatment received was even worse. I will be closing both accounts at my discretion. I have never been bullied or black flagged anywhere. I don’t know how they did it but somehow all my orders on line under my debit cards or other credit cards required identification verification. I cannot believe a company do large treats people as I have been treated.

reviews.t: Capital one app doesn’t do as advertised and customer service reps were rude and unhelpful
reviews.x: Online it says that you can start using your capital one card immediately upon approval by downloading the app where your card information will be made available to you. However, this is untrue. Half of the accounts cannot see their card details and Capital One will not tell you how they determine which users will/will not be able to see the information. When I called the customer service line, the supervisor was extremely rude. He asked me to stop talking multiple times, he told me vague and unhelpful and (at times) inaccurate information. I told him that he can disconnect, but I’d like to stay on the line to take the customer experience survey, and he said he wouldn’t disconnect. I asked if he could please transfer me to someone else, and he said he couldn’t do that either (which is not true). Terrible customer service experience. I wish I’d never applied for an account with this company.

I love the options available to me in the app and at my fingertips. I can make different Types of payments (one-time, recurring, etc), and each can be divided into payment and/or principal). Being able to add the additional funds to principal is going to make a huge impact on my payoff. Another feature is the ability to make bi-weekly payments (another bonus) that is going to help me payoff my loan even sooner without paying any additional funds/payments. And it will coincide with my paycheck so I don’t have to put the money aside every payperiod, it will just come out and be reducing my loan at the same time, leading to less interest being accrued. Win-Win! You can also view previous bank statements too. It has the payment coupon attached so if I decide to mail a payment instead, it will be easily accessible. You can also see your balance. This is especially important near the end of your loan and your watching the final payments be made! This is our first time using Capital One so we are new to the app, but so far so good!

Quick, easy and convenient. Credit card payments are easy to do on here. Credit card reward redemption is faulty at times , there’s a glitch on this app. Error message reads “oops we’re working on something , try again in a little bit”. However , you can wait for days and this error will still not clear . Capital one service support claims they’re not aware of the issue, but this issue is prevalent and has been going on for some time now. It’s hit or miss whether credit card reward redemption works . Service supper informed me “if you want to do redemption you have to do it online at a desktop computer, it doesn’t work on the app” - however that’s not entirely true it does work, it just has periods of time that it doesn’t . Don’t think it’s a maintenance issue.. you should look into this ..

First off this app really is great. With all the options easy to navigate through. Except one small inaccessible thing finding out payment posting times. My account is one payment behind so the app alerts me to resolve past due payment, but when I navigate through payment it never tells me up to what time of day payment is considered on time for that day. Tried asking “Eno” and was shut down with a blanket response that I must resolve past due account before “Eno”(listed under HELP) would be able to help. I asked for customer service phone number and was given the exact same response. It seems “Eno” is no help at all since it is blocked from helping past due customers. I am trying to resolve past due before I have a 2nd missed payment and need to know payment posting time to do this. Please give “Eno” some knowledge to answer us PAST DUE account holders so we can do exactly what we are trying to do like resolve our past due account.

reviews.t: Bloated app but gets it done
reviews.x: How is it that the capital one app is at least twice as big as any other credit card app I have. It’s three times the size of some. It doesn’t do anything most of the other major banks apps do except update the app nearly every few days, not that I’m worried about the 450mb d/l every few days but the app just seems to have gotten slower and slower while getting bigger and bigger. Lean and effective would be a better combo. I’m not going to name the major competitors that have much smaller apps that are considerably faster on my iPhone X. My major complaint is that it’s taking too long to load. I can get in and out of other credit card apps before cap1 gets me logged in. My wife has a new iPhone 11 and it’s mildly faster on that but not significantly so why do they keep making it bigger and bigger? Can’t they unload some of the stuff in this app? It’s almost becoming a entire operating system. Other than the bloat the app works well. I haven’t had problems with it outside what I discussed above. It’s a good app. It’s just grown too bloated. And the constant updates that other banks don’t seem to need probably because their apps don’t try to do everything in one place needs to stop. If they made one for credit and one for banking it might at least run at a decent speed. I have other banks that have a separate card app and I don’t have any reason to need the two under the same app. Everything I can do in cap 1 I can do at most other banks I use with smaller apps. Just my two cents. Don’t get me wrong, cap one has worked well for me but the app size is growing and growing. I think unnecessarily so. I may be wrong. Just my opinion.

reviews.t: Please add the ability to change primary account
reviews.x: I’ve had capital one checking for a couple months now. Up until now, I haven’t had any issues. I added another checking account to my account and was notified that I would receive another card. Never received the card but found out through research that you only receive one card per person no matter how many accounts there are. That’s fine with me, I’d rather have one card to deal with, but the issue is, for one, that should have been stated in the first place instead having waiting a week before I could do anything. Another issue I have with this is transferring from one account to another. It would be a lot more convenient to be able to change from account to account without having to go online, sign in, push all the buttons to get to the option, change it, use the card, then go back and do it all over again. Please include the option to change primary accounts via app, it’s such a hassle having to go through the online process not to mention the amount of data usage.

reviews.t: App crashes all the time now!
reviews.x: I love CapitalOne to death, for many reasons. I also used to REALLY love this app until recently. In the past few months or so I have had this issue where I have to literally open the app 6-10 times before it actually opens. It crashes before getting to the login page. For something that’s supposed to be convenient it’s super unpredictable and it’s turning into a complete waste of my time to the point where I don’t want to use it anymore - absolutely frustrating. I’ve tried everything, from updating my phone, updating the app, deleting and reinstalling the app and nothing works. Please, please fix this. This is the card I like to use when I travel and I like to stay on top of my expenses at all times. UPDATE: It’s gotten even worse. Now the app won’t even open at all. Crashes EVERY TIME. What’s the point? Delete!

Capital one just took over Walmart credit cards. I downloaded the app and created an account to pay my bill. I entered my current bank information and made my payment. 3 days later I get an e-mail telling me my payment was denied because my bank account was closed and they charged me a $28 late fee!!! I logged into the app and somehow my current bank account was not there they had an old account from 4 years ago (when I had a Capital One credit card) instead. I called customer service and they were rude! Had to argue with them. “Why would I give them an old bank account from years ago to pay current bill?” Took arguing with them to get it straight. They removed the late fee after much arguing. I hadn’t had any accounts with Capital One in 4 years when I closed the credit card I had with them because I was tired of their rude customer service! Looks like they store information after accounts are closed! BEWARE! Soon as I get this current account paid off I’m closing my Walmart card since Capital One took over.

This is the best financial app out there. I had my wallet stolen and also card info heisted in Las Vegas. The fact that you can lock your card and only unlock it when you want to use it is invaluable. When my wallet was stolen I didn’t have it locked and Cap 1 said no problem. I had a new card within days and they re-imbursed me right away. When my info was heisted, I found out because capital one texts me right away whenever I have a charge or hold on my account. Otherwise I would never have known until I got my bill. Having that text message is valuable. There are a lot of scams out there that Cap 1 protects you against. No other financial company does that for me. Thank you Capital One. What’s in your wallet.

reviews.t: Pretty epic but sometimes hard to navigate
reviews.x: So yeah I was just chillin’ and decided to like move some money aside to save right? And there was like this really epic animation of some thing being squeezed from one bubble to the other and it was so satisfying that I ended up saving a whopping $4. Anyway, it’s a pretty gnarly site and the only gripe that your homeboy (that’s me) has is the fact that the app doesn’t show your past balance after previous transactions are done which can make my brain like totally get confused sometimes. I’m like, “yo, like, when $53 dollars were taken out of my account but then my rad mom gave me $25, like, how did my total balance swing the entire time?” You get me? Like, sometimes it’s just a little kooky but I’ve just stayed wavy with it and I go with the flow (as you know) so really it’s not that much of a problem anymore. So yeah, to conclude, pretty sick app that I recommend. Brotendo OUT! (Peace out Girl Scout)

I enjoy your app a lot. The only thing I would do different would be to interface ALL the accounts under my name. For example I had a Walmart account that I was making monthly payments on. You changed my due date and I did not have the option to pay off monthly other than calling in every month, because I could not see the account on the app or online. All of this without even a question or a notice to me if I may add. Also where is my FICO score? It is the score that drives my interest rate is it not? What is CapitalOne hiding? There are others that are catching up fast ... don’t forget Kodak thought they were unbeatable as well. If you need to ask more ... call away. But since nobody cares about these reviews ... have a nice day :).

reviews.t: Best Credit Card Company Out There!
reviews.x: I currently have 2 different Capital One credit cards and this company is by far the best credit card company out there! Their offers are extremely inviting, their APP and website is easy to navigate and provides all the information you need regarding your account (s). The App shows a summary overview of both accounts (if you have more than one account), allows you to easily click back and forth from each account and provides tracking information of your progress to a credit line increase (if this applies to your accounts) making it easy manage your current status at any time. I highly recommend Capital One to anyone that wants to apply for a credit card. Again, Capital One is one of the best credit card companies I’ve dealt with and I highly recommend them!

Capital One helped me rebuild my credit after I made the mistake of co-signing a vehicle for my boyfriend. He lost his job at one point and I was financially unstable due to being a full time college student to aid him in paying for his motorcycle that he purchased. The voluntary repossession, hurt me for years. I got denied for almost everything I tried to do. Years later, I decided to look into different companies to see which companies offered the best credit card to help me rebuild my credit. Again, I got denied one after another. I was very hopeless when I stumbled across Capital One. I then applied for the secured credit card and paid $99 because it was worth it to help me rebuild my credit and it sure helped! Within 6 months, with responsible use for emergencies only and paying on time. My credit limit went from 300 to 650. After a year, I decided to apply for a second credit card through Capital One, and my credit limit went from 1k to 5k in 6 months, again with responsible use and paying on time. Thank You, Capital One. For helping me rebuild my life, and credit after one mistake I decided to make. Thank you for taking a chance on me. Lesson learned.

reviews.t: App has worked great until NOW???!!!
reviews.x: This mobile app has been user friendly and amazingly operational and easy to use for even the least experienced tech user. NOW!!! This app is continuously asking for a 2 step authentication and recognizes my device like it is my first time logging in and it has been horrible and the easy access to all my accounts are now what you would call,”IMPOSSIBLE ACCESS!” And that’s an understatement. Capital One?! I appreciate your security because you as a company have already dropped the ball allowing millions of people’s information to be hacked and breached. Now, you need to to get your software developers to do their job and get online and mobile access to function without issues?! No problems for 2 years now and now these 2 weeks have been considered by me the worst app on my phone to deal with or open because it has been a complete failure and I dread even attempting to open it up because of the issues created after the last update. Please fix this! Customers depend on access to their accounts on a daily basis and as I’m sure I’m not the only one. Get this right because a 5 star app has turned into 1 star in a matter of days?! What a mess?!!!!!

I refused for years to have a credit card because of APR rates, annual fees, and the risk of miss use, but this card is secured, great for building credit, and no annual fee. Although there's a "higher" APR than some cards, the lack of annual fee makes up for that. Also the APR is almost the same as other cards, but what I like so much about this card is the interest doesn't start building up the day you buy things (like most other cards) it starts one month from the day you actually bought the item. So there's no interest on your item when your bill comes in (unless you wait till the second month to pay off the total amount of your purchase). The app is amazing alone. You connect it to your bank and you can make payments right there. All from your phone. I've looked into getting other cards, but the annual fee, interest starting from day one, lack of advance app, text alerts, and high APR has kept me staying loyal to capital one, and only capital one.

I’ve had the Capital One app for a while now and it was just to keep track of my 360 Money Market account. I did not use it heavily and would sometimes go months without even opening it because it was not really necessary for my needs at the time. Recently, I decided to add an external account to my money market account and of course tried to do this through the app. I had such a hard time trying to find where in the app I could add another account and got so frustrated that I just went on the Capital One website in Safari instead. On their, website it was so easy to find where I needed to go and was able to successfully add another account. I thought I missed something in the app but I went through the same process to get to the “Add External Accounts” page in the app as I did on the website just to discover that the option is nowhere on the app!! What’s the point of having the app if I have to go to Safari each time I want to actually do something?! Other than that, the app is fine, it just doesn’t make sense that I have to go on the Capital One website in Safari to complete a task when I already have the app.

So since having ios13 I’m no longer able to view my balance from my widget screen. I now have to use the app which is inconveniencing when out shopping or needing to quickly view my available balance. Also hate that most of the links you click in advanced features for your account tell you that you must open the web browser just to then tell you it doesn’t support mobile browsing. To top it all off capital one now doesn’t share data or connect your account with third party apps they aren’t partnered with which now has messed up my budgeting and saving apps I pay service for. Not to mention my account balance can sometimes fluctuate and gain or loose transactions causing the reported balance to be way off. Over all it needs a reboot or you should seriously consider another bank.

You’d think with mobile banking and a huge branch like Capital One that they would have fast, if not instant transactions from your account. I never know how much money I have because transactions from DAYS ago are still pending. There is an “available” and “current” balance, but they are never accurate. Whenever I need to talk to a human being and not a machine about issues, I am on hold for at least 20 minutes and am transferred multiple times, just to be told there’s nothing they can do to help me. You can’t walk into a Capital One branch to have them help you in person, because 360 is online banking so it’s separate from the branches, even though it’s the same company. I wanted the convenience of cashing a check on your phone and not having hidden fees, which they offer, but it’s not worth the hassle of trying to solve the constant issues that come into play. I’m debating between getting a regular checking account with Capital One or changing banks all together. I’ve been dealing with this for years and am still not at all satisfied.

I had the CO app for a while and loved it, used it nearly every day. My issue with this app is that I can no longer use it on my phone. I have an "old" iPhone 5 with iOS 10. Very recently CO decided to drop the app's compatibility with iOS 10 requiring at least 11.0 :/ What is more annoying, there is no app support. The button at the top of the review page says app support, sends you to CO generic support page to call them. There's a specialized number for every little thing, but nothing to do with the app. No way to say, please support iOS 10, except leaving a review...maybe one day I'll again be able to enjoy the ease of accessing my accounts through the app :(

reviews.t: Well, they’ve pulled their newest PR nightmare
reviews.x: Hey fellow Christians! I was a loyal customer of Capital One, until today. You see, today I received the credit card they so graciously sent. Only to realize it still contained the same error - a numerical sequence of “666” in my card number. Now, as soon as I noticed it I rolled my eyes and called them to advise of the poor taste.. but asked to have my feedback submitted to QC and a new card with a new number issued. Guess what I got in the mail today? Same card sequence, including the 666. This is an awful way to treat your loyal customer base who has otherwise religiously used your card, for starters. But to turn around and mock someone who wanted a new card issued due to a religious preference by not only disregarding their feedback but not even taking the time to step out and ensure the new card didn’t have the same numbers (yet, again, so “graciously” offering to comp an expedited delivery 👀) is absolute more quality control and customer service AT BEST.. and a full on mockery at worst. Shame on you, Capital One. Seriously.

This app couldn’t possibly be any better. It is the hub of all my financial activity. I have several different banks and bank accounts, each with a different purpose. Often, it becomes necessary to transfer money between accounts. I have done this many times, first transferring money to the Capital One account, then transferring that same amount to the account I have that needs the influx of cash. This leaves my Capital One balance always in tact. I don’t mind that it takes a few business days to complete the transfer; that is to be expected. Capital One has never let me down. Also, several months ago when I first set up this capability, I received what I considered to be exceptional assistance from the customer service department.

Love it it logs in fast. And shows both balances to all accounts in the first screen. It’s easy to transfer money between the two.
