ONLY thing I wish there was an option to see how much the next monthly minimum payment for your credit card would be if you paid early. For instance. If I pay my minimum payment for the month of August EARLY - I wish I could know what the minimum payment would be for the next month sooner than the end of the billing cycle. . Since I paid early. Or just some sort of pre-calculated estimate for the best amount to pay in order to help me get my credit back up or stay up etc. . . Kinda not really explaining myself well. But essentially I just wish there were more options to manage your credit/payments if you want to get ahead of yourself.

I think the app is great and give it 5 stars for a few reasons. The first being that it works just as it should without glitches or non responsive tabs/functions on the the app. That should be a given anyways, but I’ve had a few banking/money management mobile apps that have given me a lot of issues like that. Second, it that it’s easy to use and quickly allows me to navigate to the information I want to see fast. That’s what the app should be all about, not complicated and overdone, but simple and quick, but secure and helpful too. And third is even with the lasted breach of security, I still feel my info is safe on the app with capital one. Regardless if it’s true or not, I feel like it is, which at the end of the day, that’s all that matters anyways! I haven’t had any issues and I would recommend Thanks

reviews.t: Should be able to service all accounts
reviews.x: As a loyal Capital One customer since 2006, I am very disappointed that my Line of Credit account, that I’ve had since 2008, cannot be accessed from the app. From 2008 until just recently, at least I could still go online to mange my Line of Credit account, but as of June 2019, customers with Line of Credit accounts cannot manage their accounts unless they visit a branch location (number of locations have been decreasing and hours are inconvenient), or call customer service (which has an office that closes at 5pm EST, two full hours before I get off of work; typical customer waiting time on the phone has been 20 minutes). PLEASE update the app so that customers with the Line of Credit accounts can manage the account! Because this account is linked to my checking account (to which, as a loyal customer, I have directly deposited my paychecks since 2006), and because it accrues interest daily, it is VERY important to be able to manage it at my fingertips via the app!

I love Capital One, I do. Customer service is great, fee-less banking is amazing, and don’t get me started on savings’ interest rates, but their security features, while needed and highly appealing, are cumbersome and quite frustrating when you have to verify who you are 6 times in a day. For example, I recently moved to Mexico, and even though I’ve informed Capital One of this, I am having to two-factor verify my account each time I log into the app or my laptop. AND I have Face ID on my phone! I suppose maybe a cartel could cut off my head and try to access my account, but I haven’t had any run ins with any of them, AND I’m broke, so I’m 99.9% sure I’m okay. There’s nothing they can do. Maybe this review will help them to create something. I’m praying it does at least. Great bank and great security, but it’s a little (a lot) over the top. In this case, I mean.

I’m conflicted. On one hand, this is a great mobile banking app and the mobile deposits are easy and fast, but on the other hand, if you deposit money into a near-empty account they might lock you out without warning. I had to deposit $4,000 into an account that I don’t use often and they locked me out without permission for “safety.” The idea is that, if the deposit was flawed and the money wasn’t actually going to be moved, you don’t go thousands of dollars into the negative - but the problem is they NEVER ASKED ME, so I suddenly lost access to my bank account, my job is hounding me to buy the materials I need for the project, and I have to explain to them why Capital One suddenly froze my bank account. This made it impossible for me to start my job when I needed to and now I’m behind and look unprofessional, and, 72 hours later, they still haven’t done anything about it no matter how many times I call. This is outrageous.

I’m very happy with this app. It show me everything I want to know on a clear, easy to read screen. Charges show up right away, it’s shows what has gone through and what is pending. How much credit I have left. The rewards page is easy to see and super easy to redeem. Extra bonus is the credit check page which gives you tips on how to improve score. I decided I would like to try and get a higher credit limit. Did all that on the app and had a $3,000 increase within a few minutes.I recently found I could customize the screen as well. Like the thumb print option to log in as I feel safe if phone ends up in wrong hands.

I'm new to Capital One, was once a customer long before the internet. Anywho... This app is great for me, not sure how great the 5th generation was... But this current app gives me everything I need in a few steps. I like the touch id... I love wish all mobile banking apps would get with the feature. I can see pending transactions in the recent activity page and paying my bill is so easy and convenient. I did have any issue with uploading a photo but not a major deal. Overall, I am pleased with the app. The biggest plus is the touch id... HATE typing in user id's and passwords. Thats why I rarely use my social media accounts. Thanks Capital One for keeping up with technology!!!!

Hello, my name is Eric Sparks and I am blind and visually impaired. When I launch the Capital One mobile app I am able to view my account balance outside of my account windows but once I launch the account voiceover for iOS will not tell me my available balance or current balance. So far I have not run into any other accessibility issues besides that but I need this fixed in another app update as soon as possible. Everything else in the app is running smoothly with voiceover besides me viewing my available and current balance. Like I said I am able to only view my available balance outside of my account windows but once I click into an account I am not able to view my current or account balance but I am able to do everything else accessibly.

I love this app with my iphone. I'm not very tech saavy and I can navigate this app with no problem. I also have an ipad 2 (2nd generation) and the app is not compatible with it because I can only update ipad to 9.3.5 version and it seems that the Capital One App is only compatable with the latest version which I think is 12.2. Is there another way to use the app or is there a Capital One app compatable with my ipad 9.3.5 I've been with Capital One for over 30 years. To me they have always had the best customer service hands down. In that 30 or more years I've been scammed a few times with online orders and Capital One credited the amount to my account and they fought my battle to get money refunded. The people are very nice and very down to earth. I love them all.

I have been a devoted Capital One cardholder for about 11 years now. C1 was ahead of everybody when mobile started going mainstream. First bank with a beautiful app. First bank to support Apple Pay. Regular updates with great new features. For the last 2 years now, I’ve seen updates on a regular cadence (about twice a month or so). It’s great that you guys are keeping your app updated. However, you have now stagnated. I don’t see any new features being added to this app. The functionality is very basic. The only major features are being able to view my balances and transactions & redeem rewards. All the other banks are passing you by. I’ve now switched my main credit card to the Chase Sapphire Reserve with the sole reason that I hate using this app now, because it never gets any *real* updates. In fact, you have even taken features away. In the old Wallet app, you used to be able to view transactions per user on your credit card. This feature never came to this app and it’s an important one. I’m not sure what’s happening over there, but you really need to get your act together or you will end up losing more devoted users like myself.

Out of all of the credit companies I’ve tried Capital One has been the most rewarding and strait forward. I’ve been a member of Capital One since 2018. I’ve seen this app progress as the company has. It’s very intuitive and everything is very easy to get to including interest rates etc. for my individual cards something That other companies hide so well, that I’ve had to call directly. I love how quick the customer service response is and how willing their representatives are to work with customers like myself. They’ve helped me threw many trials and I’m very grateful. In all I love this app as much as the company that produced it and there aren’t too many other places I can find the same service. Thank you Capital One.

I was convinced by a fellow card holder to make Capital One my very first credit card contract agreement. I entertained the idea of securing a credit card for quite some time now, after my companion showed me her card information and App, we decided Capital One would be a great choice for me. So. Since starting the process I have had one error or complications after another. Most EMBARRASSING of all is when I went to use my card for the first time and it was declined. Now my app is not keeping current on transactions or sending me notifications. I called customer service last night and was put on the phone with a gal who did nothing except tell me to wait it out. That I’m not the only person receiving poor service. It would have been nice to receive an idea of how to resolve my issue instead of being told to wait, there was nothing she could do. Meanwhile the entire time my troubles have been developing my friend in the same house is having no issues at all.

I’ve not had a traditional credit card in 15-18 years. I realized I was not building my credit as much as I could just by not owing anyone but my mortgage company, who has never had a delayed payment. This was news to me, and an education. That all said, I researched cards that were custom to my interests and my already good credit standing. Finally, using Nerd Wallet, I compared cards. I decided on the Venture card from Capital One. This is what led me to using the app. The app is amazing! Making payments, seeing payment activity, card activity, and an anytime look at my credit score, with the included Credit Wise on the app make being credit smart so easy! You can see what may happen if you increase a limit, pay off a certain amount, and how it directly would effect your credit. NONE of which takes a “ding” in your credit. We all know the more your credit is checked, the lower your s ore goes. Being enrolled in Credit Wise with my card leaves me never guessing, an immediate look at my credit, and never will reflect poorly on my credit. Again, the payment, the interest rate, and card activity are plenty to satisfy me, but Credit Wise puts this app well over the top for my interests!

reviews.t: DO NOT DOWNLOAD BEFORE RECEIVING YOUR CARD IN THE MAIL
reviews.x: At first it was a cool app, showed me that my card had shipped and had a button to activate the card when it arrived. Received the card in the mail along with the information on how activate it. “Activation is fast and easy with our award winning mobile app!” I hit the activate card button on the app only to be told my account is restricted. I called customer service who told me that this is a common occurrence and “the system will just do that from time to time, no worries though” and went through a 15minute phone call to answer all these questions to just activate my credit card. Just wait until you get the card and then download this app as per the instructions on the card. Pretty pathetic that a well known company cant get a better system for their app to communicate accurate information to avoid these frivolous phone calls to customer service.

Recently, I opened a credit line with Capital One. I have a couple other credit lines (cards-MasterCard & VISA), But Capital One thus far is the best. I appreciate the “no fee” when opening the account. It was quick & easy to apply, also. Now to the App! I use a few other “credit card apps/sites”, but Capital One’s app is the BEST! It’s layout is attractive & conducive. It’s very easy to use because it makes sense! I especially like & appreciate how when a credit purchase is made somewhere, the app shows its location on a map. It has all the necessary info one needs when checking on a balance or a specific transaction. I am very impressed with Capital One, both the APP and the business itself! T Y Capital 1! Keep up the great work!

I love 💗 my Capital One App, it lets me know when my next payment is coming up which is a great thing for some people, because they forget, not on purpose just because their lives are so hectic. Keeps track of all the places you have used your card and the best thing about Capital One is NO ONE CAN GET YOUR INFORMATION!!! They have a CreditWise linked to their app which keeps everything SAFE.... from hackers and the dark web!! Guys if you have no credit, low credit, bad credit or just want to improve your credit this is the app you need. Yes it’s a credit card, but if you already have one try CreditWise, I’m not sure it’ll work with all cards, but it’s worth a try! They keep track of your credit score, if it goes up or down!! Come on give them a try, there great 👍🏼!! Thanks Credit One & CreditWise for everything and giving me a chance to prove myself an get myself together... Thank you 🙏 so very much!!!

Anyone that has rated this card 1-3 stars are fools and need to learn more about how your credit score works. this is a great card! text alerts when a purchase is made, weekly free fico credit score, 1.5% unlimited cash back, which is pretty much the best you can get without an annual fee. also credit line increases only get approved with card use AND your DEBT TO INCOME ratio has to be reasonable. you can’t expect increases when i card can see you would struggle to make the payments to pay it off. and you only pay APR if you have a monthly balance! keep your balance low enough so you can pay it off weekly/monthly! simple tips that have helped me in my journey of credit and i’m only 26, and grew up in the middle class. so you all can do it!

With in the last couple updates this app has gotten buggy. When I log in it used to show me both my checking and savings account balance on the home screen and I could choose which account I wanted . Now it just shows me savings account. I have to go into my savings account then back out for my checking account to be visible? That’s a pain. Secondly, ever since I switched my wife and me to capital one we use zelle to reimburse each other for family expenses. It’s been perfect until now. I tried to send my wife money and it asked me to verify my phone number so they could send me a passcode. It then said my phone number wasn’t registered with this account so I checked my capital one profile and it’s the same number. Looks like it’s Venmo for me. Come on capital one - I switched from a regional bank to you because your app and the simplicity of banking with you was unparalleled. Now it’s not.

I love it!!!!! When I log into the app (which is Touch ID friendly :)))), it brings up both of my Capital One accounts. That first screen even shows both balances without having to search into each account individually. I give it 5 stars!!!!! This app allows easy back and forth navigation between my two accounts without ever having to retype my account information when I switch over. My Bank of America app in the past was easy too, but then they changed it...making it not so easy to navigate. This Capital One app is the “Best” app for me so far. Currently, I don’t see any need for any improvement, but if they (Capital One) does in the future ...I trust it will be even better. My compliments to the designer of this app!!!

I love this app! I’ve used several credit card apps and Capital One is by far the most user friendly! One of the best features is that you can redeem you rewards no matter how small as soon as the purchase is posted, and there is no minimum required to redeem (Amex only lets you redeem once you’ve reached $25 for example). I also like that I can make payments any time. Some apps don’t let you pay until your statement is ready. I like to pay my balance asap and Capital One is great for that. This app works the most closely to real time with regard to transactions posting and reward redemption. Well done! I would and have recommended Capital One cards to friends and family because the app is so great!

Well where should I start? God forbid you need to speak to a human, you must identify yourself to everyone who picks up the phone maybe for five times. So you waste a bunch of time to start off with. Then when you do reach the person you need to speak with they almost never have to info ( they will refer you to a brace ) the branch is who referred me to customer care. That I'm it's self makes no sense because no takes care of the reason for the call in the first place. Ok then company changes are done with out any one being informed and that messes up my business because when you try to count on YOUR BANK you can't and shouldn't. Mobile deposit well the concepts in theory are wonderful but in actuality here sometimes no problem , but when there is then what? The branch says call customer care!!!! Customer care says will look into it get back to you and refers you back to the branch!!!! So unfortunately this day and age I have multiple business accounts with multiple financial institutions to cover me my company and my employees and my vendors!!!! Well we will see if this post makes it up and for how long it stays up. I'm gladly waiting to see !

I’ve been with Capitol One since they were ING and I have had NOTHING but good experiences over the years. I use their online banking for my checkings, savings. I also utilize their investing account, credit cards and CDs. I love the fact that I cannot readily access my savings, because I shredded my debit card years ago but using the app I can readily transfer money as needed to and from my credit union when needed. It works well for me and I have been able to save so much more because I don’t have immediate access to my savings for impulse purchases. The app works well because when I do need to transfer money from my CapOne accounts to my credit union it is a very simple process. I have never had an issues with money transfers using this app. I also used the app to open my first CD and it took me less than 5 minutes to set everything up. I also like the creditwise feature on the app, as well. I will always be a loyal CapOne member.

I don’t do a lot reviews, for if I cant say something (not good) but GREAT, then I’ll say nothing at all. Capital One 360 Checking/Savings is by far THE BEST banking solution - HANDS DOWN. The people whom work at the “cafe’s” are very down to earth, knowledgeable, warm and genuine (not in a “pretend” sort of way). Yes, it is a bit... ok, fine, it IS truly unconventional but I 110% recommend Capital One as your new banking endeavor and believe you will truly be missing out if you don't at least give it a try. Whereas most banks are charging you for this that and the other to the point of you spiraling down the overdraft abyss, Capital One is paying you. After all, isn't that would you should expect when loaning (depositing into) banks money in which in turn they make investments? I mean they’re being paid for such, why shouldn't you? The only negative thing that I’ve experienced is that the actual Capital One ATM’s have been problematic: meaning either non-functioning or become non-functional during ones transaction. I would have given a “4” for this in this review but felt that everything else makes up for it (in my opinion for my standards). Hope this helps...

reviews.t: Amazing app; interface update not good
reviews.x: TL;DR: App is amazing, a recent update however slightly changed the interface for the worse. Capitol one please fix the navigation bar at the bottom so it doesn’t eat into the profile menu options. - LONG REVIEW - I have accounts with multiple banks, so I use a lot of banking apps. Capitol one is my favorite, the interface is very clean and simple. However, an update recently introduced a “Home” and “Profile” navigation bar at the bottom of the app. Previously, you would access the profile section by clicking your profile picture or tapping a small icon at the top - this was intuitive. Now the bar obstructs a large portion of the interface. This is true for a lot of apps, but to do so with only two options is a little unnecessary. The biggest gripe I have with the bar is that, at least on my XS max display, it cuts into the text for the listed options on the menu. What is so infuriating about this is it only cuts into the text just a little bit, now requiring you to scroll for a list shorter than the displays height. This might be hard to describe in a review without pictures, but this chunky navigation bar, which was recently introduced, ruined an already perfect interface. Perhaps if they condense the text options in the ‘profile’ section just a hair, then it would be acceptable. I was so devastated by this update to literally my favorite app, that it prompted me to write my first app review in a very long time. I know being a fan of a banking app is such a ridiculous ‘quirk’ (if that’s what you want to call it), but it is really one of the best apps, in the sense that it perfectly executed its functionality in a very intuitive way. I’ve never had a problem with this app, and the ‘zelle’ feature makes it easy to transfer money between different accounts AT different banks. In half a second

reviews.t: Ok at best, no security, card info will be stolen a few times a year
reviews.x: I have been with capitol one about 14 months and am on my third card. There is no security at all with this company, and your card will be stolen about 3 times a year. I get fraudulent charges about 4 months it seems. When I first revived my first card, it already had charges. I called the company and they said “yes, it looks like the card has not even been activated and you have charges” I told them I haven’t even received it in the mail and they sent me another one. Since then it seems like it’ll keep happening. I’m not impressed and will be leaving ASAP. BUT to end on a positive note, it’s a great card if you have no credit and almost anyone can qualify for it.

I made a payment towards my bill through the mobile app. The payment was returned for erroneous matters on CAPITAL ONE’S end and i wasn’t even notified about the returned payment. I received an email the next month saying that my trans union scored has dropped and it was due to the returned payment. I contacted customer service twice asking to speak to a manager/supervisor. They both denied having knowledge about any system errors and stood by their word that i must’ve made the error because they “have nothing to do with the app”.....? I did a little internet research just to find out that on the same exact day (Jan. 4th) that my payment was returned, there were country wide capital one payment issues. Various major news outlets had their own write up of the situation. One customer service manager told me “the internet isn’t reliable,” even though cap one admitted to the problems publicly. LOL they are a joke. I got this card to build my credit but it’s doing the opposite without any resolution. STAY AWAY.

If using the app for paying your credit card bill be wary. I switched to a new checking account for my payment method for my cc a few months after I started using the app. It allowed me to put the new account in as a payment method, but I wasn’t able to remove my old checking account. This wasn’t too much of an issue, as it was automatically defaulting to my new account every month after I entered it. However, several months later, it started defaulting back to my old account. Since the process had been virtually automatic up until then, I didn’t catch it. This resulted in a returned payment since my old account was now closed. As a result, my credit has now been affected due (in part) to the design of this app. I contacted Capital One to try to have the returned payment record taken off. They removed the old payment account for me but would not remove the returned payment record (despite a perfect payment history for almost 2 years up until that point).

What I like about the Capital One app is that it helps me and makes it all simple and easy. It very user-friendly. If I want to check my balance or even to make a payment all I need is the Capital One app to take care of most all my needs for my MasterCard. Boom! It makes having a Capital One credit card so easy. There’s no excuse for a late payment. Thank you for your efficient app!! I found it necessary to do what I rarely do and that is giving Capital One app a 5 star rating. The highest rating because I have found it to be simple to use as it’s very user friendly. It provides me with everything I need and want from the efficient app. I also thank them for having CreditWise available because I have been victimized by having more than twice as many hard inquiries that I know isn’t from me. I knew to stop after two hard inquiries being declined credit. I have about a dozen inquiries I found unfamiliar and I knew to stop at two as I did not need anymore credit and had stopped applying for two reasons. The first reason is I had sufficient credit already and have not applied for more. Secondly, after two times being declined credit I knew the very harm to a score I finally reached good in my scores and would not have any reason to take any chances because of it lowering my score I was happy as that was my goal and knew it would go up after a year to an even higher score which was my goal and didn’t want or need to apply causing what I accepted as only creating a possibly causing to lose my score ever. I thank you all for the excellent app I rely on at least once a month and now even weekly! Capital One is the best!! I recommend them to anyone who is interested in applying for credit! Thank you 😊🌎

Love ❤️ the App Capital One!!! Thank you!!! It puts all of my Capital One card spending in perspective!!! It allows me to view each transaction even if it’s pending and I get notifications when a transaction on my card takes place!!!💕If I have an issue with a specific transaction I can dispute that right from the App!!! I feel the app would be a five ⭐️ plus if there were summary tabs for your totals after your account balance for your previous balance, for approved transactions, pending transactions and pending payments which would allow you to select any of the tabs to then pull the history for the breakdown that you already provide, for each new monthly billing cycle and a tab to view the history of the card activity to a date specified... this would allow us, card holders, to view are totals at a glance and could be a tool to help us view are spending habits and trends to help us better manage our spending over time! Also, if you’re disputing a transaction, I feel you should be able to view the transaction details before you have to request to cancel and mail a new card. I still ❤️ the app!!!

I am absolutely appalled 😮 at how Affective fast decision and constructive this bank has been thus far; with all sincerity Opening my 360 checking account was the greatest financial decision I ever made; I always love to be objectively unbiased in my reviews so I will say that in comparison to the other mobile apps I have tried Wells Fargo is much more user-friendly and accurate and I do not just say that because I am used to it I say that because I have tried all of them from Chase bank of America to Wells Fargo to TD now this (Capital One) And without question capital one is ranked number two in terms of mobile app support however in terms of live customer service; it may be easier to contact Wells Fargo 24 seven because of the malleability & fungible Mobile app; at the end of the day I can take solace knowing that there are live representatives who operate with absolute a hundred percent professionalism. I am very pleased thus far as my 360 checking account has gone. I would appreciate the mobile app being a little bit more scalable in terms of its functionality however I am not one to complain just pointing out the obvious.

I’ve had some issues with this mobile app. I removed an old bank account over six months ago, my account has been at zero balance since December and all of a sudden I get a $3.87 charge. I pay the charge for whatever reason and then notice that it was returned back. When I called they said that it was returned because it wasn’t available with my old bank. I explain to them that I did not have my old banking information on the app, the customer service rep said that was accurate and she didn’t understand what was going on and transferred me to an account manager who was also unable to explain what happened. They did waive the fee and gave me an address to write a letter to the company to request that they investigate it. You would think that with technology they have a better way to report these types of issues instead of me writing a letter. All I can think is that they are trying to discourage people from reporting their issues.

I’ve had Wellsfargo for years... and always had issues weather it was fraud or unnecessary overdraft fees, down to suspicious charges, every year with them I always had at least one problem within the year. Heard about Capital 1 360, opened one up just to see and ask questions. Although it would be nice to go into a branch every now and then... I LOVE IT! The atms to make deposits are in my favorite store TARGET! So it’s absolutely awesome and convenient. Customer service is awesome as well. I got my card taken by an atm at the mall, called and was able to set up a Zelle account to send my other account the money meanwhile I waited for my new card to come in the mail. The representative stayed on the phone with me the WHOLE PROCESS, no long holds. I cannot complain about this banking method at all.

reviews.t: It’s ok but it could be better
reviews.x: Wish they would let you do a same day payment or give you a 24hr grace period, I paid my minimum payment the day it was due only to find out that the payment could only be set for the following day and the money I paid just got deducted back for being late. I don’t see why you can’t set up a payment on the same you’re making it. Sometimes the updates can be a pain too, make sure u keep it updated otherwise next thing you know payments due but you haven’t opened the app for a couple weeks and now it’s telling you this version is not supported and you must update the app and uh oh your wifi is weak and now the app won’t update times up you’re late darn here comes the late fee again. Ps I think the balance should update faster as well and can I choose my payment due date? I haven’t figured that out yet but it sure would be better for me if I could. Other than that seems to work good.

CapOne is the best; had them 3 years now and haven’t had an issue or problems EVER! When i had a questionable charge it was easy to call and place a dispute! I also bank with Discover Checking and Bank of America all of them are great but CapOne is my go to checking, the app is great and intuitive, also all my account is in one place! Can see my credit card, checking and savings. I also can easily move money from my CapOne checking to Bank of America real time using Zelle this is an added BONUS doesn’t get any easier than that! Also when i was younger i had poor money management skills as i’m sure many have had several chex systems reporting, those records were still on my chexsystem report when capone opened my account, maybe i was lucky but i still got the account so all in all they have one happy customer forever!

For everyday stuff, the app does what it needs to do. For transfers (both paying people and transferring money to external accounts), lord help us all. Cap 1 has been painfully behind Chase’s curve for nearly a decade now when trying to send money to people. Not only is transferring through Zelle a giant pain (Chase uses them too and it works fine, so why such a bad experience with Cap1?!), trying to know what automatic transfers have been set up is an act of futility. In the past, I could go to the website and see all of the transfers I have set up. The app shows them, but I can’t edit or cancel a series of transfers. Now, their website is just stupid with transfers and doesn’t even show them all even though the app shows them. I can’t cancel an upcoming transfer because it has gotten so far off target for when I actually need the money to appear in another account. So now I have to check back on the website (and risk forgetting) just to cancel a recurring transfer. I’ve had a transfer not show up anywhere, so I scheduled another one only to find out that caused two transfers. I tried to cancel one, they both disappeared. Set up another transfer only for there to be two transfers again. Get your *ish together Cap 1! Stop trying to redesign your website into the stupid boxes and make it functional!

My experience with Capital One has been, hands down, the best banking experience we have ever had. We started with moving one of our business accounts here and 1 personal 360 checking account. We quickly fell in love with literally every single thing about this bank. We are now moving all of our accounts here, including my fiancé’s personal accounts as well as our 4 other businesses. So thankful to have found Capital One at a time it seems they are just starting to hit their stride and make major waves in the world of banking. I never thought I’d say this about a bank, but Capital One has it all figured out, they know how to handle your money, how to profit and sustain without cheating their customers with unnecessary fees and such, and they know how to create a customer friendly environment. I love it, would recommend to anyone!

Capital one app is a convenient way of tracking expenses and making on the spot payments. In our business it was a great card, with multiple users we made payments daily if not twice daily. Apps are made for convenience. However, with the C1 App there is no way to remove draft accounts. Some what Defeats the purpose of having a mobile App. We had someone break into our office and forge checks . Our bank(s) closed our accounts-as we have 3 dba’s. Just as our daily capital one payments were being drafted our accounts were closed. using the Capital one App, we added our new accounts- the only difference in draft account numbers were first 3 digits. The capital one App only shows the last 4 digits. So if you are traveling as we do in our industry, living by our smart phones, you are stuck guessing what account is the correct account to be drafted. Capital one closed our account and refused to reopen it. After 2 years of multiple weekly payments and 10 of thousands spent on the card monthly , our Capital one app failed us by not showing which bank account was which. Make sure if you change bank accounts you are near a desktop to immediately change draft information because the mobile app will not allow you to delete accounts. We changed over 30 payable accounts due to this forgery nightmare. Capital one is the only card that failed us and closed our account- App is incomplete and still needs work.

My purse was stolen. All of my credit cards included. Besides the hassle of getting all of them turned off and replaced, I was taking a trip to Florida and wanted to use my Capital One card to pay for my rental for 9 days. Low and behold I didn’t realize until Saturday that my Capital One card was the only one that I did not request to be replaced and I was leaving the following Wednesday. It was already the weekend and I knew it would not get to me in time in the mail. I expressed my concern to one of the reps and he stated that “he would not want my trip to Florida be ruined because I didn’t have my card”. So he sent the card Fed-Ex. I had it by Monday. Such a relief words can’t even express how with such ease he took care of my situation because without the rental there would have been no trip. KUDOS Capital One!!!

We had identity theft and decided to find a new bank. Very skeptical about the small number of brick and mortar and none in less than 8 hour drive from us but the customer service that we received from the very beginning won us over. Not once did anyone make us feel that our tiny paychecks were not worth their time. Capital One 360 has made us feel like we are catered to like millionaires and ALWAYS easy, fast, affordable banking with AMAZING customer service. I can’t remember the last time I have been impressed by a bank let alone the app, customer service, and quality of products and services offered in one place. We even got our car financed with them and again online using auto navigator. Now a savings account that is super easy to take from checking and put into savings. It’s so easy and the app is the most user friendly app that I’ve ever used. I’m so happy with the company and the app. I definitely recommend. I also recommend visiting one of their “cafes” we loved it and can’t wait for more to open closer to us!!!! Thank you so much Capital One for making our banking needs stress free!!

reviews.t: Capital One Finally Got it Right.
reviews.x: Updated Review for version 5.4. Well after several major updates, I can finally say that Capital One got the mobile banking right. The app has almost everything you need for mobile banking. They also have a full iPad App. This all was a long time coming, but it is here. Updated Review for version 2.0.4: No matter how pretty you make this App look, it's still pretty ugly. This App still doesn't work right for paying bills; at best it accepts about a quarter of the payments entered. This have been a problem since day one and you still haven't been able to fix it (please try to get the basics right). I consistently get a cryptic error messages that say the information is incomplete when all fields are filled out. When you call Tech Support for an answer they have no idea why this is happening and all they tell you to use the regular banking web site (great customer service there). The only thing this app is good for is looking up your balances, otherwise it's toilet paper. As mobile banking becomes more important to me, I'm considering changing banks to a company that has a mobile banking platform that works. What you need to do? 1. Bill payment that actually works! It's a basic feature! 2. Check scanning / deposit functionality (but if they can't get bill paying right, how can they get the deposits right) 2. An iPad version of the App, like all the other major banks.

I would like to thank Capital One on behalf of all Broke College Students University, This bank has no annual fees for a checking account (so far that I know of) I just opened it like hours ago so haven’t had the chance to research but I felt so happily appalled that I must share this.... I cried real tears (insert Michael Jordan crying meme) Every experience was amazing from when I first walked in (small things I don’t forget) the lady saw me and ushered me in to her neat desk. It was amazing getting to sign up on a tablet for checking & mobile banking) ....Ik its a just a tablet but the feeling of privacy and processing your own information was epic ! Secondly i felt so comfortable I’ve never been in a banking office where I feel at home I even sat back in the chair sunk low & ate her dums dums, one was lemon which I didn’t wanna try but ended up being great!!! Then I ate a mystery which I think was like pineapple idk haha During this time the Banking Associate was counting my crazy change and depositing my part-time job check (still very broke btw) but signing up was quick and easy & no annual, monthly or weekly fees okuuuuurrrr !!! No Fees (checking so far) All in all I loved the 25 minute experience The candy n comfy seating No wait time Privacy The atmosphere Left happy Hopefully y’all keep up the good work. I’ll update the review if anything changes !

I do not do a whole lot of online banking as I have set up my bill payments to occur when the bill is do. I think I have added one payment partner using the mobile app and it was easy enough. Though I prefer using my laptop with its attached monitors just because of the real estate. So far the app has done everything I have wanted to do and it is majorly convenient especially when you need to transfer $ and you are nowhere’s near a computer. Using the deposit feature is easy as well and once to get the navigation down is pretty quick. Could things be easier or better. Always. Thus the upgrades we get. I like the app very much. And now with the Touch ID I like it even better What I don’t like and this is more to do with my mobile device is it is small Filling out this review using a tiny keyboard is not my best experience. But the app function great

reviews.t: Capital One Will Leave You In A Serious Financial Bind
reviews.x: I just moved to the dc/Maryland area from NYC. I previously banked with Chase & Citi for years. While I’m not particularly a fan of Citi bank, Chase is the star in NYC. However, there weren’t any Chase banks in this area & Citi hardly exists in the DMV. So, to make banking easier, I switched to capital one because they’re everywhere and my bestie has a credit card through them. It’s been almost 3 months, this bank is BY FAR the worst & most lazy bank I’ve ever encountered. They insist on holding my checks for over 5-8 days making it impossible to live my life and pay bills on time. It’s ruining my credit & credibility. I just literally moved into my new place & my credibility with my landlord & with PayPal is SHOT TO HELL. My landlord requires us to utilize pay pal to pay our rent. The first excuse for them holding my money was because I’m a new client and it takes 4 days to deposit. That sounds ridiculous to me, Chase never did that. So, the 2nd month I had everything deposited a week before the 1st of the month so there would be no issues & they held my check for over 8 days. I had to call them myself! & discovered my boss’ signature wasn’t visible, SO WHY THE HELL HOLD MY MONEY!??? WHY NOT CONTACT MY BOSS’ BANK OR THE COMPANY DIRECTLY!? So STUPID ! Chase would have done that immediately without being asked! MISSED MY RENT PAYMENT FOR THE SECOND MONTH ON TIME BECAUSE OF THIS RIDICULOUSNESS! NEVER HAPPENING AGAIN! I’m using my navy federal account & THANK GOD CHASE IS COMING TO DC THIS FALL!!!! Will only be using this stupid bank account for my little cash from my second job as a server. My business accounts, nest egg, & all the real stuff will go directly between CHASE AND NAVY FEDERAL!

I’m not a big reviewer & making my auto loan payments to Capital One has been challenging at times. Nevertheless, this app is worthy of a kudos as it is designed to provide the information a user (at least this user) seeks in an app of this kind. It opens with the big picture: what is owed overall and a touch later provides the next most important information: the payment that is due and when. In under 30” I can make that payment, check my history and/or request an extension or payment plan to get current. The app is designed consistent with Capital One’s effort to appear more collaborative with its clients and leaves me with the sense that it is on my side, without judgment; dare I say, my friend rather than my enemy!

I really like the app. I have an iPhone X and now I use my face as the password. The one thing that I don’t like is how easily you can get locked out of your account for incorrect passwords. I feel that there should be another way to identify you. I understand it’s to protect me, the consumer, but it’s frustrating when you only have a few tries. So I never sign in on my laptop only my iPhone. And when I switch phones I’m probably going to cry if it doesn’t have facial recognition because I’ll be locked out. Overall the app is really easy to use and it’s really easy to active your card. Payments are also really easy on this app. Set them up for reoccurring or pay the same day. I also like how fast I get an email when I make a purchase, it shows up immediately.

Despite being reliable for years, Capital One is now FORCING users to upgrade, without identifying what’s changed or what they’re forcing users to accept. The newest FORCED update was over a change in their TOC details, something which isn’t even casually mentioned on their website. The only thing I suspect, is that after years of being upfront and transparent with users, they’re now planning to force multiple pop-up ads and collect data on their users to sell to unnamed advertisers. If this was in relation to new banking laws, their main website would have mentioned it or they’d have sent out letters warning users, instead they’re trying to force it on users in too much of a hurry to deposit needed funds to read 12 pages of largely impenetrable legalese. I’ll withhold my final judgment, but the underhanded way they’re foisting this on users doesn’t speak well for their ultimate intentions! I suspect it’s finally time to look for yet another bank.

We’ve had a Capital One World Elite card for years- it’s the best! We cancelled our AMEX because it doesn’t have the same perks and the annual fee for 2 cards was $350!! This card has no annual fee, I earn points on Everything no matter what the category, and it’s simple to redeem through the app. On the few occasions I have had to call, the representatives have been quick to answer, are friendly, and go out of their way to be helpful. I tell everyone they should get the card. I do have a Chase Visa for those few & far between occasions when a merchant only accepts the Visa card (mostly out of the country). It is much more difficult to redeem points and I have to accept the categories to receive higher points every quarter.

Been a member since ING...still same excellent customer care, no hidden fees, personal attention (not a computer) when you call, I’ve never had to leave a message up the chain of command if I’ve called for something ( have done this at other banks), Cap One understands human beings have needs and situations and takes fantastic care of us! Did I mention that we don’t get slapped with fees constantly like at other banks? Recently received a beautiful personal note from an employee at Cap One Auto Finance, sympathy note for my old car I didn’t want to let go of. Sweet touch, meant a lot! Wanted a personal loan to replace my engine, wasn’t possible through Cap One which is a drag... but I found a loan through a credit union (is much less expensive than buying another car)and my old car is like new again, Cap One did preApprove me for an auto loan, didn’t want that. Grateful for the wonderful options Cap One does offer... maybe someday personal loans too?

I love how convenient this app is for making payments, viewing balance and checking on my account. The only reason I am not giving it 5 stars is because I use the Capital One app with two different credit cards and it consistently only emails confirmations for one of the accounts. On top of that, I had auto pay turned on for both accounts, then out of no where I get hit with a late fee on one of my accounts. All my bills are auto pay, I utilize that feature for a reason, yet for some reason... To avoid late fees and to have one less thing to worry about. Sometimes I make a non scheduled payment if I have a little extra money, because I do not like having too much debt. Two times I was proactive and made an extra payment and both times it canceled my auto pay for the following month and I got hit with a $27 late fee each time. So be careful and after making your payments, sign out and then back in to make sure the auto pay didn’t get switched off.

I got a secured card from them this last month. Everything was good to go until I tried using their 'creditwise' feature. It absolutely would not work. So I called them to see what was going on, they told my that I had a duplicate application... How in the world does that happen?! This was on Wednesday that I called. They told me they would get it 'fixed'. I call back Friday (still had no access at this point to my account...) And then they said to give it a couple more days... I call back today, Sunday, and they say that they made 'notes' of my previous calls but no action has been taken... Are you FREAKING kidding me?! I've had NO ACCESS to my account for 5 days and that's all you can tell me?! They said to call back Monday since the department that takes care of my 'issue' is open again... So much for 24 hour service. Seriously this is ridiculous. If they don't get it fixed tomorrow then I'm closing my account and I'm done. Why offer a service that doesn't even work? 🤷🏼‍♂️

I usually do not have notifications turned on for most of my apps because I work in the operating room and they would be going off all the time. But I kept this one on because my three kids have their own card on my account and it helps to keep track of when they use it (which is suppose to be for emergencies unless they ask). This App helped me to know that my daughter was in jeopardy one night when I got a notification at 0234 in the morning that a charge on her account was at a bar that she wouldn’t have gone to. The card was taken by a man who assaulted her and we were able to track him down based on the notifications from this app that are in real time. It gives the location and the time of the transactions as they go through. And the awesome customer service people were so helpful in how they closed just that card and fed-ex’d a new one for her the next day! I thank you for making this app easy to use also. I pay my balances and check my activity and have never been so up to date with a credit card before using this app. Thank you, thank you!

Several years ago, I was unhappy that Capital One bought ING; little did I foresee the quality and convenience that Capital One planned for Capital One 360. They bring the highest quality and convenience together in the best package available today - save one irritation - they do not grantee on time electronic bill payments. CheckFree which serves many other banks and credit unions does. Still the conveniences packages offered by Capital One, Capital One 360 and Capital One Credit Cards are the best I know. The interest rates paid on savings and checking accounts are higher than any other in my knowledge; the rewards payed on credit cards are competitive exceeded only by a couple of others in specialized areas such as gasoline, travel and restaurants; and the range of electronic payments and transfers are tops.

Never trust this app. They can claim to update often all they want but it’s not true. They are currently in the process of closing ALL branch banks! That includes every ATM attached to those buildings. I travel ALL of the time and switched from Citi to even crappier Cap1 HUGE mistake. They make all these claims about convenience but I’ve had nothin but problems. All I want to do is make Instant transfers from my Cap1 checking account to pay towards my credit card while traveling. I should be able in todays world with all the technology out there to move money from one account to another at the touch of a button. Instantly. If I take out too much cash and do not spend it and decide to put back into a Cap1 ATM before getting onto a plane I shouldn’t have to go to 4 freaking locations only to find NONE of them have working locations AFTER having checked the app and the CapitolOne website Repeatedly to see it said those locations confirmed and stated they had working ATMs that took deposits! Are you kidding me? Why can’t this be updated at the minimum of midnight every night for accuracy? I officially hate Cap1 and want to take my business elsewhere. By the way multiple people and myself passed each other while attempting to frequency other ATMs and branch locations. At first we laughed then we cursed as we passed each other the fourth time. We all were fed up. I spent almost a habla tank of gas doing this today! Absurd.

I joined Capital One 360 a few years ago to set up a direct deposit to go in to from my part time job. From day one when I joined I was amazed how great Capital One 360 was with their banking App. Any issues on had with my money in checking, was handled immediately when I called their service representatives. The one thing that I really like, is that you can lock your debit card after you made a purchase and keep it locked until you are ready to use it again. I have set up weekly deposits using the App to help me start saving for a rainy day. You can do all your banking from Capital One 360 App without any worries at all. So I say if you don’t have an account with them yet, do yourself a favor and set one up, because you won’t be disappointed!!! Thanks Capital One 360 and keep up the great service.......

I feel like it’s complete crap you force people to update. I was unable to use your app for over year with my old phone because I did not have enough space to update. I had your app that wouldn’t work because every time I try to open it so I had update. Have a new phone now just barely got your app in here you’re already asking me to update. It’s great if you wanna make improvements but stop forcing people to have to update if we’re fine with the old version just leave us alone with the old version because all you’re doing is causing people that have no memory on the photo not be able to use your app at all. Update: yet another update stop making people have to update why don’t you let us choose if we want update I’m so sick of these updates every little bit give us the option. When my phone runs out of memory I’m just not gonna be able to use this app anymore because you can’t use it without the updates stop with the freaking updates!!!!

This may be my first credit card but so far it is the best credit card I think because there’s no interest-rate you can pay the lowest amount of $25 or you can pay the full amount without fees and it tells you when your bill needs to be paid it gives you notifications early to notify you when your bills needs to be paid they are very secure like one time I cancel a payment then I made a different payment on the right Date then it popped up a security alert where I couldn’t buy anything so if it was someone else my credit was secure and safe yes It can be inconvenient but I liked it because my credit was safe and for someone like me someone new to Credit cards it was probably best at least with Capital One you know your account is (((((((SECURE))))) and believe me when I first got my credit card I was worried about anybody just seeing the numbers on the credit card and I’m still a little leery but at least I know I’m protected

reviews.t: Finally an app that displays EXACTLY what I want
reviews.x: You know how sometimes out of pure necessity you have to use a certain app for something super important but it’s annoying to navigate through the all the little sub-menus in order to get right to the information that’s important? It’s like some apps add too much to the opening screen and they don’t just get to the point. Well this app is for you! I have 2 credit cards with Capital One and just 3 weeks ago took out an auto loan with them too. So I had anticipated the need to go online and register the account and use a full-size computer every time I want to check any details of the auto loan. Honest to God without me doing anything, I open the app a few days ago to check my credit card balances and the home screen prompted me if I wanted to add my auto loan I was amazed and eagerly clicked “OK”. Now I can see all 3 of my CapOne accounts on the very first page. This Capital One app should be a model for all other apps.

My husband brought home a kitten for our 1 year wedding anniversary. She was our first “baby.” She was also born in the same month we conceived our son. She was our little girl. But she became VERY ill. We took out a carecredit account to cover her hospitalization expenses and bills. Couldn’t afford to pay right away. Long 4 month story short, our little girl had kidney failure and passed away. It’s now June, and my last statement reflected a LARGE interest charge. They did not allocate payment where we asked for 4 months. They would not rectify anything. The account manager said no notation was ever made in their system to allocate payments between promo and non promo transactions, which was not true. We always called in payment allocations... Since their system had no notes, I was deemed a liar. I was in tears- these bills are a horrible reminder of loss. & they found a way to make money off my grief. I called cap one- just opened an account. The rep was super friendly and informative with my options between purchases and balance transfers & my best options to resolve. I wanted out of carecredit asap for misallocating payments. Cap one helped me find the best route to do so. She even took the time to listen to me cry and vent. This company knows how to treat their customers when so many companies these days treat the consumer like dirt. So now I have 12 months to pay this burden with no stress. Thank you capital one. Please don’t ever lose that quality of customer service.

reviews.t: I am beyond happy with them
reviews.x: I could never say anything bad about Capital One after what happened to me today. I called last week to see if they would agree to remove late payment report from my credit. They stated that they couldnt do so; which I know isnt true. But that is besides the point. While on the phone the representative Brandon asked me why I had gotten behing on my payments. I explained that my husband passed away in October and due to funeral cost all of my orher payments got behind. At which point I proceeded to cry my eyeballs out while on the phone. Brandon never rushed me to get off the phone. He gave me all the time I needed to collect myself. Long story short, fast forward to today I get a knock on ny door and it was FedEx. When I opened my door it was a box with flowers inside with a note from Brandon sending his condolences and hoping to bring a little joy to me during this time. This might be that Brandon as a human being felt my sorrow and wanted to make things just a little better. But to him and the compaby as a whole. THANK YOU!

I am a software engineer and have worked with thousands of websites. The functionality, flexibility and usability of this tool to allow you to access Capital One and your accounts is by far the best that I have worked with. It allows us to make all of our necessary financial transactions in one place, immediately and without the challenges that most websites offer. We utilize the mobile deposit functionality for checks I have found it to be almost perfect. Customer support when it has been needed has been excellent courteous and professional. We sing the praises of this corporation and its online capability to everyone that we can. In this day and age when everyone is in the Web business thank you for bringing and sharing while allowing us to use one of the BEST online products that far surpasses your competitors.

Since the early 2000s we have used Capital One, never really having a problem, with the exception of today...and it really isn’t a problem, just their stance. Earlier in the week I paid off 2 CCs in the amount $2300+ in CCs, paid off 2 others last year. After paying off my cards this week an interest rate was charged that occurred within the billing cycle, which added $22 to what was a zero balance. This same thing occurred with my Discover card, which I also paid off last week. Discover happily removed the interest rate, though it was a valid charge. Their decision was based on a courtesy to me, as a loyal customer. I understood that I was asking Capital One of a favor, to forgive the $22. They chose not to. And, I chose to permanently close all 4 of my accounts with them. For the sake of keeping a loyal customer, I think I would have chosen differently. In fact, as a small business owner I have forgiven small fees to retain a loyal client. Needless to say, I will continue to use Discover. Thanks for your services Capital One.

I have a few credit card apps and this one clearly stands out above the rest. It’s simple and easy to use. Payment and reward redemption features are very clear- other apps seem to require more effort for me to figure out where those functions are located. The credit wise credit score tracker is also useful and provides explanation as to how various types of activity affect the score. I also just discovered a credit wise feature which simulates the effect of an action on one’s score. The simplicity and clarity of this app may be because it is just for a credit card account, not a general banking app which includes bank and credit accounts. This last comment has nothing to do with the app but Capital One is also cool because there is not a minimum threshold of rewards points to redeem to credit my account. Other accounts I have require $25 minimum. I am more motivated to use this card over others because of the app.

I’m writing this review immediately after capital one got me some of my money back from a shady company. I was unwittingly signed up for a subscription service that I did not need or use after making a $2 purchase from them months ago. Today capital one notified me that my card was being charged as it does with every purchase DO NOT TURN OFF THIS FEATURE!! At first I didn’t see it’s value but it notified me immediately that my card was being charged. I did not expect this at all so I call Capital One through this app. After a few voice prints I was connected with Cici who got in touch with this fraudulent company as I was on the phone with her and fought for me to get my money back! No it wasn’t the worst fraud there is but money is money and I’m glad she took my complaint seriously and made it clear we were on the same team. This is my first experience with capital one and I am very pleased. I highly recommend this app and their company. If you have one of their cards YOU MUST GET THIS APP. I don’t know what you’re doing otherwise and why you wouldn’t have this app.

I really like this app. Love the Credit Wise feature!! It’s given me some awesome tips on growing my credit even more. The app also gives me FREE weekly credit score updates. That’s neat! I am really enjoying my new credit card with Capital One and this cool app. I have called customer service to help me activate my Apple Pay and literally I was connected to someone within 10 secs of my call. I was dreading a long wait... Surprisingly, no wait time, no automated menus, the agent was already aware of the reason to my call and offered me fast, courteous service right on the spot. I am very impressed. I have been a loyal member with AMEX since 2010, but I have got to say, you really surprised me. I’m glad I decided to give you guys a shot. I heard lots of great news on the Clark Howard radio show. I heard a caller discuss a restaurant charge an exorbitant amount for a tip and you guys caught it before he even left the restaurant! THAT is excellent service! I have had that happen before so I could IMMEDIATELY relate. And then it dawned on me... maybe if I would have had Capital One, I could have had a COMPLETELY different experience and never had to go through that nightmare to start with.... So, I am here. Thank you!

I was able to download app and apply with it using the offer letter sent by capitol one. I was able to easily set up my bank account as the payment source. The app also has a credit check (FICO) score feature. When I received the physical card in the mail it was easy to activate it. I then added it to my wallet in iOS and have it as a choice in Apple Pay. For me, with horrible credit via a divorce, I look forward to using this total environment to judiciously use the credit and to be able to manage paying off purchases ahead of time and with more than minimum payments or whole pay offs at a time. I’m hoping I’ll be able to recover my credit score quickly using the tools available.

reviews.t: I love the app + credit wise feature
reviews.x: I’ve been using the Capital one app for about a year and a half. It’s easy to use, easy to make payments, easy to redeem cash back rewards. It’s a great and easy app. I like it way better then my Bank of America app. I also love the credit wise feature. It has help me go from mid 700’s to over 800 in a little over a year. It helped me understand what would raise my score and how simple patience and keeping balances low would lower my score over time. I loved he simulators. I plan to buy a new car eventually and I want to be over 800 when I do it and I understand once I buy that car my score will go down a bit. I’ve turned down every offer to open a new credit card as I know it would lower my score for a while. I opened a few accounts at the same time I got the app and then I realized that was a mistake and I should not have done them all at once as I really didn’t need to I could have paid cash for one of the items so now I just have to wait for them to fall off as “new accounts” I think will happen in about 5 months and my score will go even higher! Thank you capital 1 app designers. Thank you credit wise people!

It’s always a pain to have to call and wait on the phone for an actual human being to pick up the line (and I’m not saying specifically with Capital One, because they are actually pretty on top of that, but just having to wait on hold and go through all the prompts etc. in general...), and then on top of that having to pay a western union fee to pay and/or just the phone convenience fee period. So using this app once it’s set up which is pretty simple makes managing my account much easier... I have my checking account linked to it and can pay any amount I choose with a few taps on my phone and it’s done... The app will even remind you when you’re bill is due amongst many other options and you can opt to have certain things texted to you or emailed as well overall I think it is a great app

Well, I would like to entertain the idea that someone or thing will take the time to read this. I would like to state for the record that “ I Bobby Jackson “ will continue to be a loyal consumer to the entity, We’ve had some ruff patches and yet we’re still together. My credit cards that I have with us have taken a turn for statement balances above the status quo. Yet, I’m willing to continue receiving emails pertaining to financing our/my new vehicle. I’m not ready to purchase . I know that you or us should see that I have broken away from the semi constant balances that I kept. I hope that more attention is paid to my accounts and that I’m able to quickly get back on track. The app on my smartphone has been very helpful. The only downside to the app is that it takes several days for my funds to transfer to and from my external accounts. While avoiding the hassle and delays, it causes me to inadvertently save money. Having a snap view of my credit on credit wise has also equipped me with the knowledge I need to continue my journey towards bettering my credit. We’ll see ow it plays out. Bobby Jackson Jr

reviews.t: I am looking to move my money if the web site doesn’t improve
reviews.x: What are you folks thinking? I can’t believe how many windows you have to open just to open a CD. Never mind that you can’t conduct any business at all in the app. Not a thing. You can open up the app and stare at how much money you have. That’s loads of fun. And then you open three different web pages AFTER leaving the app to open a CD. And at least on iPad you can’t type in an amount. You have to add in $20 increments. And you can’t hold the + sign down. No! That would be too easy. So here I am opening a CD for a thousand bucks... twenty dollars at a time. I’ll never invest a dollar amount higher than that until you change your web site- and I mean fire the ones who designed your site and go elsewhere and have them start at ground level. Additionally, you don’t need to know my job title and income level. I’m giving YOU money, not asking for a loan. Anyway I’m shopping around for other banks in case you don’t come to your senses.

As a person with an employment history in the banking/financial area, I am so impressed with Capital One! The first account I had with them was a credit card, then I did a car loan, and I was so happy to deal with them that I moved all of my accounts to them. (Checking and Savings) Even though they are a larger financial institution, they treat me as a person and not as a number! The service is great and the employees go out of their way to assist you. Even though I had most of my accounts in a smaller bank for years, the transition from them to Capital One was easy and smooth. When my hometown bank tank denied me for a loan even with good credit, Capital One not only approved me, they gave me an interest rate that was unheard of! When I decided to leave the other bank, they couldn’t care less; I have no idea why I was treated that way since I was a good customer and went there bc everyone I used to work with was at the small bank. No worries bc God sent me to Capital One and now I am blessed beyond words! What’s in your wallet and is your money working for you? 🤗

It’s alright. It works and that’s important but information wise, has a long way to go. Lacks the basics like, a FAQ section. Trying to use this app it’s like joining a class that half way over; they assume that you are already familiar with all the basics of their “great products” (like if you work at the bank or something) so they just skip to selling you other products; in a very deceiving way I may add. I was in the process of opening account 360 and a box showed up where you would have put all your personal information again (you just did right); well, it happens to be a mortgage application! (Since you are here and clueless why not right? I was trying to find out if account came with debit card or not; took a lot of digging to find something close to an answer. Seriously y’all: how about an old fashioned FAQ link at bottom of page?

I received this card after being in an accident and not being able to work for three years, needless to say, things went downhill fast financially. I was surprised to qualify for this card, but I did. After making on time payments for five months, I was able to get a credit limit increase. I have had the card for two years and my credit has improved over 100 points by paying this and all others on time and keeping the balance below half the limit. I know 30% of the limit is optimal, but that’s not realistic for me. Once my bank saw my payment history with this card, the bank issued me a card with a higher limit, so I’m using them both to get my score back over 750.

reviews.t: New app removed most useful feature
reviews.x: First, I should say that I love Capital One overall. But ... it makes me extremely sad that the Capital One Wallet app will be retired in May. Primary value of the app, for me, comes from instant purchase alerts - best feature EVER. But, I have multiple users on my account (2 teenaged kids). Inside Wallet, all purchase activity is divided by card/user, and an easy swipe tells me who did what, and I'm alerted instantaneously. New app dumps everything into one big category. There are filters at the top of the purchase activity page, but none are all that useful to me (no choice for card/user). Do that many people really need to frequently analyze how much of their spending is grocery store versus airline from their phone?? With this new app, I will now need to log into my account ON MY LAPTOP, OR TABLET BROWSER, download purchase activity with user detail, then sort it. Not cool. I do like being able to see other accounts like my Money Market balance via the app, but not much activity happens with that, so ... Capital One, PLEASE add the card user functionality from the old Wallet app to this new version! That would take my rating straight to 5 stars.

When my husband of 47 years passed away I found myself with an income that was a third of what it was. My bills were twice my income. I had no choice but to go bankrupt. I had always had a credit rating of 780+ and suddenly I couldn’t pay my bills. It was very emotional event for me. All our savings were gone. No business or bank would give me credit. Capital 1 was the only bank that would give me a credit card. I found having a card to be a comfort. I no longer had any money for repairs of any kind. I could not even afford tires for my car. I am an old lady and I am sure that didn’t help. I have to say thank you Capital 1 for giving me a chance to right myself again. I will always keep you in my pocket. Thank You from a lonely heart.

I’m not easy. I’m not some little puppy who loves a pat on the head for paying his bills on time, and I have a sincere disdain for “big money” banks, but the way Capital One manages its online credit card and banking operations is so efficient. Upon utilizing the usual password access procedure, the links are immediately relevant and instant, so the online experience is fast, simple, and allows the online banking client to feel in control of his or her finances, with optional embellishments ie a superior choice of spending rewards and a sophisticated credit score revelation that even suggests improvement techniques. The online assistance is also succinct and seems to be in control when any kind of malware attempts to compromise their customer security. I plan to stay with this company.

reviews.t: Good app in general, but hobbled with VPN
reviews.x: I’ve always been impressed with the function of the Capital One app. As other reviewers point out, it works smoothly, allows multiple logins, looks good, and respects OS conventions. Until recently, I would have rated the app a full five stars, but its functionality seems to have been hobbled while operating over a VPN. I use a VPN for added privacy online and always use servers based domestically (to the US), so there’s little reason to cripple my ability to deposit checks simply on account of that. What’s worse is that the failure is simply noted with the message, “sorry, we’ve hit a snag. Try again later,” rather than telling me the underlying reason - that’s not helpful app behavior. I had to spend an hour either on hold or on the phone with tech support only to find out the true reason why the app wasn’t working. I’ll update the rating to five stars if the app starts working well again under a VPN.

The Capital One credit card app makes the Capital One credit card the best. They send you a notification each time your credit card is used. I recently received a notification of a charge I did not make. With just a few clicks, I reported the charge as fraudulent. Capital One immediately cancelled my card and initiated the process to send me a new card, which I received a few days later. Then they investigated and rejected the fraudulent charge. And while I was waiting on my new card, I could still use my old card by contacting them to tell them a charge was valid. In this age of electronic thievery, you cannot ask for better protection than the tools Capital One provides to help you protect yourself.

It is a nicely designed and executed app. I have a business credit card account and a personal credit card account with them. It does a good job of showing multiple accounts and details. I’m a big fan of Capital One sending instant alerts on purchases. I’d like to see some improvements. 1. iOS app push message alerts don’t beep or buzz. This issue is not due to any settings I have on my iOS devices. As the purpose of the purchase alerts is to draw immediate attention in case there is a fraudulent charge, the push messages should beep and buzz. I could get around this issue by opting for text messages instead of push, but I’d rather not. 2. My wife’s card and my card have different numbers on a single account. The purchase alerts via iOS push messaging don’t tell us which one of our cards was used for the transaction. So when a purchase alert comes in, it is hard for us to know if it was fraudulent or if our spouse used the card. Including the last 4 digits of the card in the alert will solve that problem. 3. iOS Wallet wants me to use the Capital One Wallet app to validate the addition of Capital One card to Apple Pay. That should be changed to this mobile app. 4. It is confusing to have this mobile app and the Capital One Wallet app. They mostly do the same thing. Capital One should get rid of the Capital One Wallet app.

I got a credit card through Capitol One as a way to help build my credit. When my first payment came along, I tried making a payment through this app for my minimum payment. It was returned a few days later, so I was advised to try again since the funds were in my other account. Well I tried again, and again the payment was returned. I called customer service again, and was advised to try and use my other accounts bill payment. They assured me everything was fine. Well I tried that, and the payment took, but then my account was promptly closed. When I called the customer service team for the third time, they advised that I had had too many of my payments returned so they closed my account and there was nothing I could do. So now my credit has been affected, I have a bill for $400+ dollars, and they refuse to even apologize or offer any kind of solution. After this, I turned off my autopsy immediately. I was going to wait for when I had enough to pay it in full and be done with it. Not long after I find that my autopay wasn’t turned off, the app had kept my info, and despite having cancelled my other account it was still trying to make unauthorized payments. I emailed customer service several weeks ago and have heard nothing from them. Don’t trust this credit card company or their app.

I thought it was just me but I’m very disappointed to see the amazing notifications from the Wallet app removed. They said they were moving it to this app but it’s not there! There are NO instant purchase notifications on whether something has been approved or declined! How do you not integrate something that was so valued on the Wallet app? I see all the other options for notifications on your balance and what not but NOTHING for instant purchase notifications! Come on guys, do you realize this helped me catch credit card fraud on my account multiple times!? I really hope the developer reads this and takes this very seriously. It was an integral part of the other app. Now I have to manually check when my card is swiped to see if I got double-charged or mysteriously charged for something.

reviews.t: Pretty solid mobile and online banking
reviews.x: I've been with Capital One about a year now, and have few complaints. Mobile and online banking are easy to use, and visually appealing. All accounts are conveniently located together, and details and features are pretty self explanatory.
